title: Technical Product Manager, Chemistry IT Systems
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
San Diego, California, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an exceptional Technical Product Manager, Chemistry IT Systems, to join our team in Beerse, Belgium or Spring House, Pennsylvania. Our Business Technology team delivers leading-edge technology solutions that advance J&J Innovative Medicine’s molecule discovery organization. As a strategic information technology partner, the team supports key scientific functions across medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, analytical chemistry, DMPK, discovery data sciences, computational sciences, screening, and compound logistics.
  
  
Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s): Springhouse, PA: La Jolla, CA; and Beerse, Belgium.
  
  
Beerse, Belgium- Requisition Number: R-093445
  
  
Remember, whether you apply to one or all of these requisition numbers, your applications will be considered as a single submission.
  
  
Team members partner directly with business stakeholders to analyze business processes, define scientific IT requirements, and build strong partnerships across research and business technology groups. Through these collaborations, the team delivers complex, cross-site, multidisciplinary projects and programs that create meaningful impact across discovery sciences.
  
  
In this Technology Product role, the successful candidate will help shape and deliver enterprise-wide discovery informatics platforms that modernize and support lead discovery and optimization across multi-modality research. The role will enable data-driven, AI-augmented discovery workflows across Design–Make–Test–Analyze cycles by translating scientific needs into scalable technology capabilities, integrated data flows, and product roadmaps. The role focuses on applying best-in-class technology to design high-performing platforms that help business partners pursue scientific opportunities that were previously out of reach.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Discovery Informatics Strategy and Delivery

+ Contribute to the global delivery of cheminformatics and broader discovery informatics platforms for the Innovative Medicine research organization.
+ Define, evaluate, implement, and champion new data-driven and scientific IT approaches across discovery sciences globally.
+ Identify and drive opportunities to modernize chemistry-centric decision-making through advanced digital capabilities.

* Portfolio and Product Leadership

+ Lead and support portfolio strategy for assigned product areas by identifying gaps, overlaps, retirement opportunities, and performance improvement recommendations.
+ Define project goals, manage risks and budgets, and ensure measurable impact through effective execution and post-project evaluations.
+ Evaluate and communicate the strengths and weaknesses of business processes, identify new business requirements, and develop change strategies that improve information systems, procedures, and stakeholder outcomes.

* AI, Data, and Technology Enablement

+ Understand the global deployment of AI and machine learning capabilities for molecular invention, including AI-enabled search experiences that allow chemists to retrieve information using natural-language prompt statements and emerging AI agent capabilities that proactively surface relevant information, support workflow automation, and enable alert-based notifications.
+ Apply a strong understanding of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, data integration, and lifecycle management.
+ Support technology adoption and change management across diverse teams and organizational levels.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Engagement

+ Lead cross-site, multidisciplinary projects with internal and external partners.
+ Promote team member engagement and commitment while ensuring clear, effective communication between researchers, developers, and engineers.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s is required preferably in Chemistry or relevant life science or data science field of study.
* Graduate degree preferred.
* 5+ years in pharmaceutical R&D molecular discovery with strong exposure to small molecule, peptide and large molecule chemistry research.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with scientific stakeholders, technology teams, and cross-functional partners to define requirements and deliver informatics or scientific IT solutions.
* Candidates should have Data base management to be able effective engage with Cheminformatics teams, architects, and external vendors supporting solutions across multiple applications. Strong technical expertise would be a significant advantage, enabling the individual to provide informed guidance and contribute strategically to solution design and implementation.

+ Experience with pipelining applications such as KNIME or Pipeline Pilot.
+ Experience with commercial chemistry software providers such as Schrödinger, BIOVIA, Revvity, OpenEye, ChemAxon, or similar platforms.
+ Experience with open-source chemistry or cheminformatics applications such as RDKit or Oligokit.
+ Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Spotfire.
+ Knowledge on Data warehouses and ETL clarifies how data is managed and consumed by multiple users across cross matrix.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

title: Technical Project Manager (BUSY Bar)
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager (BUSY Bar) based in United States.**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will help organize and drive the delivery of a smart productivity hardware product. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, design, and operations teams to turn ideas, requirements, and decisions into clear plans and actionable tasks. You’ll own coordination across multiple workstreams, ensuring dependencies, deadlines, blockers, and decisions are actively managed. The role combines Agile delivery, technical project coordination, documentation, and operational follow-through. You’ll work in an international environment alongside internal teams, vendors, and contractors. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how a technology product moves from planning through release.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Organize sprint work, including planning, task breakdown, prioritization, and progress tracking.
* Translate product requirements and decisions into clear, actionable tasks for engineering and design teams.
* Track deadlines, dependencies, blockers, risks, and agreements across project participants.
* Maintain accurate backlogs, roadmaps, project documentation, and task statuses.
* Document product and technical decisions, requirements, meeting outcomes, and agreed next steps.
* Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, design, and operations.
* Run regular team syncs and follow up to ensure decisions are translated into execution.
* Support changes in requirements by assessing their potential impact on scope, timelines, and delivery.
* Coordinate operational matters involving vendors, contractors, legal, finance, and other external stakeholders.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and escalate issues that could affect timelines, quality, or product outcomes.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Project Manager, or Product Operations Manager within a technology product company.
* Experience working directly within a product or engineering organization, rather than exclusively in an agency or administrative environment.
* Hands-on experience running Agile/Scrum processes and managing sprint execution.
* Experience taking ownership of projects or products from initial scoping through release.
* Strong ability to write requirements, user scenarios, acceptance criteria, and development or design tasks.
* Experience managing multiple parallel workstreams, dependencies, and external stakeholders.
* Experience working with vendors, contractors, or operational teams.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing and release.
* Basic understanding of how hardware, firmware, mobile, and backend components interact.
* Ability to turn complex or loosely defined problems into structured, actionable tasks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence running meetings and driving decisions to completion.
* Self-driven and proactive approach, with a willingness to personally resolve organizational and delivery challenges.
* Upper-Intermediate English or above, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, vendors, and contractors.
* Experience using project and documentation tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.
* Experience with hardware, IoT, or embedded products is a plus.
* A background in Business/System Analysis, QA, or Software Engineering, combined with experience coordinating development and delivery, is a plus.
* Experience with roadmap tools, process diagrams, or workflow-mapping systems is a plus.

**Benefits**

* Choice of working format: office, hybrid, or fully remote from anywhere in the world.
* Necessary equipment provided to support a comfortable and effective working environment.
* Benefits including VHI, corporate sports activities, foreign language courses, and therapy sessions.
* Five-day workweek with a flexible start to the working day.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. title: Technical Program Manager and Data Product Delivery Lead
description:
**Description**
**About Peregrine**
Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.
  
  
Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.
  
  
We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.
  
  
As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.
  
  
**People first. Ownership always.**
We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.
  
  
At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.
  
  
At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the integrated delivery of three production data products across Peregrine and its delivery partners for a federal agency. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.
  
  
This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $165,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements.
  
  
**Your first project**
Your First Project Turns a Fixed Schedule And a Complex Technical Scope Into Clear Decisions, Accepted Deliverables, And a Stable Team. You Will Deliver
  
  

* One integrated plan, backlog, calendar, risk register, decision log, and definition of done.
* Delivery of all monthly milestones and formal deliverables with acceptance evidence prepared before submission.
* A disciplined agile cadence that connects daily work, biweekly demonstrations, weekly management, and monthly government reporting.
* Fast resolution of access, data, architecture, partner, staffing, and acceptance dependencies.
* Clear writing. Status reports, risks, decisions, and escalations must be concise enough to act on immediately.
* Visible performance management across all personnel, including partner resources and replacements.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 8+ years leading technical delivery, including at least three enterprise data, analytics, cloud, or artificial intelligence (AI) programs
* Working knowledge of data engineering, cloud platforms, analytics, testing, and model delivery. This is a technical delivery job, not an administrative coordinator
* Experience managing federal customers, subcontractors, deliverables, acceptance, risk, reporting, and security-dependent onboarding
* Practical agile leadership, including backlog management, sprint planning, demonstrations, retrospectives, and corrective action
* Strong written and verbal communication. You must explain technical issues to executives and turn customer comments into controlled work
* United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms
* The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements

**Preferred**

* Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL-5) or higher
* Azure Databricks, Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow, or federal financial and audit data experience
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Scrum Master, product management, or a comparable delivery credential supported by real project results
* Experience with firm fixed price delivery and acceptance-based invoicing

**Who You Are**
You turn a fixed schedule and a complex technical scope into clear decisions, accepted deliverables, and a stable team. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* Calm under pressure and quick to surface bad news before it becomes expensive.
* Direct, organized, low ego, and comfortable holding senior specialists accountable.
* Able to work at executive altitude in one meeting and inspect a test plan or backlog in the next.
* Protective of the customer relationship without hiding delivery facts from Peregrine leadership.
* Persistent with access and dependency follow-up. Polite reminders alone will not move this program.

**When we talk**
Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.
  
  
**Benefits**
Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.
  
  
**What We Offer**
You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.
  
  
**What We Commit To**
As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.
  
  
We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
  
  
Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
*Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

title: IT Program Manager, Staff - Enterprise Data Transformation
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm Incorporated
  
  
**Job Area**
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Program Management
  
  
**General Summary**
The
**Staff IT Program Manager**
will lead the planning and execution of Qualcomm’s enterprise data transformation, a multi-year initiative to establish the Enterprise Data Hub (EDH) as a unified, trusted, scalable, and governed foundation for enterprise data products, analytics, reporting, applications, and advanced technology solutions. The role will coordinate business and technology workstreams spanning data strategy, architecture, Databricks platform development, data engineering, data integration, migration, governance, quality, security, analytics, organizational change, adoption, and legacy-system retirement. The Program Manager will establish integrated governance, roadmaps, plans, budgets, dependencies, decision forums, and outcome measures; direct delivery across internal teams, software providers, systems integrators, and business functions; and provide transparent reporting to executive sponsors and steering committees. The role will ensure that enterprise data capabilities align with and support major business platforms and transformations, including CRM, HCM, ERP, PLM, supply chain, finance, customer, product, engineering, and other systems of record. This role reports to the Office of Planning & Delivery (OPD), part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO).
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Leads the full lifecycle of a large, global, cross-functional enterprise data transformation from strategy and business case through platform development, data onboarding, migration, solution delivery, deployment, adoption, operationalization, and value realization.
* Builds and maintains an integrated, outcome-based transformation roadmap and plan of record covering EDH platform evolution, Databricks capabilities, data architecture, data engineering, data products, integrations, governance, security, analytics, migration, legacy retirement, organizational change, and operational readiness.
* Establishes the program governance model, decision rights, workstream structure, delivery methodology, and executive reporting cadence; facilitates steering committee, program leadership, architecture, data governance, dependency, risk, and decision forums.
* Partners with executive sponsors, business data owners, product owners, enterprise architects, and IT leaders across finance, sales, supply chain, manufacturing, human resources, product development, engineering, commercial operations, security, infrastructure, analytics, and other functions to define the transformation vision, scope, business outcomes, delivery priorities, and accountabilities.
* Directs the development and evolution of EDH as the enterprise platform for governed data products, business intelligence, self-service analytics, enterprise applications, data sharing, and advanced analytical capabilities.
* Coordinates Databricks platform strategy and implementation, including lakehouse and medallion architecture, scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines, batch and streaming patterns, data sharing, workspace and environment strategy, observability, performance, cost management, release management, and platform operations.
* Drives enterprise data architecture and design decisions involving common data models, primary and master data, metadata, semantic layers, lineage, data contracts, retention, lifecycle management, interoperability, and secure access.
* Ensures data governance is embedded throughout the transformation, including data ownership and stewardship, quality and certification, cataloging, lineage, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, retention, and auditable controls.
* Maintains an end-to-end view of critical enterprise data flows, including data origination, transformation, enrichment, distribution, consumption, and control points across systems.
* Leads data discovery and intake processes that translate business needs, pain points, analytical requirements, and strategic priorities into defined data products, use cases, and platform capabilities.
* Establishes data classification and certification practices, including heightened quality, security, reconciliation, and approval requirements for critical, regulated, financial-reporting, and executive-decision datasets.
* Partners with architecture and engineering leaders to establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering standards, and platform guardrails that improve scalability, interoperability, reliability, security, and delivery speed.
* Promotes DataOps and software-engineering practices across the platform, including version control, CI/CD, automated data testing, environment promotion, deployment controls, documentation, and production observability.
* Defines and monitors service-level objectives and operational measures for platform availability, pipeline reliability, data freshness, processing performance, incident response, recovery, and stakeholder support.
* Coordinates data and integration requirements across enterprise solutions such as CRM, HCM, ERP, PLM, finance, supply chain, customer, product, engineering, and related systems of record, ensuring alignment on data ownership, models, interfaces, timing, controls, and downstream consumption.
* Leads the migration of data assets, pipelines, reports, dashboards, and analytical workloads from legacy data warehouses and platforms to EDH, including dependency analysis, sequencing, mapping, reconciliation, parity validation, business transition, retirement planning, and realization of operating-cost reductions.
* Leads the strategy and execution of enterprise business intelligence rationalization, including assessment of existing reports, dashboards, data extracts, analytical applications, and tools; establishes criteria for retention, consolidation, redesign, migration, certification, and retirement; and partners with business owners to simplify the analytics landscape, improve trust and usability, reduce duplication and cost, and increase adoption of governed enterprise data products and standard BI capabilities.
* Drives the development and adoption of reusable, domain-aligned data products that provide trusted business definitions, certified metrics, consistent dimensions, appropriate controls, and secure consumption across reporting, analytics, applications, and other enterprise use cases.
* Partners with business and technology leaders to establish data-domain ownership, product-management practices, delivery priorities, service expectations, and measurable outcomes for enterprise data products.
* Manages interdependencies across platform, domain, governance, analytics, integration, security, infrastructure, and enterprise-application workstreams and owns consolidated scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, milestones, changes, decisions, and actions.
* Directs integrated data and solution readiness, including source-to-target mapping, data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, data quality thresholds, lineage, access controls, testing, performance validation, business acceptance, deployment, cutover, stabilization, and operational handoff.
* Establishes consistent delivery practices for enterprise data initiatives, including intake, prioritization, estimation, planning, dependency management, architecture review, release management, status reporting, escalation, and benefits tracking.
* Integrates stakeholder engagement, communications, data literacy, role-based training, organizational readiness, adoption, and sustained changes in business and technology practices into the transformation plan.
* Establishes an enablement model for data engineers, analysts, data scientists, data stewards, product owners, power users, and business consumers, including reusable patterns, communities of practice, training, office hours, documentation, and adoption support.
* Leads the transition to a sustainable data-product and platform operating model with clear ownership, governance, service management, support processes, financial management, performance measures, and continuous-improvement mechanisms.
* Directs systems integrators, software providers, consultants, and other partners; coordinates workforce planning and reviews statements of work, staffing models, estimates, deliverables, acceptance criteria, commercial commitments, invoices, performance, and change requests.
* Establishes the benefits-realization framework by defining financial and non-financial baselines, target outcomes, measures, timing, and accountable business owners; monitors value throughout delivery and ensures ongoing tracking of adoption, data quality, data trust, platform usage, delivery speed, legacy retirement, productivity, and business impact.
* Anticipates cross-workstream risks and resource constraints, escalates decision needs early, drives mitigation and recovery plans, and provides concise, fact-based executive communications on program health, options, tradeoffs, financial outlook, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Applies lessons learned and leading practices from prior data, cloud, analytics, and enterprise-application transformations and operates with substantial independence, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.

**Corporate & Professional Competencies**

* Analytical Expertise — Analyzes, interprets, integrates, and verifies complex business, program, platform, and data information from multiple sources to identify critical trends, make informed decisions, and address complex enterprise transformation challenges.
* Clear Communication — Communicates complex program, data, architecture, governance, and technical information accurately and promptly, adapting messages and methods to the evolving needs of executive, business, technical, and external audiences.
* Coaching & Development — Seeks feedback and continuous learning, promotes data literacy, provides leadership and constructive coaching to program participants, and aligns individual and team development with transformation and organizational goals.
* Collaborative Teamwork — Builds effective working relationships across functions, business units, geographies, data domains, enterprise-application teams, and external partners while demonstrating and encouraging respect, dignity, and fairness.
* Functional Knowledge — Leverages advanced enterprise data, analytics, platform, and program-management expertise together with operational, financial, and organizational knowledge to create business cases, assess cost and value, and connect work across the enterprise.
* Impactful Innovation — Develops and implements impactful data, analytics, automation, and platform approaches for complex situations while encouraging experimentation and alternative viewpoints that challenge fragmented or legacy practices.
* Strategic Execution — Prioritizes key objectives and manages complex, cross-functional work while meeting quality expectations, navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities, delivering commitments, and adhering to Qualcomm standards of ethical behavior.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of program or project management experience, including leadership of large, complex, global technology or business transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading a significant enterprise data platform, data modernization, analytics, cloud, or related transformation through multiple lifecycle phases.
* Program leadership experience with modern cloud data platforms and technologies such as Databricks, data lakehouse architectures, cloud data services, data integration, data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, or analytics platforms.
* Experience coordinating work across data platform, architecture, engineering, governance, security, analytics, integration, testing, deployment, operations, and organizational change teams.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data-management disciplines, including data architecture, data modeling, ingestion and transformation, data products, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, master or primary data, semantic layers, and lifecycle management.
* Experience integrating data from major enterprise applications such as CRM, HCM, ERP, PLM, finance, supply chain, customer, product, engineering, or other systems of record.
* Experience leading data migration and modernization efforts involving legacy data warehouses, data pipelines, reports, dashboards, analytical workloads, or related data assets.
* Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, business cases, systems integrators, software vendors, contracts, statements of work, and geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to communicate with and influence executives, business data owners, product owners, architects, engineers, analysts, data scientists, security teams, finance partners, and external providers in a matrixed environment.
* Proven ability to create structure in ambiguity, manage complex dependencies, drive difficult decisions, and deliver measurable business and technology outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of program management experience, including leadership of a multi-year, global enterprise data, analytics, cloud, or related transformation.
* Hands-on program leadership experience developing or scaling an enterprise data hub, data lakehouse, data mesh, data-product ecosystem, or cloud data platform.
* Experience with Databricks capabilities such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, Databricks SQL, MLflow, AI/BI, or related data engineering, governance, analytics, and platform services.
* Experience with public-cloud data services and architecture on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience implementing medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic layers, business metrics, common data models, metadata management, data marketplaces, knowledge graphs, or governed self-service capabilities.
* Experience establishing federated or hybrid data governance, including ownership, stewardship, certification, quality, lineage, access, privacy, security, and lifecycle policies.
* Experience integrating data from CRM, HCM, ERP, PLM, supply chain, finance, customer, product, or engineering platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, Oracle, SAP, Siemens Teamcenter, or comparable enterprise solutions.
* Experience modernizing or retiring legacy data warehouses, ETL platforms, business intelligence tools, dashboards, reports, and data pipelines while maintaining business continuity and stakeholder trust.
* Technical fluency sufficient to evaluate data architecture, integration, engineering, security, performance, and operating-model tradeoffs with senior architects and engineers; working knowledge of SQL, Python, or comparable data-analysis techniques is beneficial.
* Experience developing or enabling AI and machine-learning solutions that depend on governed enterprise data, including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, conversational analytics, intelligent agents, model operations, or intelligent automation.
* Working knowledge of AI-ready data practices, including data quality, metadata, lineage, semantic context, security, privacy, responsible use, model and agent governance, and monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to identify valuable AI-enabled opportunities, partner with AI platform and solution teams, and translate business needs into scalable data and technology capabilities.
* Experience in the semiconductor, high-technology, electronics, manufacturing, or similarly complex global industry.
* Experience establishing transformation governance and presenting recommendations, architecture choices, tradeoffs, program health, and value realization to senior executives and steering committees.
* Demonstrated organizational change management, adoption, data literacy, and business enablement experience for large-scale data and technology change.

title: Senior Technical Compliance Program Manager, LCPO Solutions & Strategy
description:
**Overview**
At Intuit, we help over 100 million people and businesses around the world feel more confident about their money. We are the proud makers of TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. Our mission is to power prosperity around the world. We do this by staying customer-obsessed and using data and AI to solve the biggest financial challenges for our customers.
  
  
The Legal, Compliance, Policy Organization’s Solutions & Strategy team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our team. As technical program manager, you will be part of a smart, collaborative team focused on modernizing how Intuit's legal function operates, leverages data, automation, and AI. In this role you will work closely with legal operations, counsel, engineering, and other internal stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities where technology and AI-powered tools can make LCPO faster, data driven, and more efficient while enabling the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a technical translator and point of contact between Legal, Compliance and Policy Practice Groups and FLP Tech engineering — converting legal/business requirements and processes into clear technical requirements, user stories, and program plans that engineering can execute against.
* Partner directly with LCPO stakeholders across Legal Practice Groups to gather requirements, ask the right clarifying questions, and surface the true underlying need, not just the stated ask.
* Own end-to-end program delivery for prioritized Legal Tech initiatives (e.g., Unified Orchestration, workflow automation, AI-assisted review tooling, CLM and data lake integrations), from planning through launch.
* Champion end user experience throughout the delivery lifecycle — pressure-testing designs and workflows from the perspective of the legal/compliance practitioners,and business stakeholders who will actually use these tools day to day.
* Structure program delivery across engineering teams by applying strong SDLC knowledge — identifying workstreams, owners, dependencies, and risks before they materialize.
* Drive the operating rhythm for assigned programs: build and maintain plans with clear milestones and success measures, run status/risk reporting, and proactively escalate blockers with recommended paths to green.
* Build credibility with technical SMEs and engineering leads — understand solutions deeply enough to participate in architecture and trade-off discussions, and communicate technical constraints back to legal/business stakeholders in plain language.
* Apply AI tools as thought partners to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication, and help evaluate the quality and risk of AI-assisted outputs.
* Support change management for new tools, workflows, and process redesigns — including stakeholder communication, training, and adoption tracking — to ensure LCPO teams actually adopt what FLP Tech ships.
* Contribute to and help scale program management best practices, tools, and templates across the Legal Tech program portfolio.
* Own clear from-to metrics on intake so every request has a stated baseline and target before work begins.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, or a related program/product delivery role, ideally including some experience supporting enterprise, legal, compliance, or other regulated business functions.
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies and the software delivery lifecycle; able to structure and manage technical program delivery across cross-functional engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a translator between non-technical business/legal stakeholders and engineering teams — turning ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable technical scope.
* Strong requirements-gathering skills, including the ability to ask incisive clarifying questions, identify unstated assumptions, and drive stakeholders to a well-scoped problem definition.
* High level of technical acumen: comfortable engaging in architecture and trade-off conversations with engineers, without requiring a hands-on coding background.
* A genuine focus on end user experience — able to advocate for usability and workflow simplicity even under legal/compliance complexity.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and strong working relationships across Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Engineering.
* Superior program/project management and time-management skills, including managing multiple priorities and cross-functional dependencies in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Proven ability to drive operating rhythm: building plans, tracking risks/dependencies, and communicating clearly with data to drive alignment and decisions.
* Familiarity with AI and automation tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, agentic AI/workflow platforms) and a demonstrated interest in applying them to accelerate program delivery.
* Proven history of taking initiative, working independently, and proactively identifying areas of need and generating recommended action plans.
* Intellectual curiosity with a demonstrated willingness to dive into new legal, compliance, and technical domains.
* Preferred Prior experience working with or adjacent to a Legal, Compliance, or Privacy organization.
* Experience with legal tech / workflow orchestration platforms (e.g., Tonkean, ServiceNow, Ironclad, Legal Tracker) or comparable enterprise workflow tools.

title: Silicon IP Program Manager - 18314
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent a decade or more in the semiconductor world, close enough to analog and digital design that you can read a block diagram, spot a risk in a timing closure plan, and ask the question that makes an engineer pause and reconsider. You know that the hardest part of delivering IP is not the RTL or the characterization, it is aligning three time zones, two customer stakeholders who want different things, and a release schedule that was aggressive before someone added another tape out dependency.
  
  
You have been the person customers call when something is off track. Not because you have all the answers, but because you ask the right questions, escalate what matters, and keep your team focused on what will actually move the needle. At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex IP in the industry, and the programs you run will directly enable customer tape outs that matter.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout IP program delivery, from kickoff through post-silicon support
* Own statement of work (SOW), program schedules, milestones, and deliverables across analog IP, digital IP, and SoC integration efforts
* Coordinate cross-functional global teams including design, verification, applications, and sales
* Identify technical, resource, and schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans
* Report program health and blockers to internal leadership and customers in a way that drives action

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate customer product launches by keeping IP delivery on schedule and reducing integration friction
* Reduce delivery risk across high-stakes programs where timing, quality, and customer trust are non-negotiable
* Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a reliable IP partner by consistently delivering what was promised
* Drive broader adoption of Synopsys IP by ensuring customers have a smooth experience
* Shape program management standards across the IP organization

**What You'll Need**

* BSEE or equivalent, with 8+ years of semiconductor industry experience. (we are growing this team with multiple levels available)
* Proven technical program management experience in SoC design, analog IP, or digital IP development
* Direct experience managing customer-facing programs where you owned schedules, deliverables, and stakeholder communication
* Strong understanding of semiconductor design flows, IP integration challenges, and what it takes to get a chip to tape out
* Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, across geographies and disciplines

**Who You Are**

* You can look at a program plan and spot the dependency that will become a problem in six weeks, not after it is already late
* When a customer escalates an issue, you listen, clarify, own the follow-through, and close the loop
* You stay organized across multiple simultaneous programs without losing track of what matters most
* You push back when a commitment does not make sense, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
Work with the Silicon IP Program Management Office, collaborating globally with engineering, sales, and support teams to deliver innovative solutions.

description:

This role leads the delivery of an advanced Digital Twin Platform that combines real-time 3D, physics simulation, industrial data, and IoT technologies.
  
  
You’ll guide complex engineering programs that enable customers to simulate, test, optimize, and predict the behavior of real-world assets before making physical changes.
  
  
The position sits at the intersection of technical program leadership and hands-on engineering expertise, requiring strong judgment around architecture, scope, risk, performance, and delivery.
  
  
You’ll coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, design, and data while aligning dependencies and priorities across multiple workstreams.

title: Project Manager (PJM) – Open Source Software & Upstream Enablement - Remote
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm France S.A.R.L.
  
  
**Job Area**
Operations Group, Operations Group > Project Manager
  
  
**General Summary**
The Open Source Technology Team (OSTT) drives Qualcomm's open source enablement strategy across multiple technology domains including Linux Kernel, Zephyr, Open Boot Firmware, Linux Distributions, Testing Infrastructure, Kernel Testing & CI, LAVA, and related upstream ecosystems. OSTT operates with an upstream-first mindset, collaborating internally with engineering, product, program management, and executive leadership while engaging externally with open source communities and industry partners. OSTT is responsible for enabling sustainable adoption of open source technologies, accelerating upstream contributions, improving product readiness, and delivering scalable testing and validation capabilities.
  
  
The team manages complex portfolios spanning multiple Qualcomm SoCs, software programs, and long-term strategic initiatives. Program execution is highly data-driven, with Jira serving as the primary system of record for planning, execution tracking, risk management, status reporting, and executive visibility.
  
  
**Position Summary**
OSTT is seeking a highly motivated Project Manager (PJM) to lead the planning, execution, governance, and reporting of strategic open source initiatives. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of engineering, open source communities, product organizations, and senior leadership.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of technical curiosity, program management discipline, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive execution across geographically distributed teams. The PJM will ensure alignment between strategic objectives and day-to-day execution while providing clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio and Program Leadership**

* Manage a portfolio of open source initiatives across domains such as:
* Linux Kernel Upstreaming
* Open Boot
* Zephyr RTOS
* Linux Distributions (Yocto, Debian, Fedora)
* Testing & Validation Infrastructure
* LAVA and KernelCI enablement
* Define and maintain program roadmaps aligned with OSTT strategic objectives.
* Facilitate prioritization of initiatives, backlog management, and quarterly planning cycles.
* Coordinate execution across multiple SoCs, product teams, and technology groups.

**Project Execution and Governance**

* Drive end-to-end project execution from planning through delivery.
* Establish and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Monitor program health through meaningful KPIs and actionable metrics.
* Identify execution risks, bottlenecks, and resource constraints, driving timely mitigation plans.
* Ensure accountability and follow-through on commitments across stakeholders

**Jira and Backlog Management**

* Own governance of Jira-based planning and execution processes.
* Maintain high-quality project data enabling accurate reporting and decision-making.
* Drive backlog structuring, refinement, prioritization, and execution tracking.
* Establish traceability between engineering work, deliverables, and strategic objectives.
* Ensure consistent project hygiene and reporting discipline across the organization.

**Executive Reporting**

* Prepare regular executive-level status updates and business reviews.
* Develop concise summaries of program progress, accomplishments, risks, and required decisions.
* Translate technical topics into business-relevant insights.
* Deliver dashboards, reports, metrics, and presentations for senior management audiences.
* Facilitate leadership reviews and steering committee discussions.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with engineering leaders, technical leads, architects, and program managers.
* Coordinate activities across geographically distributed teams.
* Facilitate alignment between business priorities and engineering execution.
* Lead structured discussions focused on progress, stalls, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
* Build trusted relationships across internal organizations and external partners.

**Open Source Ecosystem Engagement**

* Support programs interacting with upstream open source communities.
* Understand upstream development lifecycles, release planning, and community processes.
* Help teams navigate submission timelines, review cycles, and community expectations.
* Facilitate collaboration between Qualcomm engineering teams and open source stakeholders.

**Process Improvement**

* Continuously improve project management practices, tooling, reporting, and governance.
* Introduce scalable methodologies for managing large engineering portfolios.
* Promote automation, AI-assisted workflows, and operational efficiencies.
* Drive adoption of best practices across OSTT programs.

**Required Skills**
**Program Management**

* Strong project and program management experience in complex engineering environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with competing priorities.
* Expertise in planning, scheduling, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication.

**Technical Acumen**

* Ability to work effectively with highly technical engineering teams.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycles and modern development workflows.
* Understanding of open source software development models.
* Exposure to Linux-based platforms, embedded software, or systems engineering is highly desirable.

**Communication**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, directors, executives, and external partners.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting capabilities.

**Collaboration and Leadership**

* Influential leader without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills.
* Capable of driving consensus across diverse organizations and cultures.
* Agile servant leader.

**Tools**
**Experience With**

* Jira
* Confluence
* Microsoft 365
* PowerPoint
* Excel / Reporting systems
* GitHub and collaborative development platforms
* AI-assisted productivity tools (Copilot, Claude, etc.) is a plus

**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of project or program management experience.
* Experience in semiconductor, embedded software, Linux, Android, automotive, IoT, or open source ecosystems.
* Exposure to Linux kernel development, upstream contribution workflows, or open source governance.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams.
* Experience supporting executive reviews and organizational planning.

**Success Profile**
**The Ideal OSTT Project Manager Is**

* Comfortable operating in highly technical environments without necessarily being an engineer.
* Passionate about open source and large-scale collaboration.
* Data-driven and execution-focused.
* Able to transform ambiguity into structured plans.
* Skilled at aligning stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
* Trusted by both engineers and executives.
* Relentless about execution, transparency, and continuous improvement.

In short,
**the OSTT PJM is the operational glue that connects strategy, engineering execution, open source engagement, and executive visibility, ensuring Qualcomm's open source initiatives are delivered predictably, transparently, and at scale.**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of project management or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Associate's degree and 7+ years of project management or related work experience.
  
  
OR

At McGraw Hill, we are dedicated to delivering digital learning experiences that transform education for learners and educators. Our focus is on creating seamless, impactful products that truly benefit our users while supporting growth and collaboration across teams. We foster a culture that values innovation, teamwork, and a balance between career growth and personal well-being.

The Senior Technical Product Manager leads cross‑functional engineering teams within the Enterprise domain, driving Business Unit (BU) partnership, development, and delivery of scalable, intelligent solutions that power our global digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, education, and enterprise platform architecture, helping scale AI capabilities that personalize learning, improve outcomes, and drive data‑informed decision making throughout the organization. Success requires a deep technical understanding of AI systems, APIs, databases, and infrastructure, paired with strong product leadership, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Technical Project Lead - Research
description:
ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Wilton, CT, Chandler, AZ, San Jose, CA and San Diego, CA.
  
  
The Technical Project Lead, Main Deliverable Owner, is responsible for managing the critical path of key project deliverables, while balancing the triple constraints of schedule, resources and cost. This includes but is not limited to creating and tracking schedules, performance targets, resources plans, and general planning activities for Source Research (SR) learning and testing deliverables. Throughout the process, the MDO is responsible for ensuring that the proper elements of the SR WOW are known and adhered to across the research team: assessing risk and mitigation strategies; highlighting issues and managing their solutions including through escalation process; and coordinating the various development activities to ensure intermediate cross-program communication. The MDO makes the connection between high-level plans and tactical, operational plans.
  
  
Duties and responsibilities:
  
  

* Manage system hardware and software integration and completion of technical learning deliverables from SR Functions

+ Own deliverables (qualified BoM/SW baseline; qualified build/setup & test sequence; qualified upgrade packages, integration sequence)
+ Align on triple constraints, with the relevant stakeholders internally and across sectors – Safety, Facilities, Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering
+ Report on deliverable status and quality, towards project lead, program and line management

* Own release strategy for baseline and upgrades with team and roll up to high-level plan with the Project Lead. Own the “bottom-up” plan

+ Plan work over prototype EUV light sources (test rigs)
+ Manage bottom-up differences between machine plans and integration plan
+ Report on bottom-up differences between machine and integration plan
+ Manage critical path of hardware and software integration
+ Support and monitor test preparation and readiness, including documentation, materials tracking, tool availability, sequence generation, test plan reviews and resources

* Provides input towards the SR learning objectives and committed testing
* Manage issues for the agreed deliverables
* Roll-up towards Top-X lists & report Proto test rig level impact

+ Define and own the issue handling WOW, maintain issue lists (or delegate), ensure root cause corrective actions are completed
+ Critical stakeholder for equipment availability and utilization, maximizing learning potential through lessons learned and test operational reports

* Report on integration quality towards internal customers and make proposals for structural improvements
* Plan, coordinate and coach the assigned test engineering team in order to identify and separate integration related product risks compared to issues as a result of research efforts
* Performs other duties as assigned

Education and Experience
  
  

* BS or MS in an Engineering discipline or Physics with 5+ years of relevant experience
* Excellent communication skills, and demonstrated ability to align communication with various teams
* Excellent skills managing stakeholders across sectors
* Analytically strong, enthusiastic, flexible, assertive, proactive, structured
* Knowledge and experience in EUV light sources and technology preferred

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you will always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You will not work in a silo. Instead, you will be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you will collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You will have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

* Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work
* Can learn and apply new information or skills

description:

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
  
  
****Company Operating Rhythm****
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
  
  
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
  
  
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
  
  
Deepgram is seeking a
**Senior Technical Program Manager (Engineering)**
to drive execution across complex, cross-functional programs involving both software and hardware. In this role, you’ll work closely with our engineering and research teams to manage large-scale, technically demanding initiatives—from inception through delivery.
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you enjoy creating clarity out of complexity, organizing ambiguous requirements into coherent roadmaps, and getting into the technical weeds to keep programs moving forward. We’re looking for someone who has led large, multi-disciplinary initiatives and can partner with researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders to align teams and outcomes.

* Enjoy optimizing complex distributed systems for performance and cost
* Love solving challenging problems in compute, networking and storage at global scale
* Are excited about working with cutting-edge GPU infrastructure, and frontier research in ML architecture
* Want to work at the intersection of humans and AI/ML systems

**It’s Important To Us That You Have**

* Strong technical acumen—bonus if you’ve been an engineer or worked closely with applied-ML teams

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Greystar**
Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Greystar is seeking an experienced, highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead engineering initiatives within our Digital, Data & AI team. The TPM will have a strong sense of ownership, aid in identifying and resolving dependencies, track progress across different teams, and ensure the work progresses, while clearly communicating progress and risks to project stakeholders.
  
  
This role sits at the delivery core of the Data Digital and AI team and is distinct from our Product Managers/Owners: PMs own the what and why (product direction and roadmap priorities); the TPM owns the how and when, driving execution end-to-end across engineering teams without absorbing product scope.
  
  
Success in this role requires an equal blend of hands-on technical fluency and strong project and program management discipline. Nearly every initiative brings together multiple engineering disciplines within a single project — data engineering, application/product engineering (web and mobile), and infrastructure.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own end-to-end delivery for assigned initiatives, from scoping through launch, driving progress across data engineering, product engineering (web and mobile), and infrastructure teams, often within the same project.
* Partner with Product Managers to translate product strategy and roadmaps into executable delivery plans. Product Managers own product direction; TPMs own sequencing, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Drive delivery for application-centric initiatives, including web and mobile feature launches, API/service integrations, and release coordination — with enough fluency in app architecture to pressure-test estimates, identify technical debt risk, and sequence frontend/backend/mobile workstreams realistically.
* Keep initiatives moving under competing priorities by driving stalled decisions to resolution with clear options, a recommended default, and a named owner, rather than allowing work to drift.
* Regularly assess risks and opportunities; understand best practices, drive process improvements, and find new ways of operating, with a focus on simplification and productivity.
* Run the delivery operating system in Linear, including sprint planning, dependency tracking, RACI, and status reporting, as the single source of truth across multiple product teams.
* Drive initiatives with a heavy data component, coordinating data readiness, integration, and quality across delivery, with enough fluency to pressure-test estimates and ensure data-dependent plans are realistic.

**BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven track record of managing large-scale, complex technical initiatives for product development & software engineering with clear evidence of technical delivery you personally owned and shaped.
* Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity to detailed solutions. You can take a vague problem, crisply frame the challenge, identify a path forward, and drive an initiative over the finish line.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and proven ability to adapt well and work with teams having different operating cadences.
* Strong working knowledge of data, including the ability to read a data model, understand pipeline and integration dependencies, assess data quality, and hold teams accountable for data readiness. This is not a data engineering role, but you must be able to identify and address data-related risks.
* Strong working knowledge of application development, including the ability to read a system/architecture diagram, understand client-server and API dependencies, assess technical debt and scalability tradeoffs, and hold teams accountable for release readiness. This is not a software engineering role, but you must be able to identify and address app-delivery risks
* Experience developing processes where little exists and demonstrated flexibility to get things done.
* Proven experience leading delivery across multiple engineering disciplines, not just one. You have coordinated data engineering, product or application engineering (web and/or mobile), and infrastructure within the same initiative.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Lazer**
is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like
**Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more.**
With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products
**from $0 to $200M in revenue.**
Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.
  
  
We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!
  
  
Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!
  
  
**Lazer Commerce**
is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with enterprise brands to design and implement complex storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From platform migrations to ERP and OMS workflows, our team brings deep expertise in Shopify Plus, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure -- helping clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lazer is seeking an experienced
**Delivery Manager**
to lead the development of enterprise eCommerce platforms on Shopify. In this role, you will own the client relationship, manage budgets, and oversee the entire project lifecycle from strategy to execution. Acting as the primary liaison between enterprise clients and Lazer’s internal teams, you’ll ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards.
  
  
You will drive the strategic direction of projects, manage competing priorities, and foster collaboration across cross-functional teams. Your expertise in eCommerce, particularly Shopify, coupled with your project and product management skills, will empower you to lead complex platform migrations and deliver innovative solutions for enterprise clients.
  
  
**The Role**

* Client Relationship Management:

+ Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, owning the client relationship and ensuring satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
+ Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives to align project deliverables with business objectives.
+ Act as the client's trusted advisor, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth and innovation.

* Project Management:

+ Oversee end-to-end project delivery for Shopify-based eCommerce platforms, including migrations and custom implementations.
+ Create and manage comprehensive project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and milestones.
+ Ensure project objectives align with client business drivers and are delivered on time and within budget.
+ Monitor and manage dependencies, risks, and issues, providing regular updates to stakeholders.

* Product Ownership:

+ Define and prioritize product roadmaps, requirements, and user stories in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
+ Work closely with developers, designers, and QA engineers to ensure the successful implementation of features and functionalities.
+ Triage and manage defects, ensuring high-quality deliverables and securing QA sign-off.

* Collaboration and Governance:

+ Facilitate communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams, third-party vendors, and clients.
+ Provide regular governance updates, including status reports, budget tracking, and resource utilization.
+ Supervise third-party solutions to ensure successful integration and alignment with project goals.

**Requirements**

* Professional Experience:

+ Proven experience as a Delivery Manager, Product Owner, Digital Project Manager, or similar role, with a focus on eCommerce and retail.
+ Extensive knowledge of Shopify Plus and its ecosystem, including platform migrations, custom development, and integrations.
+ Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex project portfolios.

* Client Engagement Skills:

+ Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and C-suite executives.
+ Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

* Project Management Expertise:

+ Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including experience with Scrum or Kanban frameworks.
+ Proven track record of delivering large-scale eCommerce solutions on time and within budget.
+ Expertise in creating and managing project plans, tracking dependencies, and mitigating risks.

* Leadership and Collaboration:

+ Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and align cross-functional teams.
+ Demonstrable ability to resolve disputes, overcome challenges, and maintain a positive attitude in high-pressure situations.

* Required Qualifications:

+ Experience in managing platform migrations from systems like Magento, Salesforce, or BigCommerce to Shopify Plus.
+ Familiarity with ERP, OMS, and CMS integrations (e.g., NetSuite, Sanity, or Manhattan).
+ Shopify certifications are a plus.

**AI in our hiring process**
We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.
  
  
**Why Work With Us**

* 🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast.
* 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.
* 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.
* 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.

**Why This Might Not Be For You**

* 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.
* 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.
* 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.
* 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.

**Benefits & Perks**

* 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!
* 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.
* 🩺 Employee Care: We provide full benefits (healthcare, dental, vision) for our employees (401k for our US employees)
* 🏖️ Unlimited PTO: Everyone needs a break. Take at least 15 days off a year, and more if you need—just be cool about it and keep the team in mind.
* 🎉 Regular Team Retreat: Join us for a week of team bonding at amazing destinations. Recent trips include the Dominican Republic, Cancun, and Hawaii — plus ones welcome.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager, Data Center & Network Delivery
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.
* 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting
* Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year
* 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan
* Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year
* Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month
* Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Technical Project Manager to drive the successful execution and delivery of our global GPU data center deployment projects. The ideal candidate is a disciplined project leader with 6+ years of PM experience and a deep understanding of the data center lifecycle, specifically in coordinating the physical implementation of high-density compute environments. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require advanced-level cross-functional coordination, a proven track record of managing 3+ years of data center infrastructure deployments, and the ability to facilitate complex technical designs into operational reality. This is your opportunity to join our fast-growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Execution: Lead the planning and execution of specific project workstreams within the broader GPU data center deployment program.
* Technical Integration: Coordinate with engineering and facilities teams to facilitate the design, site-specific implementation, and optimization of data center environments.
* Operational Delivery: Manage the deployment lifecycle of high-density GPU clusters, including oversight of specialized infrastructure such as liquid cooling systems and networking interconnects.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive alignment between Networking, Facilities, Compute Engineering, and Supply Chain to ensure seamless project handoffs and risk mitigation.
* Schedule & Risk Management: Develop detailed project schedules, identify potential bottlenecks, and implement mitigation strategies to maintain deployment timelines.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, preferably within a large-scale enterprise or infrastructure environment.
* 3+ years of experience specifically in Data Center deployments or physical infrastructure projects.
* Proven ability to manage complex project schedules and coordinate multiple stakeholders across different time zones.
* Strong understanding of the data center lifecycle, including power, cooling, and rack-level integration.

**Compensation**
$110,000 - $140,000
  
  
*Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.*
**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
