title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
**Description**
The Senior IT Project Manager leads the design, development, and implementation of information systems across the full system development life cycle, from requirements through go-live and transition to operations. Systems may include Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS), eligibility and enrollment systems, enrollment broker platforms, learning management systems, web portals, and data and reporting solutions. The Senior IT Project Manager supports multi-year, federal, state, and corporate projects with budgets of $500,000 and higher.
  
  
Essential Duties
  
  

* Lead the initiation, planning, execution, and closing of IT and Professional Services projects across the full system development life cycle (SDLC), from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the end client, vendors, stakeholders, and Briljent. Manage communication across all parties and regularly report on project progress to ensure successful outcomes, customer satisfaction, and a positive employee experience.
* Define and develop project scope, deliverables, tasks, required resources, schedule baselines and expenses; manage resource allocations; and provide timely performance feedback to ensure successful project completion.
* Monitor project budget and hours to achieve target gross margin goals, accurately forecast resource utilization and revenue recognition, and review and approve client and subcontractor invoices.
* Apply Waterfall, Agile/Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies based on client needs, including backlog, sprint, and release planning in coordination with product owners.
* Facilitate requirements gathering and elicitation sessions, maintain a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), and partner with business analysts, developers, solution architects, and quality assurance (QA) teams to translate business requirements into technical designs.
* Identify, monitor, and mitigate project risks, including technical risks, system interfaces, integrations, and environment dependencies.
* Ensure quality of all project deliverables to Briljent standards and client requirements, including oversight of system, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT), defect triage, and go/no-go readiness decisions.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors, system integrators, and client IT organizations, and define statements of work for subcontract partners.
* Support federal oversight activities as applicable, including Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) certification, Advance Planning Documents (APDs), and Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) reviews.
* Collaborate with technical, organizational change management (OCM) and training teams to ensure end-user readiness for system go-live.

**Requirements**

* Superior writing and verbal communication skills
* Outstanding organization, prioritization, time management skills and the ability to master complex systems and topics quickly
* Working knowledge of software development, system integration, APIs, and data flows sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams
* Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical executives and program staff
* Exemplary consultative and customer service skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work well with a wide range of people, personalities, and levels within an organization
* Ability to manage conflict and negotiate win-win solutions
* Ability to perform under pressure, and meet expected deadlines
* Proficient with project management and delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or ServiceNow
* Familiarity with cloud-based and software-as-a-service (SaaS) implementations
* Must have an AI-forward mindset and the ability to effectively leverage AI tools and technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity in daily project management activities
* Must demonstrate the ability to use AI responsibly and effectively to support project planning, documentation, analysis, communication, and other routine project management activities

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or program/project management, or equivalent work experience
* PMP® Certification
* Agile certification preferred (PMI-ACP®, Certified ScrumMaster® (CSM), or SAFe®)
* At least 7 years of experience managing IT projects for external customers, including at least 5 years managing system implementations
* Demonstrated experience successfully managing IT projects exceeding $500,000 in budget
* Successful delivery of at least one large-scale system implementation from requirements through go-live
* Experience managing projects with federal government, state government, and private clients
* Health and Human Services (HHS) or Medicaid systems experience preferred (e.g., MMIS, eligibility and enrollment, enrollment broker, or data and reporting systems)

Employee is regularly required to talk or hear, sit, stand, and utilize technology tools such as a laptop computer for extended periods of time. Specific vision abilities include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. This position requires the ability to occasionally lift up to 20 lbs. title: Principal Product Manager, Risk & Fraud
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
****What You’ll Be Part Of:****
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
******What You’ll Be Part Of:******
Circle is a financial technology company at the epicenter of the emerging internet of money, where value can finally travel like other digital data — globally, nearly instantly and less expensively than legacy settlement systems. This ground-breaking new internet layer opens up previously unimaginable possibilities for payments, commerce and markets that can help raise global economic prosperity and enhance inclusion. Our infrastructure – including USDC, a blockchain-based dollar – helps businesses, institutions and developers harness these breakthroughs and capitalize on this major turning point in the evolution of money and technology.
  
  
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we’re expanding into some of the world’s strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: Multistakeholder, Mindfulness, Driven by Excellence and High Integrity. Circlers are consistently evolving in a remote world where strength in numbers fuels team success. We have built a flexible and diverse work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
****What you’ll be responsible for****
As a Principal Product Manager at Circle, you will own the strategy and execution of our risk platform, ensuring it scales to support new products, markets, and global regulatory requirements. You will act as a cross-functional leader, partnering with compliance, legal, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to align priorities and deliver resilient infrastructure that supports both crypto and traditional financial rails. By combining product vision, technical fluency, and deep compliance expertise, you will enable Circle to manage risk with precision, meet evolving regulatory expectations, and uphold the highest standards of trust and safety.
  
  
****What you’ll work on****

* Define the strategy and roadmap for a risk and fraud platform that supports real-time and asynchronous risk decisions across products and markets that supports crypto- and traditional financial rails, as well as risk-related use cases across onboarding, account linking, and other customer lifecycle events — with a focus on building a user-friendly rules engine and intuitive tooling for risk operators.
* Build fraud prediction and detection systems from the ground up by defining risk vectors affecting Circle’s product roadmap and executing mitigating controls to address them by integrating party vendor models, and creating iterative feedback loops that learn from past fraudulent behavior.
* Define and implement observability strategies to ensure risk platform integrity, including monitoring performance, validating critical flows, and surfacing key risk indicators to inform prioritization and executive decision-making.
* Leverage AI/ML to automate risk decisioning and operational processes; lead feature/context engineering, model development, evaluation/monitoring frameworks.
* Maintain clear, comprehensive documentation of platform design, functionality, and dependencies to ensure internal transparency and audit readiness.
* Translate regulatory requirements and business needs into clear product requirements, insights, and user stories for engineering execution.
* Represent the risk platform in senior leadership and regulatory forums, aligning cross-functional strategy and demonstrating how Circle’s infrastructure meets evolving compliance obligations at scale.

****What you’ll bring to Circle****
****Core Requirements****

* 10+ years of product management experience building risk, compliance, or trust & safety platforms in fintech, crypto, or financial services.
* Deep expertise in fraud typologies in consumer/SMB segments, signals & strategies to mitigate them and hands-on experience crafting risk rules.
* Deep expertise in AML, sanctions screening, and onboarding compliance (e.g., KYC/KYB),
* Track record of translating regulatory requirements into scalable, policy-driven platform capabilities that support both real-time and asynchronous risk decisioning across crypto and fiat rails.
* Experience leading modular platform design, including refactoring monolithic services into scalable, service-oriented architectures.
* Skilled in collaborating with engineering, data science, and operations teams to ship complex infrastructure products; able to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across functions.
* Highly analytical and data-driven, with experience applying ML, risk signals, and scoring models to improve detection, decisioning, and operational efficiency.
* Strong technical fluency, including working knowledge of APIs & SDKs, event-driven architectures like SNS/SQS or equivalent, SQL, GitHub or equivalent.

******Preferred Requirements******

* Background in RegTech, banking, or scaled fintech, with direct exposure to complex regulatory environments.
* Expertise in blockchain technologies and crypto compliance, including chain types, on-chain travel rule requirements, blockchain monitoring, and evolving crypto regulations.
* Experience with rapid prototyping using AI tools to accelerate product exploration, workflow automation, or internal tooling development.

*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*
Base Pay Range: $200,000 - $260,000

. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Technical Program Manager - Maritime Defense
description:

Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions*

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager in the greater San Diego area (we offer relocation) to help architect, manage complex projects, identify gaps, and implement best practices for our maritime customers. This position will involve intense collaboration with subject matter experts within Applied Intuition and the the defense customer on a technical level in order to implement solutions for customer pain points.
  
  
**At Applied Intuition, You Will**

* Execute projects as the single point of contact, track progress, and ensure successful completion of all the milestones, metrics, and final deliverables

* Provide regular touch points with Applied Intuition's internal teams to update on customer use cases and workflows that our current software solutions do not yet provide a solution for

title: Technical Product Manager, Data and Analytics
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving.
**Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!**
  
  
As a
**Technical Product Manager for Data and Analytics**
, you will lead the development, enhancement, and continuous improvement of ML models and gen AI development, data pipelines, and business intelligence.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Business Owners, Engineering, Operations, and other stakeholders—to define product strategy, deliver high-quality solutions, and ensure our technology evolves to meet changing business and customer needs.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, technical acumen, and the ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for data and analytic products including ML models, gen AI, data pipelines, reports and dashboards, aligning business objectives with platform capabilities and technical constraints.
* Balance business objectives, customer needs, and technical feasibility to prioritize initiatives.
* Incorporate user feedback, market trends, and competitive insights to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

**Requirements & Feature Development**

* Translate business needs and user insights into clear, developer-ready features and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and refine features.
* Prioritize enhancements based on ROI, user impact, and delivery complexity.

**Backlog & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog aligned to business priorities balancing new capabilities, enhancements, and technical debt.
* Collaborate closely with Development team, architecture, and QA throughout the development lifecycle to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.

**Technical Alignment**

* Ensure solutions align with Hagerty best practices, architectural standards, and enterprise integration patterns
* Partner with both the business and engineering to evaluate design decisions, tradeoffs, and implementation approaches.
* Stay current on relevant technologies, platforms, and regulatory considerations impacting product development.

**User Experience & Adoption**

* Champion user-centric design principles, ensuring intuitive and effective product experiences.
* Support product rollout through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Gather feedback to continuously improve usability and adoption.

**Performance & Metrics**

* Define and track KPIs and success metrics to measure product performance and business impact.
* Use data and insights to inform prioritization, enhancements, and long-term strategy.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Act as a product subject matter expert and trusted partner across business and technology teams.
* Navigate ambiguity and complex tradeoffs, providing clear product direction and decision-making.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

**This Might Describe You**

* 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in a technical or SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with a full spectrum of data products including machine learning, generative AI applications, data pipelines, and reporting and dashboards.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to work closely with data scientists, engineering teams and understand complex systems.
* Proven track record of owning product strategy, defining roadmaps, and delivering complex software solutions.
* Experience translating business requirements into actionable product and technical deliverables.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Experience working in agile development environments with a solid understanding of modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A user-focused mindset with attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality products.
* Insurance industry experience is a plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with enterprise platforms or complex system integrations.
* Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps or similar agile delivery platforms.
* Exposure to regulated environments or compliance-driven product development (e.g., SOX).

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Have technical product expertise and enjoy owning complex, mission-critical systems.
* Are comfortable operating at the intersection of product, technology, and finance.
* Prefer clarity and precision over vague product language.
* Enjoy turning messy operational problems into scalable platform capabilities.

**Other Things To Note**

* This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
* May require travel for quarterly events.
* Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email recruiting@hagerty.com for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart.
  
  
At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference.  We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.
  
  
Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.
  
  
Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent**
, you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally. You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution.
  
  
In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make the AI Agent product successful. You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value! To do this, you’ll…
* Own the deployment lifecycle for AI Agents — from pre-sale scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization
* Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents in partnership with FDEs using Cresta’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI
* Lead customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help prospects and customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.
* Facilitate workshops and design sessions with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria while gathering feedback to improve the AI agent platform
* Work closely with FDEs to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform
* Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product, or Customer Success roles, ideally working closely with AI or LLM first products
* Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action. You anticipate needs and bottlenecks and deliver with urgency and care.
* Experience leading complex deployments, owning customer relationships (including senior customer stakeholders), and working cross-functionally
* Strong technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!)
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment
* Passion for AI, automation, and shaping the future of customer experience

**Bonus Points**

* Background in product management, conversation design or forward deployed engineering roles
* Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
* Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations

**Perks & Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:
  
  

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
* Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
* Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
* Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
* Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
* Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
* In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

**Compensation At Cresta**
Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.
  
  
The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.
  
  
**OTE Range**
: $170,000–$280,000 + Offers Equity
  
  
***Our use of AI in recruiting:***
*We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact*
*recruiting@cresta.ai*
*(if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).*
***Recording & AI transcription:***
*We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.*
***Recruiting impersonation scams:***
*We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the*
*@cresta*
*.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.*

title: Tech Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
At SCA Health, we believe
**health care is about people**
- the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the
**mission, vision and values**
that define our organization.
  
  
As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.
  
  
**What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it**
. Each decision we make is rooted in
**seven core values**
:
  
  

* Clinical quality
* Integrity
* Service excellence
* Teamwork
* Accountability
* Continuous improvement
* Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words - they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.
  
  
At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, https://careers.sca.health/why-sca, to learn more about our benefits.
  
  
Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team,
**they will**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Project Manager is responsible for the management of multiple, concurrent projects including the enforcement of governance processes to ensure compliance of the project process through scoping, analysis/design, implementation, and closing. Projects vary depending on size and scope which will require flexibility of project management processes and solutions. This role will include management of the entire project life cycle, balancing the constraints of project scope, timelines, quality, and budget. The position will require management of risks, completion of status reports, approving deliverables and post deliverable assessment. Day to day management of project resources will be required including significant communication to project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Additionally, there will be direct interaction with all levels of individuals throughout the organization as well as 3rd party vendors and consultants.
  
  
Significant interaction with SCA leaders will be a requirement of this position and, therefore, this individual must be comfortable working with the highest levels of senior management. This position requires proactiveness, willingness to learn from various business areas, and ability to make recommendations on how best to improve process and/or use technology to solve business problems.
  
  
**Essential Functions/Responsibilities:**
**Project Oversight**

* Creates and executes project work plans and revises as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
* Identifies resources needed and assigns individual responsibilities.
* Effectively applies company methodology and enforces project standards.
* Coordinates quality assurance procedures.
* Project risks & issues management
* Ensures project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.

**Project Accounting**

* Develops budget, provides monthly forecasting, and overall budget management.
* Ensures timely and accurate invoicing, and monitors receivables for project.
* Follows up with customers, as necessary, regarding unpaid invoices.
* Assures project legal documents are completed and signed.

**Communication**

* Facilitates team and customer meetings effectively.
* Holds regular status meetings with project team.
* Keeps project team well informed of changes within the organization and general corporate news.
* Effectively communicates relevant project information to superiors.
* Resolves and/or escalates issues in a timely fashion.
* Understands how to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully.

**Customer Management & Business Partnership**

* Manages day-to-day customer interaction.
* Sets and manages customer expectations.
* Develops lasting relationships with teammates that foster customer ties.
* Communicates effectively with customers to identify needs and evaluate alternative business solutions.
* Builds a knowledge base of each customer’s business, organization, and objectives.
* Ensure cadence with business team leadership to ensure alignment with business goals, strategy.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5+ years hands-on project management experience required.
* M&A experience is required.
* Experience managing projects in both waterfall and agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban frameworks.
* Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, including a proven ability to adapt to a dynamic project environment.
* Proven ability to manage key stakeholders while managing competing priorities.
* Strong leadership skills including conflict/issue resolution.
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and written with customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to work effectively with project resources across multiple departments.
* Substantial experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint & Project.
* ServiceNow experience is a plus.
* Microsoft Office 365 experience is a must. Azure is a plus.
* Working knowledge of cyber security, data retention, infrastructure, networking preferred.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree (Engineering, Business, Org. Management, Project Management, Computer Science, or related)
* PMP Certification is highly
* Additional agile preferred certifications include:

+ PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
+ org (PSM-I, PSPO-I)
+ Scrum Alliance (CSM, CSPO)
+ Scaled Agile (SA, SSM, SP, PMPO)

USD $100,000.00/Yr. USD $110,000.00/Yr.

title: Sr Product Manager – Data Center Controls Solutions
description:
*Join the world's largest HVAC company, named by Forbes as one of America's Best-In-State Employers 2025!*
*Make your mark at the world’s largest HVAC company*
Daikin Applied is seeking a
**Senior Product Manager – Data Center Controls Solutions**
who is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the product and portfolio strategy for Daikin Applied's Data Center Controls Solutions offerings. This role serves as the primary liaison between the Data Center Corporate Team, Controls & Solutions business, Global engineering, digital services, sales, marketing, and external partners to deliver innovative solutions that drive customer value and profitable growth.
  
  
The successful candidate will own the vision and roadmap for data center controls solutions offerings, encompassing the controls ecosystem, software, analytics, connectivity, monitoring, optimization, and emerging digital solutions. This individual will lead new product introductions (NPIs), develop go-to-market strategies, identify growth opportunities, and serve as the subject matter expert who orchestrates cross-functional stakeholders to successfully deliver market-leading solutions for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and edge data center customers.
  
  
This role will lead the development and execution of the Data Center Controls Solutions portfolio strategy, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, corporate growth objectives, and technology roadmaps. Come be a part of an exciting journey at Daikin Applied, where innovation and excellence drive our every endeavor!
  
  
**Location:**
San Diego, CA, Plymouth, MN, Phoenix, AZ, Atlanta, GA
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own and execute the portfolio strategy and long-term roadmap for Data Center Controls Solutions, aligning with Daikin Applied's growth objectives and data center market strategy
* Serve as the primary product management interface with the Data Center Corporate Team to identify market opportunities, customer needs, technology trends, and competitive threats
* Define solution requirements spanning building controls, equipment controls, automation platforms, digital services, analytics, cloud connectivity, monitoring, optimization, cybersecurity, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Lead the product lifecycle from concept development through launch, commercialization, growth, and end-of-life management
* Develop business cases, market assessments, customer value propositions, pricing strategies, and revenue forecasts for new offerings
* Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) activities by coordinating engineering, Digital, manufacturing, operations, service, sales, marketing, and external technology partners
* Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies, including positioning, messaging, sales enablement, launch plans, and channel engagement
* Act as the subject matter expert for data center controls and digital solutions, supporting strategic customer engagements, industry events, sales pursuits, and executive-level customer discussions
* Analyze market trends, competitive offerings, customer feedback, and industry developments to guide portfolio investment decisions
* Establish and maintain partnerships with third-party technology vendors, cloud providers, software partners, and ecosystem participants to expand solution capabilities
* Monitor portfolio performance, profitability, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction, recommending actions to optimize business results
* Collaborate with sales and service organizations to identify growth opportunities and improve customer experiences across the product lifecycle
* Support strategic planning activities, including annual operating plans, growth initiatives, portfolio reviews, and investment prioritization
* Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and ensure alignment of objectives across multiple organizations
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**What’s In It For You**

* The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
* The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Engineering: Mechanical, Electrical
* Computer, Building Automation Systems or related technical discipline
* 6 to 8 years in product Management, Building Automation, Controls, Data Center Infrastructure, HVAC Systems, Digital Services, Software Solutions, or related technologies
* 5 + years in product management leadership within controls, software, digital services, cloud-connected solutions, or mission-critical infrastructure markets
* Demonstrated success leading product strategy and managing profitable technology portfolios
* Strong understanding of Building Automation Systems (BAS), HVAC Controls, equipment controls, and integrated solutions architectures
* Knowledge of mission-critical data center environments and their operational requirements
* Experience leading product lifecycle management and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs
* Ability to develop business cases, perform market assessments, and define product investment strategies
* Strong understanding of customer requirements analysis, product road mapping, and commercialization
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Strong analytical, financial, and strategic planning capabilities
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in a highly matrixed organization
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30%
* Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10 + years experience serving Data Center, Mission-Critical, or Building Technologies markets
* Experience with data center cooling, controls architectures, thermal management systems, and mission-critical infrastructure
* Knowledge of cloud-connected platforms, IoT architecture, analytics, AI/ML applications, and digital services
* Experience with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, edge, or AI-focused data center environments
* Familiarity with cybersecurity requirements and connected building technologies
* Experience working with software vendors, cloud providers, technology alliances, and strategic partners
* Experience launching software, SaaS, analytics, optimization, monitoring, or digital service offerings

* Experience developing and executing vertical market strategies
* Strong understanding of GTM planning, channel engagement, sales enablement, and value proposition development

title: Principal, Enterprise AI Platform & Strategy | Onsite San Diego HQ
description:
**Who We Are**
Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis\* and uterine fibroids\*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (
*\*in collaboration with AbbVie*
)
  
  
**About The Role**
The Principal, IT Engineering Enablement - AI Data Platforms leads enterprise-wide initiatives that define, deliver, and mature Neurocrine’s core AI and machine learning platforms. This role combines technical program leadership, platform product management, and strategic advisory responsibilities to accelerate enterprise adoption of secure, scalable, and governed AI capabilities. This role partners with Engineering, Data, Cybersecurity, Tech Enablement & Adoption, Compliance and business stakeholders to architect platform strategy, own the AI services roadmap, and orchestrate multi-team execution across complex workstreams. Acting as the organization’s primary technical AI subject-matter expert, this role drives evaluation of emerging models and technologies, ensures alignment to Responsible AI principles, and shapes the long-term platform foundation that enables advanced analytics, automation, and AI-powered applications across Neurocrine.
  
  
\_
  
  
**Your Contributions (include, But Are Not Limited To)**
**AI Platform Leadership & Product Ownership**

* Owns the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for Neurocrine’s AI/ML platforms—including model orchestration, RAG pipelines, embeddings services, prompt governance, vector search, and model performance monitoring.
* Leads evaluation, selection, and integration of foundation models, third-party AI services, and emerging technologies to support enterprise AI use cases.
* Defines platform requirements, success metrics, technical capabilities, and prioritization aligned with business value and risk considerations.
* Develops ROI models for AI use cases and builds executive presentations and updates

**Enterprise AI Strategy & Advisory**

* Serves as the company’s primary AI technical SME, advising leadership and cross-functional teams on AI feasibility, solution patterns, risks, and architectural alignment.
* Partners with business units to shape AI concepts into actionable initiatives, ensuring platform capabilities and governance frameworks are consistently applied.
* Identifies new opportunities for scalable AI adoption across functions, proactively recommending platform enhancements and enterprise best practices.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Compliance**

* Leads the development and ongoing stewardship of Neurocrine’s Responsible AI governance framework, including council facilitation, policy creation, risk assessments, and guardrails for safe and compliant use of AI technologies.
* Partners with Legal, Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, Tech Enablement & Adoption, and Compliance to ensure platform standards meet regulatory, ethical, and organizational requirements.
* Defines operational readiness and auditability criteria for AI-enabled solutions across the enterprise.

**Cross-Functional Program Execution**

* Drives the end-to-end execution of AI and platform initiatives—requirements, dependency management, engineering coordination, release readiness, and enterprise rollout.
* Orchestrates work across engineering, data, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and product teams to deliver integrated, scalable, and secure platform capabilities.
* Implements and reinforces Agile/Scrum practices to improve transparency, delivery velocity, and alignment across multi-team programs.
* Identifies and mitigates platform bottlenecks or risks related to scalability, security, cost, or developer experience.
* Continuously evaluates industry trends to recommend platform evolutions that improve long-term sustainability and enterprise value.

**Platform Health, Telemetry & Continuous Improvement**

* Establishes and monitors platform KPIs—including availability, performance, adoption, SLOs, usage patterns, and business impact—to guide roadmap and operational improvements. Key areas include:

+ Business impact (time saved, revenue uplift, cycle time reduction, etc.)
+ Quality of Response (Accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, quality, etc.)
+ Management of usage and tokenization optimization

* Identifies and mitigates platform bottlenecks or risks related to scalability, security, cost, or developer experience.
* Continuously evaluates industry trends to recommend platform evolutions that improve long-term sustainability and enterprise value.

**Collaboration With Technology Enablement & Adoption**

* Partners closely with the Technical Enablement & Adoption Manager to ensure consistent onboarding, training, and communication for new AI capabilities.
* Contributes subject-matter expertise to enablement content, adoption campaigns, and enterprise training—without serving as the primary owner of these functions.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* PMP certification (or in progress) strongly preferred
* 10+ years of relevant experience, including a combination of education and professional experience, in IT or related disciplines, ideally within the pharmaceutical industry or similar regulated environment
* Working knowledge of enterprise AI components:
* RAG pipelines
* Embedding services
* LLM orchestration and evaluation
* Prompt governance
* Model performance monitoring
* Understanding of foundation models, vector databases, third-party AI services, and AI safety/responsible AI concepts
* Experience delivering automation frameworks, integration platforms, and reusable services
* Understanding of telemetry, observability, SLOs, performance tuning, and platform reliability practices
* Familiarity with data privacy, security requirements, and governance frameworks
* Understanding of platform governance models—API lifecycle, versioning, access policies, auditability
* Ability to define platform vision, multi-year roadmaps, and measurable KPIs
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and making strategic recommendations
* Strong ability to drive complex, multi-team initiatives with clarity and momentum
* Skilled at influencing without authority across engineering, data, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders
* High-quality communication (written, verbal, executive-level summarization)
* Expert in Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog management, milestone tracking, and risk mitigation
* Demonstrated ability to run end-to-end program lifecycles—requirements, prioritization, delivery, rollout, and adoption
* Skilled in structured decision-making and cross-functional alignment
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into actionable technical roadmaps
* Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward data-driven decisions
* Comfortable using metrics/telemetry to diagnose issues and measure outcomes
* Experience driving enterprise-wide adoption, onboarding, and training
* Able to facilitate complex discussions, manage competing priorities, and resolve blockers

Neurocrine Biosciences is an EEO/Disability/Vets employer.
  
  
We are committed to building a workplace of belonging, respect, and empowerment, and we recognize there are a variety of ways to meet our requirements. We are looking for the best candidate for the job and encourage you to apply even if your experience or qualifications don’t line up to exactly what we have outlined in the job description.
  
  
\_
  
  
The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is $132,700.00-$182,000.00. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus with a target of 30% of the earned base salary and eligibility to participate in our equity based long term incentive program. Benefits offered include a retirement savings plan (with company match), paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

title: Product Owner III, Tempus Technologies

As a leader in the industry, we recognize our employees as one of our greatest assets. title: Application Owner- Field & Risk
description:
**Department:**
Risk Management and Loss Control

**Location:**
Home United States

**Compensation:**
$145,000 - $155,000 / year

**Description**
**Our Story**
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At
**Davies North America**
, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.
  
  
The
**Application Owner**
is responsible for the operational ownership, delivery coordination, and continuous improvement of the app ecosystem supporting the Field & Risk Services (FRS) division. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, the Product owners , and the development team to ensure that strategic initiatives are translated into actionable work, prioritized appropriately, and delivered through a structured Agile framework.
  
  
The role combines Product Ownership, Application Ownership, and Scrum Master responsibilities, acting as the day-to-day steward of the platform while facilitating sprint execution, release planning, team coordination, and delivery governance. The Product & Platform Owner will work closely with the Head of Product, who is responsible for strategic product direction, divisional priorities, business outcomes, and long-term platform evolution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Ownership**

* Act as the primary operational owner for the application portfolio.
* Capable of hands-on intervention during critical problem-solving scenarios.
* Maintain oversight of platform health, support processes, integrations, technical debt, and enhancement opportunities.
* Partner with engineering leads to ensure platform stability, performance, security, and scalability.
* Coordinate business and technical stakeholders regarding platform changes and releases.
* Facilitate issue escalation and resolution across business, support, and engineering teams.
* Ensure platform documentation, operational procedures, and ownership records remain current.

**Product Ownership & Delivery Governance**

* Own the day-to-day operational backlog for business applications and related platforms.
* Translate business requirements, enhancement requests, defects, and operational needs into well-defined user stories and backlog items.
* Maintain backlog hygiene, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and delivery readiness.
* Ensure development priorities align with strategic direction established by the business.
* Coordinate release planning and delivery schedules with stakeholders.
* Provide visibility into delivery status, sprint progress, risks, and dependencies.

**Agile Delivery Facilitation**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies
* Remove delivery impediments and coordinate resolution of blockers.
* Monitor team delivery metrics and team performance indicators.
* Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement.
* Support estimation, capacity planning, and sprint forecasting activities.

**Business & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the primary coordination point between:
  + FRS Leadership
  + Head of Product
  + Development Team
  + Operations Teams
  + Technology Teams
  + External Vendors (as applicable)
* Communicate roadmap progress, delivery updates, and implementation plans.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions among competing business needs.
* Support business case development and initiative planning.

**Strategic Execution Support**

* Partner with the Head of Product to convert strategic objectives into executable delivery plans.
* Assist in roadmap planning and platform modernization initiatives.
* Support migration, transformation, and continuous-improvement programs across the technology portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, automation, user experience, and operational efficiency.

**Skills, knowledge & expertise**

* 5+ years in Product Owner, Application Owner, Platform Owner, Business Analyst, Delivery Lead, or similar roles.
* 3+ years working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Experience managing software backlogs and coordinating development teams.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and technology delivery teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications through full lifecycle management

**Preferred**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM, or equivalent.
* Product Owner certification (CSPO, PSPO).
* Experience with SaaS, cloud-hosted, or enterprise business platforms.
* Experience supporting insurance, risk services, loss control, premium audit, or field operations platforms.
* Familiarity with application modernization and platform transformation initiatives.

title: Product Manager - AML
description:
**Shape the future of trust in the age of AI**
At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place.
  
  
**Why Join Us**

* Mission-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer.
* Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward.
* Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk.

**The Role**
AML operations teams are making high-stakes decisions on bad tooling. False positive rates hitting 90–95%. SAR narratives written by hand. Alert queues backlogged for days. Investigation workflows duct-taped across a transaction monitoring system, a case management tool, and a spreadsheet no one owns.
  
  
AI has gotten good enough to fix most of this - but compliance teams don't trust it yet, and most AI vendors don't understand AML well enough to earn that trust. You will own the product that earns it.
  
  
At Oscilar, you'll have full product ownership of our AML and financial crimes suite: transaction monitoring, KYC/KYB, screening, case management, SAR filing, and the AI agents that are beginning to augment and automate the investigation workflow itself. This is not a handed-down playbook. You are writing it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Transaction Monitoring. The rules engine and ML model layer that generates alerts - scenario design, threshold calibration, typology coverage, backtesting against historical transaction data. You'll define what the system flags, why, and how those decisions evolve as customer behavior and fraud typologies shift. You understand the difference between a rules-based velocity check and a graph-based network detection model, and you have opinions on when each is right.
* KYC / KYB. Onboarding risk workflows: identity verification, document checks, beneficial ownership, ongoing monitoring triggers, and risk re-scoring. You know the data sources that power these decisions - bureau data, device signals, open banking, registry data - and how to orchestrate them dynamically based on risk tier rather than applying a one-size waterfall.
* Screening. Sanctions (OFAC, UN, EU), PEPs, adverse media, and negative news. You understand the matching problem - why fuzzy matching on names produces the false positive rates it does, and what it takes to make screening defensible to an examiner without generating alert volumes that bury the ops team.
* SAR Filing & Regulatory Reporting. FinCEN SAR workflow end-to-end: narrative generation, supporting documentation, filing status, audit trail. You've seen what regulators look for in an MRA and you build product that holds up under that scrutiny.
* AML Data Strategy. The data model that powers all of the above: transaction graphs, entity resolution, behavioral baselines, consortium signals, model feature pipelines. You can speak fluently to a data engineer about what data the models need and why, and to a compliance officer about what the model's output means and how it was derived.

**How You'll Work**

* You are an AI-native PM. You use AI tools throughout your entire workflow — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier that lets you do in a day what used to take a week.
* For discovery: You use AI to synthesize call transcripts, cluster themes across interviews, scan regulatory guidance and examiner findings, and surface competitive product gaps faster than any manual process. You come into customer conversations already knowing what the literature says - so you can spend the time extracting what the literature doesn't.
* For building: You use AI to generate first-draft PRDs, stress-test your own specs, write and iterate on user stories, prototype UI flows, and pressure-test edge cases before engineering touches them. Your specs are tighter and your stakeholder review cycles are shorter as a result.
* For design: You use AI to explore multiple UX directions quickly and give the design team a sharper brief. You're not a designer - but you use AI tools well enough that you show up with something specific rather than a blank page.
* For analysis: You use AI to query product and operational data, interpret model outputs, and build the evidence base for roadmap decisions. You don't wait for a data analyst to unblock you.

This is how we build. If you've already made AI tools a core part of your workflow, you'll find us a natural fit.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Full-stack AML product depth. You've shipped product across at least two of the five areas above - in production, with real users, under real regulatory scrutiny. You've sat in a room where an examiner asked a question about your system and understood exactly what was at stake. You know what a BSA officer worries about before an exam, and you build product that addresses it.
* AML strategy knowledge. You understand how AML programs are designed and calibrated, not just executed. You know why scenario thresholds drift over time and how to fix it. You know the difference between a structuring typology and a layering typology and have an opinion on which detection approach fits each. You understand model drift, backtesting methodology, and what a model validation report covers. You can engage a Chief Compliance Officer on their AML program design and add something to the conversation - not just listen.
* Technical and data fluency. Your engineers trust your specs. You can read a data schema, write a query to validate a hypothesis, and spot when an ML model is being misapplied. You understand the explainability problem in AI-assisted compliance decisions - not as an abstract concern, but as a concrete product constraint - and you have a position on how to solve it.
* Regulatory literacy. BSA, FinCEN, OFAC, FATF. You understand what examiners are looking for, what triggers an MRA, and how to build a defensible audit trail. You've worked in an environment where regulatory guidance was unclear, evolving, or in conflict with shipping speed - and you made the call anyway.
* Bias toward speed. You use AI tools to move faster, test sooner, and learn earlier. You do in a week what takes a month elsewhere.

**What Success Looks Like**
**30 days:**
You've run discovery with at least 5 AML/compliance buyers - BSA officers, heads of financial crimes, CCOs - and produced a written synthesis that surfaces at least one insight we didn't already have. You've reviewed our current AML product surface and identified the two biggest gaps relative to what buyers actually need.
  
  
**60 days:**
You've delivered one complete PRD - spec'd, reviewed by engineering, AML SME's and product, and ready to build. You have a clear point of view on the SAR narrative automation problem: what to build, what not to build, and why. You've pressure-tested it with at least two practitioners who aren't already sold on it.
  
  
**90 days:**
You're already the PM on calls with CCO prospects. You have a 12-month AML roadmap with clear prioritization rationale. And you've shipped at least one thing to production.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan
* Flexibility: Remote-first culture — work from anywhere
* Health: 100% Employer covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top tier plan for you and your dependents (US)
* Balance: Unlimited PTO policy
* Technical: AI First company; both Co-Founders are engineers at heart; and over 50% of the company is Engineering and Product
* Culture: Family-Friendly environment; Regular team events and offsites
* Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities
* Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions

title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
description:
**About The Role**
HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.
  
  
As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.
  
  
**What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like**

* Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites
* Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's
* Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners
* Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding
* Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets
* Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas
* Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice
* Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data
* Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

**An ideal candidate has**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation
* Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset
* Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team
* The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build
* Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly
* Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level
* A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality
* Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

**Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us**

* Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
* Unlimited PTO
* Carrot Cash travel stipend
* Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend
* Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards
* Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
* Open communication with management and company leadership
* Small, dynamic teams with massive impact
* 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
* Access to Disability and Life insurance
* Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
* DCA/FSA and access to a 401k plan

**About Hopper**
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
  
  
The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
  
  
While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.
  
  
Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
  
  
Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.
  
  
Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  
  
Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.
  
  
Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.
  
  
Come take off with us!
  
  
*At Hopper, we leverage AI-driven tools to assist our team in efficiently reviewing applications. These tools help us assess qualifications fairly and objectively. By submitting your application, you acknowledge the use of these automated screening technologies.*

title: Enterprise Applications Manager
description:
**Location:**
Remote, United States
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Enterprise Applications Manager to join our CRM & Revenue Technology team within Revenue Operations. This newly created role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations and Product Management, serving as the technical bridge between our Salesforce CRM ecosystem and internally developed enterprise applications.
  
  
As the Enterprise Applications Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of complex integration projects spanning Salesforce, Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, and Onboarding systems. This role requires a unique blend of technical depth (integration architecture, API design, Workato development), operational excellence (RevOps processes, data governance), and product thinking (requirements gathering, stakeholder management, feature prioritization).
  
  
You will be the primary business point of contact for all enterprise application projects, partnering with Engineering, Product, GTM leadership, and Revenue Operations to design scalable integration solutions that enable revenue growth. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring strong technical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a self-starter mentality. You'll be working in a dynamic environment where you'll need to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive projects from requirements gathering through deployment and ongoing optimization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Integration Architecture & Implementation**

* Own the design and deployment of integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications (Credit Platform, Data Platform, Entity Management, Onboarding) using Workato or similar iPaaS platforms
* Design integration patterns that ensure data consistency, real-time synchronization, and proper error handling across systems; establish integration best practices and reusable patterns for the team
* Define Requirements for API connections between Salesforce and internal applications; understand REST/SOAP APIs, authentication methods (OAuth, API keys), and webhook architectures
* Gather requirements for complex Workato recipes including conditional logic, data transformations, lookup tables, error handling, and batch processing; optimize recipes for performance and reliability
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for all integrations; proactively identify and resolve integration failures, performance issues, and data quality problems

**Project Management & Product Ownership**

* Act as technical product owner for enterprise application initiatives; gather requirements from GTM stakeholders, translate business needs into technical specifications, and prioritize feature requests
* Create detailed technical documentation including integration architecture diagrams, data flow maps, API specifications, and user guides for enterprise applications
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination; develop test plans, manage UAT execution with business users, track defects, and ensure successful production deployment
* Build product roadmaps for enterprise applications in collaboration with stakeholders; balance technical debt, new feature requests, and operational maintenance needs

**Salesforce Administration & Configuration**

* Create Salesforce product roadmap to support enterprise application integrations, including custom objects, fields, validation rules, process builders, flows, and permission sets
* Manage complex Salesforce data models spanning multiple custom objects and relationships; ensure data integrity and optimize for reporting and integration performance
* Create and maintain Salesforce reports, dashboards, and list views to provide visibility into enterprise application data and integration health for stakeholders
* Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators to ensure alignment on data governance, security model, and platform best practices across all enterprise integrations

**Data Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Establish and enforce data governance standards for enterprise applications including data dictionaries, field definitions, validation rules, and master data management policies
* Own data quality for all enterprise application integrations; implement automated data validation, cleansing routines, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Skills**

* 4-6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Salesforce administration, or technical product management roles with heavy integration/systems focus
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems using iPaaS platforms (Workato strongly preferred; Zapier, MuleSoft, or similar also acceptable)
* Deep Salesforce knowledge including data model, security model, automation tools (Flow, Process Builder), custom objects, and API capabilities; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred
* Strong understanding of API concepts including REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, authentication methods (OAuth 2.0, API keys), rate limiting, and error handling
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis and troubleshooting; experience querying databases and understanding relational data models
* Advanced Excel skills for data analysis, transformation, and mapping exercises (XLOOKUP, pivot tables, complex formulas)
* Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services environments with complex revenue operations and compliance requirements
* Understanding of revenue operations workflows including lead-to-opportunity, customer onboarding, and renewal processes

**Key Competencies**

* Systems thinker with ability to understand complex technical architectures and how systems interact across the enterprise technology stack
* Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Operations, and GTM teams to deliver shared outcomes
* Self-starter with strong ownership mentality; able to take ambiguous requirements and deliver complete solutions with minimal supervision
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills; able to diagnose integration failures, data issues, and performance problems methodically
* Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence decision-making at all levels
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality, security best practices, and technical documentation
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity; able to thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and requirements evolve
* Product mindset with focus on user experience, scalability, and long-term maintainability of technical solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workato certification or extensive hands-on experience building production-grade integrations in Workato
* Salesforce Admin Certification
* Experience with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran) and understanding of ELT/ETL patterns
* Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices for integration deployments
