title: Sr Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.
  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As
**Sr. Professional Services Manager**
(Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning complex enterprise implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.
  
  
This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.
  
  
This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead complex enterprise implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Mentor peers by sharing expertise, providing practical guidance, and supporting their growth in implementation leadership, customer engagement, and problem-solving.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need To Be Successful**

* 7+ years leading complex enterprise implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.

title: Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience
description:
**About IXOPAY**
IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.
  
  
From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.
  
  
At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.
  
  
What Makes an IXOPAYer?
  
  
We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience to lead the successful delivery of IXOPAY's largest and most strategic enterprise customer implementations.
  
  
In this highly collaborative role, you'll serve as the primary program leader across complex, multi-phase customer deployments, coordinating internal teams, customers, and external partners to ensure successful implementation and long-term customer success. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Customer Experience, and enterprise customers, you'll transform complex deployment strategies into structured execution plans that deliver predictable outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity to drive high-impact customer programs while helping define and continuously improve IXOPAY's enterprise implementation methodology.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead Enterprise Programs
  
  

* Own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise customer implementations, from discovery and solution planning through testing, migration, go-live, and production ramp-up.
* Develop and manage detailed program plans, timelines, milestones, and dependencies that enable successful project execution.
* Ensure implementation activities remain aligned with customer objectives, business priorities, and technical requirements.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Coordinate internal teams across Engineering, Product, Customer Experience, Solutions Engineering, and Support to ensure successful program delivery.
* Partner with customer stakeholders, including technical, operational, treasury, fraud, and business teams, as well as external payment providers and technology partners.
* Facilitate clear communication across all stakeholders, ensuring alignment throughout every stage of implementation.

Manage Risk and Delivery
  
  

* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, assumptions, and potential delivery challenges, driving mitigation plans before they impact project timelines.
* Provide governance for payment data and token migration activities while supporting secure, compliant implementation practices.
* Monitor program health through structured reporting, issue management, and executive-level status updates.

Improve Customer Experience
  
  

* Lead regular program reviews with internal leadership and enterprise customers, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, and next steps.
* Capture lessons learned and continuously improve implementation playbooks, onboarding processes, and delivery frameworks.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to share customer insights that improve future implementations and platform capabilities.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 7+ years of experience leading large-scale technical programs, enterprise software implementations, or complex customer delivery initiatives.
* Experience managing cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and external stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software delivery, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, and modern software development practices.
* Experience managing complex implementation projects with multiple workstreams, dependencies, and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive decisions in complex environments.
* Experience using project and program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.

**Preferred**

* Experience within FinTech, payments, or financial services.
* Knowledge of payment orchestration, payment gateways, acquiring, tokenization, PCI DSS, or 3D Secure (3DS).
* Experience working with enterprise customers through complex technical implementations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, Scrum, or similar certifications.
* Experience working within fast-growing SaaS or infrastructure software organizations.

Why Join IXOPAY?
  
  
At IXOPAY, you'll help deliver the enterprise payment infrastructure that powers global commerce. You'll work alongside experienced engineering, product, and customer teams to lead strategic implementations for some of the world's most sophisticated merchants. You'll solve complex delivery challenges, influence customer success, and play a key role in scaling IXOPAY's enterprise implementation capabilities.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Professional growth and leadership opportunities
* A collaborative, international team environment

US Benefits Include
  
  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Employer-paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* 401(k) Plan with Employer Match

Our Commitment to Inclusion
  
  
We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY. What Makes an IXOPAYer? We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
IXOPAY is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior AI Product Manager | Bankrate
description:
* This role is open to remote or hybrid candidates (East Coast preference), with hybrid being central to our New York, NY or Charlotte area offices. Must be able to work Eastern Standard Time hours.

For the Bankrate website click here. Curious how Bankrate fits into Red Ventures? Click here.
  
  
Bankrate is rebuilding itself with AI at the center. The AI Transformation Office decides what to build, ships it, and proves it changed the business. We're looking for a Senior AI Product Manager who is technical enough to build the prototype, not just spec it. You'll sit with our business teams in Human Resources, Marketing, and Commercial, find the highest-leverage problems, define the AI products that solve them, and often ship the first working version yourself. You report to the Head of AI Transformation. This is an individual-contributor role: a hybrid of technical builder and product leader, with no direct reports.
  
  
This is not a backlog-grooming, ticket-writing PM role. It's for someone who can open a notebook, wire up an API, and put a working prototype in front of a business team by the end of the week, then turn that prototype into a product people actually adopt. Slideware doesn't count. A roadmap nobody ships doesn't count. What counts is the product in production, the adoption behind it, and the business metric that moved.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the product end to end. Find the problem worth solving, define what to build and why, and drive it from prototype to production to adoption. You set the direction and you own the outcome, not the output.
* Prototype it yourself. You don't wait for an engineer to test an idea. You build the first working version, put it in front of real users, and learn fast. Working code beats a perfect spec.
* Translate business problems into AI products. Sit with HR, Marketing, and Commercial, learn how they actually operate, and turn messy problems into products with a clear thesis, a way to measure success, and a path to scale.
* Decide what not to build. Ruthless prioritization is the job. You kill low-value work, sequence the roadmap around leverage, and defend the focus when everyone wants everything.
* Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers. When a product outgrows a prototype, you hand engineering a sharp spec and a working reference, then stay close through production. You speak their language because you can build too.
* Measure what matters. Define the metric that proves the product changed the business, instrument it, and report against it. Usage is a leading indicator, not the goal.
* Move at the speed of the tools. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), AI APIs, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), prototyping platforms (v0, Lovable, Replit), and automation layers (Zapier, n8n) are how you get from idea to working software in days. You keep up as they change

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5 to 10 years of work experience, with real technical depth. You've shipped products and you can build them yourself. A background in data science or engineering is exactly what we're after, but the idea of owning a product end-to-end excites you.
* You can actually build. You're comfortable in a notebook, with APIs, and with modern AI tooling. You've shipped working prototypes with your own hands, not just directed others to.
* AI-native to the core. You build with agents, models, and APIs as a default, and you have a real point of view on what these systems can and can't do.
* Product judgment. You know the difference between a feature and a product, and between motion and progress. You prioritize hard and defend the call.
* Outcome obsessed. You care about the business metric that moved, not the roadmap you shipped. You measure it and you own the number.
* A translator. You sit between non-technical business teams and technical builders and make both better. You bring clarity where there's ambiguity.

**Compensation**
Total Cash Compensation Range: $155,000 – $220,000 per year
  
  
*This role is also eligible for Equity, which is offered separately from the total cash compensation listed above. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.*
*Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.*
Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.
  
  

* Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
* Life Insurance
* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Holiday Pay
* 401(k) with match
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): We believe time to rest and recharge is essential. That’s why we offer a generous and flexible PTO policy. Full-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO for a full calendar year annually, with an increase to 25 days after five years of service.

**Who We Are**
Bankrate is where Americans go to get the best price on life's most important financial decisions. By combining proprietary data, advanced technology, and deep market coverage, Bankrate helps consumers compare options and make confident financial choices across mortgages, credit cards, savings, and more. As a rate provider to the Federal Reserve and the benchmark relied upon by major publishers and policymakers nationwide, Bankrate's rate data is the national standard. This commitment to precision is reflected across all its products. In mortgages, proprietary auction technology puts lenders in real-time competition on price alone, consistently delivering rates in the lowest 10% in the country. For deposits, the platform features exclusively top-tier rates in the top 10% nationally, while its credit card coverage encompasses more than 90% of the market by volume. Founded by a journalist, Bankrate remains dedicated to its founding mission of transparency, honest information, and real competition — helping to make the American dream more affordable for everyone.

title: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization
description:
**Who We Are**
Chomps is America's fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.
  
  
**Traits of a Chompian**
If you've been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You're a team player who's self-motivated and action-oriented. You're committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You're a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you'll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You're hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.
  
  

* Accepting applications through 10/4/2026 5pm CST

**What You Will Do**
We seek a highly strategic, deeply organized Senior Project Manager to lead our complex, cross‑category innovation and commercialization initiatives. The ideal candidate brings advanced project leadership experience who does not only monitor progress and manage timelines, budgets, and risks, but also shaping project strategy, driving cross‑functional alignment, and anticipating challenges before they surface. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee and influence multiple high‑impact projects through the Stage‑Gate process, ensuring disciplined execution, stakeholder confidence, and consistent on‑time delivery across a fast‑moving innovation pipeline.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Strategic Project Leadership
  
  

* Lead and influence cross‑functional teams through complex, innovation projects, overseeing multiple high‑move initiatives simultaneously while driving alignment, strategic prioritization, and timely decision‑making to ensure disciplined execution.
* Build strategic project frameworks, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify risks and bottlenecks before they impact timelines.
* Drive accountability across teams and elevate issues to leadership when needed to protect launch timing and quality.

Project Management Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and influence high‑level, cross‑functional project meetings, driving clarity on updates, risks, decisions, and timelines while ensuring alignment across diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
* Design, refine, and lead the complex project timelines (Monday.com), driving strategic prioritization, anticipating timeline risks, and enabling cross‑functional teams to execute with clarity and precision.
* Oversee end‑to‑end project performance, using advanced documentation, risk modeling, and mitigation strategies to anticipate issues before they impact delivery.
* Drive accountability at all levels, ensuring cross‑functional partners meet commitments and escalating barriers early to protect launch timing and quality.
* Orchestrate cross‑functional collaboration, aligning teams around clear objectives, decision pathways, and commercialization requirements for high moving innovation projects.
* Manage project scope, budgets, and resources effectively to ensure successful on- time project delivery
* Coach, mentor, and elevate project managers and commercialization team members, strengthening Stage‑Gate discipline, operational rigor, and project management excellence across the organization.

Stage-Gate Process:
  
  

* Support projects through the stage gate process, assisting in ensuring adherence to defined gates and deliverables at each stage.
* Partner with the Innovation Director in preparing for gate reviews, including gathering necessary documentation, helping with presentations, taking detailed notes and supporting the documentation of the approvals.
* Collaborate with the Innovation Director to make sure the key stakeholders are aligned and facilitate decision-making at each gate.
* Provide training on stage gate and commercialization to new team members
* Implement robust post launch evaluations to capture learnings and drive continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  
  

* Facilitate collaboration across product development, marketing, manufacturing, planning, inventory, fulfillment, BAT, sales, and finance.
* Promote clear communication and teamwork to manage interdependencies and address conflicts.
* Serve as the senior liaison between project teams and leadership, providing clear, concise updates on risks, opportunities, and strategic decisions.

Resource Management:
  
  

* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to secure the right resources at the right time for complex innovation projects.
* Prioritize work across teams to optimize efficiency and ensure critical path tasks stay on track

Continuous Improvement:
  
  

* Analyze project data to identify trends, productivity opportunities, and systemic improvements and apply key learnings to drive actionable insights that enhance productivity savings.
* Champion a culture of learning, cross training, and process optimization.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen commercialization discipline across the organization.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
* 5-8 years experience as a Project Manager, preferably in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross functional projects with high ambiguity and high visibility.
* Expert in project management methodologies, risk mitigation, and strategic prioritization.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in using project management software and collaboration tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment by building relationships , driving alignment , fostering collaboration and driving results with diverse teams
* People manager experience preferred
* PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.

description:
**The Team**
ConvergeCONSUMER ™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world's largest professional services firm.
  
  
We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today's data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER's suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte's next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Product Strategy & Assortment Leadership, ConvergeCONSUMER**
Are you an experienced Product Manager who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.
  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As the Merchandising and Assortment Product Manager within Deloitte Consulting's ConvergeCONSUMER™ team, you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of cutting-edge, data-driven products that empower consumer-focused businesses to optimize merchandising decisions and personalize customer experiences at scale. You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Assortment Optimization solutions, translating business needs and consumer insights into actionable product strategies, and working closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams to ensure timely delivery, market readiness, and ongoing product evolution. With a strong foundation in analytics and retail domain expertise, you will bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver high-impact solutions that meet real-world business challenges in a rapidly converging marketplace.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the strategy for the Assortment Optimization product.
* Collaborate with other Product Managers and engineering team members on product development activities and assist in tasks necessary to make a developed product market-ready.
* Work with designers and developers to ensure product features are delivered on time, meet quality standards, and align with the product vision.
* Engage with various stakeholders to scope high-level features or user stories to a level of detail needed for engineering team members to execute against (including requirements, mockups, prototypes, etc.).
* Play a key hands-on role in an agile software development lifecycle by writing user stories, grooming backlogs, and running sprint reviews/showcases.
* Develop product collateral such as presentations, sales tools, marketing materials, and product demonstrations.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on customer/decision-maker/end-user feedback and manage the success and evolution of products in the marketplace.
* Provide timely reporting of development activities, product launches/extensions, and ongoing sales, revenue, and profitability performance against defined business targets.
* Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to develop effective go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and sales enablement materials.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Strong technical background combined with solid business experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Highly self-motivated, energetic, and passionate, with a team-oriented working style.
* Proven ability to partner successfully with internal stakeholders across the organization and drive outcomes cross-functionally.
* Well-developed judgment and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to juggle many competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working in the merchandising domain and/or with merchants.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and optimization technologies.
* Familiarity with User Experience design principles and ability to collaborate effectively with design teams.
* Experience with agile software development methodology and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
* Experience with market and competitive analysis to identify product opportunities and inform decision-making.
* Experience building data science and analytics solutions, particularly in the merchandising space.
* Familiarity with optimization techniques.
* Experience working closely with an engineering organization to manage products through the entire product lifecycle.
* Solid retail or consumer products analytics experience and domain knowledge.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, or an equivalent field; an advanced degree is a plus, and equivalent work experience may substitute for the degree requirement.
* 7+ years of proven success in a fast-paced, retail or consumer products-related product management or management consulting role.
* Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

**Culture & Values**

We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

title: Product Manager, Thermal
description:
**JOB DETAILS:**

**Position:**
Product Manager, Thermal

**Status:**
Permanent; Full-time

**Location:**
Remote, must live in the contiguous U.S. or Canada

**Closing Date:**
Open until filled

**ABOUT US:**

NGEN Mission Critical is a U.S.-based provider of critical power and cooling infrastructure, serving data centers, AI factories, and utility-scale power generation. We reduce lead times by pairing global manufacturing scalability with a fully integrated American engineering and service platform. In a market defined by equipment scarcity, extended procurement cycles, and heightened regulatory scrutiny, NGEN delivers deployment certainty through disciplined regulatory compliance, coordinated sourcing, and lifecycle accountability. From engineering validation through commissioning and ongoing operational support, NGEN ensures compliance, documentation integrity, and performance continuity in mission-critical environments.

Our team works hard while maintaining a collaborative, respectful, and supportive culture. We are looking for colleagues with a sense of humor, who consider themselves “builders,” and who are excited to make an impact in a future-focused and fast-paced environment.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

We're hiring a Product Manager for NGEN's Engineering and Product team. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our liquid cooling product lines and working directly alongside our cooling product lead as the line scales to meet AI and HPC data center demand.

If you have built your career around thermal products for data centers, understand how these products get specified and qualified, and are ready to go deep in an organization that is scaling fast in exactly this domain, we’d love to meet you!

**YOUR MISSION:**

* Own day-to-day execution for liquid cooling product lines, including RFQ development, documentation, and supplier analysis
* Manage OEM supplier relationships and technical evaluation, covering spec compliance, cost negotiation, and quality accountability
* Build and deliver RFQ packages and multi-option quote proposals for liquid cooling opportunities
* Support product roadmap development and evaluation of new products that expand NGEN's cooling offer
* Coordinate on NPI process execution and stage-gate progression for assigned cooling products
* Engage with engineering, supply chain, and compliance teams to keep products moving through development and certification
* Represent NGEN in OEM and occasional customer discussions during RFQ and spec alignment

**YOU'LL WIN US OVER WITH THIS KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:**

* A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in the relevant product domains
* You bring 3-8 years of experience in product management, product engineering, applications engineering, or OEM/supplier management
* Direct experience with liquid cooling systems for data centers - you can read specs and engage engineering SMEs without needing an introduction to the product
* Hardware/physical product NPI experience - long lead times, physical validation, and certification cycles are familiar territory
* Supplier and OEM management experience for cooling systems

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* You know liquid cooling products well enough that you can own the work without needing to be taught what you are looking at
* You are comfortable doing the hands-on execution work
* You are self-directed and can set your own pace while staying aligned with the team
* You are curious about how AI and HPC infrastructure is reshaping liquid cooling requirements and want to be close to that shift as it happens

**COMPENSATION PACKAGE:**

• U.S. base salary: Level 3 Product Manager $135,000 - $165,000 USD or Level 2 Product Manager: $120,000 - $155,000

• The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills

• Annual bonus of up to 25% of your base salary, based on performance

• 401k or RRSP match of up to 5% of your base salary

• Access to health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents

• Three weeks of paid vacation

• Five paid personal days

• Home office set-up support

• Remote working environment with flexibility and autonomy

**INTERVIEW PROCESS & TIMELINES:**

We're so excited that you are interested in joining our team! Our interview process will look like this:

• 4-6 questions emailed to shortlisted candidates, confirming some basic information about you and why you're interested in this position (estimated time commitment 10-15 minutes).

• 30-minute virtual meeting with our recruitment team so that we can learn more about your career path so far, and you have a chance to ask us any questions that you have

• 1-hour meeting with our Hiring Manager and a member of the People & Culture team

• Reference checks and an employment offer extended

We will do our best to follow the timelines outlined, and we will let you know if timelines shift!

**HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI IN RECRUITMENT:**

We believe in real humans hiring real humans.

To keep things organized and thoughtful, NGEN uses AI-assisted tools for notetaking during interviews. That said, every conversation, evaluation, and hiring decision is made by real people on our team (including initial resume screening). The only automated (not AI-augmented, just automated) step in our process is at the initial screening question stage when you're first applying for the role.

We are so excited to meet you and hear about all the incredible experiences and expertise you have built throughout your career. It's very important to us that we hear about those experiences and pieces of expertise in your own words – we prefer messy and authentic to polished with no depth. We mention this because we know how tight the labor market is and why some candidates may feel compelled to use an AI companion tool to help them answer questions live in interviews. Please be aware that if we suspect that you are using a tool like this, we will stop the interview and remove your application from consideration.

We do believe in using AI to support our everyday work in areas that we've identified as low value or low energy – we routinely use tools like Claude, Zapier, Fireflies.ai and Grammarly. Bringing on a new teammate is very important to us, so this effort falls into neither of those categories of “low value” or “low energy”.

We will show up for you in this recruitment process! In turn, please show up (as you!) for us. We can't wait to meet you!

**HOW TO APPLY:**

If this role sounds like it's right up your alley, but you're worried about missing a few of the qualifications, please reach out with your interest anyway. We value the unique skill sets, experiences, and pathways that people take in their careers, and are aware that non-traditional routes are sometimes overlooked. We make hiring decisions based on skill, and we're excited to hear what you will bring to our team!

• This is a permanent, full-time position and a fully remote role with some travel required

• We are not in a position to sponsor visa applications of any kind. As a result, only candidates who are currently legally entitled to work in the USA or Canada will be considered for this role

• This position will typically work Monday to Friday within the normal business hours of the region in which the successful candidate lives. As a member of a globally remote team, some meetings outside of normal business hours will be required for this role

Please submit a resume and online portfolio to careers@ngen-mc.com with the subject
**‘Product Manager, Thermal**
. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Senior Product Development Manager, NPI Strategy
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.
  
  
What You Can Expect
  
  
Paragon 28 (Zimmer Biomet) is hiring a Senior Product Development Manager, NPI strategy.
  
  
The Senior Product Development Manager, NPI Strategy leads the opportunity assessment, clinical research, and product-definition work needed to select and define new foot and ankle product development programs. The role identifies unmet clinical needs, evaluates development opportunities, builds investment cases, and converts surgeon and user evidence into documented inputs for design-control and phase-gate decisions.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor within Product Development and reports to the Director of Engineering. Its accountability spans opportunity identification through design transfer and product release readiness. The role does not own product promotion, campaign execution, field sales enablement, sales quotas, or ongoing revenue and unit-volume performance; those responsibilities remain with downstream commercial functions.
  
  
How You'll Create Impact
  
  
NPI Opportunity and Portfolio Planning
  
  

* Product Roadmaps: Build and update multigenerational roadmaps based on clinical gaps, technology shifts, and company priorities.
* Opportunity Evaluation: Assess projects using clinical metrics, procedure volumes, workflows, regulatory pathways, patents, and development costs.
* Prioritization: Recommend development pathways, including internal builds, partnerships, acquisitions, licensing, or cancellation.
* Domain Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of relevant anatomy, surgical procedures, devices, and emerging competitive tech.

Clinical Research and Development Inputs
  
  

* User Research: Lead primary and secondary research via surgeon interviews, clinical observations, surveys, and literature reviews.
* Evidence Translation: Turn research into clear problem statements, user needs, target profiles, and requirements with engineering and quality teams.
* Concept Validation: Drive prototype testing, cadaveric labs, and usability trials to validate assumptions before heavy investment.
* Traceability: Maintain detailed evidence packages linking source research directly to design decisions.

Investment Case and Governance
  
  

* Financial Models: Create business cases detailing market opportunity, development costs, unit economics, risks, and ROI.
* Phase-Gate Reviews: Update project assumptions to recommend funding approvals, program accelerations, pivots, or cancellations.
* Strategic Diligence: Assess external technologies and partners for potential acquisitions or strategic alliances.

Cross-Functional Core Team Leadership
  
  

* Strategy Ownership: Act as the NPI lead on core teams, owning the business case, user needs, and phase-gate deliverables.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with engineering, regulatory, quality, and finance to guide design reviews and risk management.
* Executive Influence: Present complex clinical and financial data to leadership to drive consensus without direct authority.
* Mentorship: Coach associate managers and improve organizational NPI research templates and governance processes.

Release Handoff and Lifecycle Learning
  
  

* Commercial Handoff: Provide downstream marketing and sales teams with product definitions, clinical rationale, and adoption risks.
* Advisory Continuity: Maintain relationships with surgeon advisors through product launch without managing promotional campaigns.
* Feedback Loop: Capture post-release data to update future product requirements and next-generation roadmaps.

Compliance
  
  

* Regulatory Adherence: Execute all duties in compliance with company policies, Quality Management Systems, and healthcare laws.

Your Background
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or another related technical discipline.
* Five or more years of experience defining or developing products in orthopedic medical devices or a closely related regulated-device field.
* Demonstrated success leading clinical or user research, opportunity assessment, product definition, and investment-case development for new products.
* Experience working on cross-functional medical-device development teams and working knowledge of design controls, user needs, design inputs, risk management, usability engineering, phase-gate governance, and design reviews.
* Strong clinical and technical aptitude with the ability to understand surgical procedures, anatomy, instrumentation, implants, and customer workflows.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including opportunity modeling, forecasting, investment-case development, and proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Ability to manage multiple complex development programs with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to obtain and maintain hospital credentialing and a valid driver's license with a driving record acceptable under company policy.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in engineering, biomedical innovation, or business.
* Direct foot and ankle or extremities experience and established relationships with orthopedic surgeons or key opinion leaders.
* Experience with global product development, human-factors research, reimbursement or health economics, and external technology evaluation.

Work Environment

Job Description: Senior Program Manager – Global Information Security

Position Overview

Avancé Consulting Group is seeking an adaptable, high-impact Senior Program Manager to embed directly with Global Information Security (GIS) leadership at a premier global investment management organization.

This role serves as a strategic execution thought partner and delivery lead to a senior pillar head within the Information Security portfolio, bridging high-level security strategies with tactical execution across Global Technology and enterprise business units. Rather than managing a strictly predefined, static scope, you will operate with significant autonomy, partnering 1-on-1 with security domain leaders to unpack complex mandates, establish program structures, prioritize critical initiatives, and drive execution across distributed enterprise teams.

Four positions are currently open across four distinct Information Security functional pillars. Candidates will be aligned to one of these specific domains based on relevant technical background and delivery strengths.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Role Details

• Engagement Type: Contract (12-Month Engagement with high likelihood to extend)

• Target Start Date: October 15, 2026 (Immediate hiring cadence)

• Work Arrangement: Remote (East Coast / Eastern Time alignment preferred; Charlotte, NC hub)

• Operating Model: Embedded within Global Information Security (GIS) leadership under the governance and delivery frameworks of the central Enterprise Change Office (ECO).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Core Responsibilities

• Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the dedicated delivery partner to a Security Pillar Lead, translating high-level imperatives, audit remediation goals, and emerging security demands (including AI-driven governance and operational resilience) into structured, actionable program roadmaps.

• Program Delivery & Execution: Establish milestones, drive accountability, track complex cross-functional interdependencies, and manage risks across multi-disciplinary global technology teams without requiring rigid top-down project parameters.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate seamless alignment between Information Security pillar leads, application engineering teams, enterprise architecture, infrastructure operations, and central change management governance.

• Scope Definition & Governance: Dissect broad, ambiguous technical mandates into discrete workstreams, project plans, and measurable operational outcomes.

• Executive Visibility & Reporting: Deliver clear visibility into portfolio delivery status, resource bottlenecks, critical path milestones, and key security deliverables for executive leadership.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Target Pillars & Functional Scope

Candidates will be deployed into one of the following four Information Security pillars:

1. Cybersecurity Incident Management

• Domain Focus: Cyber incident preparedness, response orchestration, crisis escalation paths, and post-incident remediation.

• Core Initiatives:

o Modernize enterprise incident response playbooks and cross-functional crisis communication workflows.

o Mature tabletop exercises and cyber simulation drills across global technology and executive leadership.

o Lead post-mortem tracking, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous control validation workstreams.

• Specialized Acumen: Working familiarity with CSIRT/SOC operating cadences, threat escalation frameworks, and NIST Incident Handling standards (NIST SP 800-61); ability to coordinate cross-functional teams (Legal, Compliance, Communications, SecOps) under time-sensitive conditions.

2. Application Security (AppSec)

• Domain Focus: Embedding proactive security governance directly into the modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) across global engineering teams.

• Core Initiatives:

o Scale developer security enablement, threat modeling workflows, and secure coding standards across product teams.

o Operationalize centralized penetration testing scheduling, vulnerability prioritization, and third-party vendor testing engagements.

o Drive the rollout and engineering adoption of SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security scanning tooling across enterprise CI/CD pipelines.

• Specialized Acumen: Deep familiarity with DevSecOps practices, secure SDLC integration, and application vulnerability remediation cadences across distributed software engineering groups.

3. Identity & Access Security (IAM / Governance)

• Domain Focus: Enterprise identity governance, privileged access management (PAM), and machine/non-human identity controls.

• Core Initiatives:

o Lead program execution around non-human identity lifecycle management (service accounts, API keys, tokens, certificate management).

o Rationalize and execute role-based access control (RBAC) cleanups, least-privilege enforcement, and privileged access workflows.

o Modernize identity governance and administration (IGA) integration across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments.

• Specialized Acumen: Working knowledge of modern IAM architectures (e.g., SailPoint, CyberArk, Okta, Active Directory/Entra ID) and access compliance audits in financial institutions.

4. Security Tooling & Infrastructure Modernization

• Domain Focus: Delivery governance across internal and vendor-provided security tools protecting enterprise infrastructure, endpoints, and cloud environments.

• Core Initiatives:

o Plan and coordinate enterprise-wide security tooling migrations, upgrades, agent rollouts, and rationalizations.

o Track vendor integration milestones, proof-of-concept (POC) evaluations, and enterprise deployment across thousands of endpoints and server instances.

o Partner with enterprise infrastructure and cloud engineering to ensure monitoring coverage and tool telemetry integration with SIEM/data lakes.

• Specialized Acumen: Technical breadth across endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), network security tooling, vulnerability scanners, and telemetry pipelines; strong vendor delivery management.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Qualifications & Key Competencies

• Enterprise Program Management: 7+ years of experience leading complex, large-scale technology programs or portfolios.

• Information Security Acumen: Demonstrated experience supporting cybersecurity, InfoSec, or technology risk domains aligned with at least one of the four core pillars above.

• Consultative Problem Solver: Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments; operates effectively as a hands-on strategic partner rather than a rigid checklist-driven coordinator.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills, capable of influencing senior technical leaders, engineering directors, and cross-functional business partners.

• Delivery Frameworks: Deep experience with Agile, hybrid delivery frameworks, and Enterprise Change Office / PMO standards.\

• Financial Services & Investment Management (Nice to Have):

o Prior background within Financial Services, with a strong preference for Investment Management (buy-side / asset management) or wealth management environments.

o Familiarity with the operational, audit, compliance, and regulatory landscapes typical of global financial institutions.

* Manuel Ramirez - Founder

title: Project Manager (Data Centers)
description:
**Job Description**
**This Opportunity**
WSP is currently initiating a search for a
**Project Manager (Data Centers)**
to join us in
**Houston, TX.**
The following locations will also be considered:
**San Diego, CA, New York, NY, Houston, TX, Portland, OR and Seattle, WA**
. This position can be offered remotely.
  
  
As demand for AI, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure accelerates, our clients are developing some of the world's largest, most complex, and most power-intensive facilities. In this role, you will help deliver the electrical infrastructure that enables next-generation data center campuses—projects requiring hundreds of megawatts of power and unprecedented levels of planning, engineering, and coordination. You will work across the full project lifecycle, playing a key role in delivering critical infrastructure for some of the industry's most prominent clients.
  
  
What makes this opportunity unique is the breadth of collaboration across WSP's global organization. You will work alongside top experts in their field to solve highly complex infrastructure challenges. This multidisciplinary environment provides exposure to the full range of technical and strategic considerations required to successfully develop large-scale data center campuses. You will contribute to the planning and design of substations, transmission interconnections, and site electrical infrastructure while supporting fast-paced projects that demand innovation, technical excellence, and strong collaboration.
  
  
If you're energized by large-scale infrastructure projects, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while accelerating your career on some of the most significant power delivery projects being developed today.
  
  
Provides technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of critical high-voltage infrastructure for data center projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. Tasks include responsibility for overall performance of distribution system and grid modernization projects of moderate size/complexity and/or local/regional scope. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.
  
  
Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Lead and oversee cross-functional teams delivering power distribution and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
* Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and distribution projects.
* Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
* Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
* Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power & energy market.
* Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for power delivery projects.
* Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
* Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
* Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in all aspects of distribution design.
* Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
* Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
* Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
* Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
* Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future projects.
* Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience managing projects in power distribution, transmission & distribution (T&D), or utility engineering environments.
* Proven experience delivering feeder, distribution line, or grid modernization projects.
* Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
* Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
* Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in complex utility environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
* Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
* Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Master’s Degree in Engineering.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* PMI Certification (PMP or CAPM).

**WSP Benefits**
WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
  
  
**Compensation**
Expected Salary (all locations): $102,200 - $182,200

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.
  
  
**About WSP**
**ABOUT US**
WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.
  
  
www.wsp.com
  
  
WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.
  
  
At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?
  
  
WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.
  
  
The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Principal Product Manager, Augmented Memory Grid (AMG)
description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning.
**NeuralMesh by WEKA**
sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud- and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.
  
  
WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
  
  
**About The Role**
WEKA is looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and go-to-market for Augmented Memory Grid (AMG), part of the NeuralMesh platform. This is a deeply technical PM role sitting at the intersection of AI inference infrastructure, high-performance networking, and enterprise storage. You will work directly with engineering, GPU/inference partners (NVIDIA, hyperscalers, GPU clouds), and enterprise customers running large-scale LLM inference to define what AMG needs to do next.
  
  
**Bring Your Expertise – and Your Passion**

* Leadership Skills: Strong leadership skills with a history of successfully leading cross-functional teams. Product Managers are expected to inspire and motivate team members to achieve ambitious goals while maintaining a collaborative and positive working environment. You understand how to influence without authority, and your recall of meaningful details supports verbal and written agility.
* Strategic Vision: You are a strategic thinker who can develop and execute product strategies that align with market trends and customer needs, as well as think critically about existing strategies. You have a proven ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and deliver results.
* Communication Skills: You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable presenting product strategies and roadmaps to internal teams and external customers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the AMG product roadmap: KV-cache/prefix-cache offload, memory tiering, and integration with inference engines and orchestration layers (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Kubernetes-based serving).
* Partner with engineering to define architecture trade-offs across GPU memory, networking (RDMA, GPUDirect, NVMe-oF), and distributed storage — translating inference performance bottlenecks (time-to-first-token, throughput, context length) into product requirements.
* Work directly with enterprise customers and GPU cloud partners: Nebius, CoreWeave, TogetherAI, etc., running production inference workloads to gather requirements, validate benchmarks, and prioritize features that reduce cost-per-token and improve SLAs at scale.
* Partner with NVIDIA and other silicon/inference-stack partners on joint roadmap and certification work.
* Define and track benchmarks (TTFT, throughput, cache hit rate) that demonstrate AMG's value versus standard GPU-memory-only inference.
* Support sales and field teams with technical positioning, competitive differentiation, and enterprise deal support.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Inference ecosystem depth: hands-on product or engineering experience with LLM inference serving — vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM/NIM, Ray Serve, or comparable — and fluency in concepts like KV-cache, prefix/context caching, quantization, and batching strategies.
* Model & systems familiarity: working knowledge of how modern LLMs are served in production (context windows, multi-tenant serving, GPU scheduling) well enough to translate model-level constraints into infrastructure requirements.
* Networking/infrastructure fluency: comfort with the fundamentals of high-performance networking and distributed systems — RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, NVMe-oF, or equivalent — and how they affect inference performance.
* Enterprise customer experience: track record working directly with large enterprise accounts — requirements gathering, production deployments, SLAs — not solely self-serve/PLG products.
* 10+ years of product management experience, ideally with some portion in infrastructure, ML platforms, or developer-facing technical products.

**Nice-to-have**

* Prior experience at a GPU cloud, inference platform, or AI infrastructure startup.
* Familiarity with storage systems (parallel/distributed file systems, object storage) in AI/ML pipelines.
* Experience partnering directly with NVIDIA or other accelerator/silicon vendors.

**The WEKA Way**

* We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility & ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
* We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
* We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
* We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned that you don’t meet every qualification above?
  
  
*Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified. At WEKA, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned that your past work experience doesn’t match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.*
*WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and optimization of Dandy’s practice-facing software as we expand internationally. In this role, you will own key software tools and workflows that empower dental practices to run their operations smoothly—including how they manage their account and interact with Dandy’s core services.
  
  
You will partner with engineering, design, finance, operations, sales, and customer service to build intuitive, scalable, and compliant software that delights practice owners and their teams. This is a high-impact role where you will balance exceptional user experience with operational excellence to support both our customers' success and Dandy’s business expansion globally.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own the Practice Software Vision & Roadmap – Define and execute a multi-year strategy for Dandy’s practice-facing tools, ensuring reliability, scalability, and seamless user experiences across daily operations.
* Deliver Seamless Practice Experiences – Build intuitive, transparent, and user-friendly software that simplifies complex tasks, earns customer trust, and reduces friction for practice staff.
* Collaborate Across Functions – Partner with engineering, product design, finance, legal, sales, and customer operations to align on product priorities, requirements, and execution.
* Ensure Accuracy & Compliance – Work with finance and legal to ensure financial and practice-facing systems meet tax, healthcare, regulatory, and audit standards across geographies.
* Optimize for Growth – Support flexible practice workflows, new revenue models, flexible payment options, and feature expansions into new markets.
* Modernize Our Infrastructure – Evaluate and implement integrations with payment processors, practice management systems (PMS), tax engines, and external service providers.
* Leverage Data to Improve Systems – Track user engagement, product performance, and financial metrics to identify trends, eliminate friction, and drive strong business and customer outcomes.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 4+ years of product management experience, ideally building B2B SaaS or practice-facing software.
* Technical fluency—you can work closely with engineering on system architecture, APIs, data flows, and third-party integrations.
* Customer obsession—you deeply understand the daily lives of practice owners and office staff, advocate for their success, and design products that make their work easier.
* Cross-functional leadership—proven ability to manage complex stakeholder needs across business, technical, and operational teams.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with performance metrics and operational data to diagnose problems and drive product decisions.
* High bias for action—you move quickly, navigate ambiguity, remove blockers, and deliver measurable value.
* Excellent communication skills, with a talent for translating complex user needs and technical requirements into clear, actionable product specs.

Bonus Points For
  
  

* Experience building software in b2b, healthcare, dental, or practice management domains.
* Familiarity with payment gateways, ERP systems, billing platforms, or regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Experience building software to enable global expansion.

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.
  
  
Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
