title: Product Manager- Low Voltage & Power Distribution Solutions
description:
**Mission Critical Group (MCG**
) is an end-to-end power solutions and services provider that accelerates time-to-power and delivers scalable, resilient infrastructure for mission critical environments. By integrating engineering, manufacturing, modular deployment, and lifecycle services under one platform, we streamline execution and bring complex projects online faster - without compromising performance. With more than 1.5 million square feet of U.S. manufacturing capacity, MCG supports data centers, power generation, healthcare, oil & gas, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and industrial facilities where uptime is non-negotiable. Mission Critical Group designs, manufactures and provides value-added services for customers requiring critical power solutions. Powering a new electric world for a brighter, more secure future.
  
  
**Job Description**
We’re seeking a Product Manager to drive strategy, standardization, and growth for our portfolio of
**Low Voltage (LV) switchgear and power distribution solutions**
, with a particular emphasis on
**UL891 switchboards, UL1558 metal-enclosed low-voltage power circuit breaker switchgear, and data center power infrastructure**
.
  
  
Reporting directly to the VP of Innovation, this role will own the product lifecycle for LV switchgear solutions—from market analysis and customer requirements through product definition, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. This position sits at the intersection of engineering, customer needs, manufacturing, and business strategy, transforming technical requirements into scalable, standardized products that drive growth and competitive differentiation.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep technical understanding of
**LV power distribution systems, OEM breaker platforms, regulatory standards, and end-market requirements**
with strong product management discipline. You will help define the next generation of standardized switchgear products serving critical infrastructure markets including
**AI factories, hyperscale data centers, oil & gas, industrial, healthcare, utility, and commercial applications**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy for UL891 and UL1558 switchgear platforms, power distribution systems, and associated control architectures
* Own the complete product lifecycle—from concept through commercialization, sustaining engineering, and retirement
* Conduct market analysis to identify growth opportunities across data centers, AI infrastructure, utilities, industrial, and other critical power markets
* Translate market trends and customer requirements into product strategies and roadmaps
* Develop business cases supporting new product introductions and portfolio investments
* Ensure alignment between product strategy, manufacturing capability, and financial objectives

**Product Definition & Standardization**

* Define standardized product offerings, configurations, and architectures to improve scalability and reduce engineering complexity
* Develop Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and technical specifications based on customer and market needs
* Establish product standards governing ratings, configurations, accessories, and performance requirements
* Drive modularization and standardization strategies balancing flexibility with manufacturability
* Collaborate with Engineering to convert engineered-to-order solutions into repeatable product platforms
* Support design decisions considering manufacturability, cost optimization, reliability, and lead time reduction

**Voice of Customer & Market Engagement**

* Serve as the Voice of Customer (VOC) within the organization, translating customer feedback into actionable product improvements
* Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPCs, hyperscalers, and channel partners to understand emerging requirements
* Develop strong understanding of customer pain points in AI and data center power infrastructure
* Validate new concepts and product features with customers and market stakeholders
* Support strategic customer engagements and major opportunities requiring technical product expertise

**Technical Leadership & Industry Expertise**

* Maintain deep expertise in UL891, UL1558, NEC, UL, ANSI, IEEE, and related standards governing LV switchgear
* Develop and maintain intimate knowledge of OEM breaker technologies and switchgear ecosystems, including but not limited to:

+ Schneider Electric
+ Eaton
+ ABB
+ LS ELECTRIC
+ Other major circuit breaker and switchgear suppliers

* Understand strengths, limitations, competitive positioning, and application suitability of various OEM technologies
* Track evolving market trends impacting AI infrastructure, power density, electrification, and data center architectures

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Engineering to define specifications and prioritize development initiatives
* Work closely with Manufacturing and Operations to ensure products are scalable and production-ready
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies
* Coordinate with Finance to support pricing strategies and business case development
* Support supply chain and sourcing decisions influencing product competitiveness

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Monitor industry developments impacting switchgear, AI infrastructure, and critical power markets
* Identify opportunities to improve product management processes, portfolio governance, and standardization practices
* Contribute to development of templates, best practices, and product frameworks across the organization
* Drive continuous improvement through post-launch analysis and customer feedback

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**
**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in product management, engineering, technical sales, or related roles within switchgear, electrical distribution, or critical power infrastructure
* Strong technical knowledge of UL891 switchboards and UL1558 metal-enclosed low-voltage power circuit breaker switchgear
* Deep understanding of low voltage distribution systems and breaker technologies
* Experience defining standardized products and product requirements within technical environments
* Demonstrated experience translating customer requirements into product specifications and roadmaps
* Familiarity with OEM breaker ecosystems and competitive positioning across major suppliers
* Strong understanding of critical infrastructure markets, particularly data centers and AI-driven applications
* Excellent communication skills with ability to bridge technical and commercial stakeholders
* Willingness to travel (25–35%) for customer visits, manufacturing sites, and industry engagement

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hyperscale or colocation data center infrastructure
* Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline
* Experience launching and scaling technical products within power distribution markets
* Familiarity with MV switchgear, modular power systems, or integrated power solutions
* Experience supporting standardization initiatives within manufacturing environments
* Knowledge of pricing strategies, portfolio management, and product economics

**Technical Competencies**

* Product lifecycle management and roadmap development
* Product requirements definition (PRDs/MRDs)
* UL891 and UL1558 application expertise
* OEM breaker technologies and competitive analysis
* Switchgear architecture and power distribution systems
* Market analysis and portfolio strategy
* Technical documentation and specification writing
* Risk assessment and regulatory compliance

**Professional Competencies**

* Strong customer orientation and relationship building
* Strategic thinking with commercial awareness
* Ability to influence across engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong organizational and execution capabilities
* Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset
* Executive presence with customers and industry stakeholders

**Attributes**

* Have Humanity: Builds trust through respect, empathy, and collaboration while maintaining strong relationships with customers, manufacturing teams, and engineering partners.
* Be Transparent: Communicates openly regarding product decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and market realities to drive alignment and trust.
* Drive Innovation: Challenges conventional approaches and continuously seeks opportunities to improve products, architectures, and customer value.
* Be Resilient: Maintains momentum through ambiguity, changing requirements, and evolving market conditions.
* Always Reliable: Delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes while ensuring products meet performance, safety, and customer expectations.
* Grit: Demonstrates perseverance and ownership in solving difficult technical and commercial challenges from concept through launch.

**Why This Role Matters**
As a Product Manager focused on Low Voltage Switchgear, you’ll shape the products enabling the next generation of critical infrastructure. Growth in
**AI factories, hyperscale computing, and high-density electrical loads**
is driving new demands on power distribution systems.
  
  
Your work will directly influence our ability to standardize products, improve speed-to-market, increase competitiveness, and deliver differentiated solutions supporting mission-critical environments.
  
  
**Our Environment**
You’ll thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where innovation, customer focus, and technical excellence drive success. We value bold thinking and practical execution, giving you opportunities to shape products that define the future of power infrastructure.
  
  
You’ll work alongside engineering, manufacturing, commercial teams, and industry partners to build solutions that power the world’s most demanding applications.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**A Note to our Recruitment Partners:**
We really appreciate the interest, but MCG currently manages hiring through our internal team. We love getting to know our candidates directly! Because of this, we don’t accept unsolicited resumes from agencies at this time. If we ever need an extra hand, we’ll be sure to reach out to the community. Thanks for understanding!

title: AI Program Manager - Special Projects & Innovation
description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.
  
  
Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.
  
  
****Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.****
****Position Title:****
AI Program Manager — Special Projects and Innovation
  
  
****Position Location:****
Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings
  
  
**Job Summary**
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company-wide AI enablement program.
  
  
AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team-by-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands-on support.
  
  
This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering & Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub-and-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
****Program Governance, Policy & Intake (20%)****

* Establish light-touch, practical governance for AI use company-wide — acceptable-use standards, data-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
* Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
* Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

****AI Enablement, Training & Messaging (20%)****

* Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non-technical staff alike — through hands-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
* Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
* Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company-wide capability

****Solution Development & Deployment (20%)****

* Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM-powered tools, agents, and integrations
* Serve as a hands-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
* Harden and deploy high-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

****Development Frameworks & Hosting Platforms (15%)****

* Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
* Replace ad-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
* Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

****Tool & Use-Case Portfolio Management (15%)****

* Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
* Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
* Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build-vs-buy decisions

****Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency (10%)****

* Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization
* Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget
* Performs other related duties as assigned

****Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget****
**Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned**
**Position Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience building or maturing an AI enablement program or Center of Excellence at a similarly sized, fast-scaling company — taking it from ad-hoc adoption to governed, supported capability
* Power user of Claude (claude.ai, Claude Code, CoWork, Projects, connectors/MCP, and agentic tools) with fluency across the modern AI tool landscape (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Perplexity)
* Hands-on skill designing and shipping LLM-powered applications: prompt engineering, agent and workflow design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and API integration
* Application development and rapid prototyping using AI app builders and full-stack tools (e.g., Replit, Lovable) and scripting (Python)
* Development frameworks, hosting platforms, and DevOps: source control (Git), CI/CD, containerization, and cloud hosting (Microsoft Azure and others)
* Data fundamentals: relational, vector, and time-series data, knowledge bases, and data-pipeline concepts sufficient to ground AI tools in company data
* Workflow automation platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio)
* Working knowledge of AI governance and IT/OT security frameworks
* Program and change management: intake and prioritization, roadmapping, stakeholder management, and internal communications
* Ability to translate business needs into AI use cases and to teach both technical and non-technical audiences
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams); knowledge of file management
* Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness, and resourcefulness in a distraction-free workspace
* Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports, and correspondence
* Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information) and directly with stakeholders across all levels
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with limited supervision
* Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
* Ability to effectively plan, prioritize, and delegate work
* Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to follow company and site safety requirements

****PHYSICAL DEMANDS****
**Duties**
The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:
  
  

* Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and to operate a computer and other office equipment
* Frequently moving through office, lab, and critical-facility environments, including tight and confined spaces
* Occasionally descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment during site visits
* On occasion required to move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

****TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS****

* Up to 20%; this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
* Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position
* Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need
* Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, and attending industry conferences

**Education / Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience)

****PLUS****

* 5+ years in software / AI development, technical program management, or AI/ML enablement, including hands-on delivery of AI or LLM-powered solutions.
* 2+ years building, leading, or maturing an AI enablement program, Center of Excellence, or comparable initiative at a similarly sized organization

**Benefits**
**Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include**

* Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
* Dental and vision plans
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
* 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
* PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
* Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
* Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
* Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
* Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.
  
  
Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.
  
  
Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!
  
  
**Notice To Third Party Agencies**
STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

99,750 - 120,225 USD per year(Remote (United States))

title: Delivery/DevOps Agile Lead
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking a results-driven and technically proficient Agile Delivery Leader to oversee and optimize the performance of cross-functional engineering teams. This role is responsible for driving efficient, continuous software delivery through Agile methodologies, DevOps best practices, and disciplined SDLC execution. The ideal candidate will combine strong leadership skills with hands-on software development expertise to improve estimation accuracy, increase engineering productivity, and identify opportunities to reengineer team structures and processes to enhance delivery effectiveness and reduce operating costs. This individual will leverage data-driven insights to drive continuous improvement, communicate progress and outcomes through executive-level presentations and reports, and partner closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions that align with organizational objectives.
  
  
The Delivery / DevOps Agile Lead partners with departments list engineering, product, and business stakeholders to improve delivery flow, strengthen release execution, reduce non-value-add work, and support predictable delivery outcomes in cloud and DevOps environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Facilitates core Agile ceremonies (sprints, standups, retrospectives) while removing technical and organizational blockers
* Partners with DevOps and engineering leadership to streamline CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release cycles
* Tracks and improves team delivery metrics (velocity, lead time, deployment frequency, MTTR)
* Monitors and adjusts team structures, Agile practices, and delivery operating models when needed to reduce scrum-related cost, improve efficiency, and strengthen accountability
* Applies hands-on development and SDLC knowledge to review delivery estimates, identify coding-level inefficiencies, and help teams improve technical execution
* Partners with internal departments and stakeholders to align backlog priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery expectations
* Improves workflow transparency through effective use of Agile tools, reporting, dashboards, and team information radiators
* Leads continuous improvement efforts that reduce waste, improve cycle time, increase deployment reliability, and support predictable delivery outcomes
* Supports release planning, dependency management, delivery readiness, and incident learning activities across assigned teams
* Prepares PowerPoint presentations, status reports, delivery summaries, and leadership updates that clearly communicate progress, risks, decisions, metrics, and recommendations
* Promotes Agile, DevOps, and SDLC best practices while helping teams maintain a practical, outcome-focused approach to software delivery
* Uses approved AI tools appropriately to improve delivery planning, reporting, workflow analysis, and team efficiency while protecting confidential, proprietary, and regulated information

**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Advanced knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including Scrum, Kanban, sprint planning and execution, backlog refinement, estimation techniques, retrospectives, and continuous improvement methodologies
* Advanced knowledge of DevOps, cloud-based delivery environments, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release management, deployment practices, site reliability principles, and operational support processes
* Advanced proficiency in software development, coding practices, system design, and software engineering principles, with the ability to actively contribute to development efforts, review code, validate estimates, and resolve technical delivery challenges
* Expert knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements management, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, quality assurance, and technical delivery governance
* Strong ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional engineering, product, architecture, and DevOps teams to achieve delivery objectives, remove impediments, manage dependencies, and improve execution effectiveness
* Demonstrated ability to assess, redesign, and optimize team structures, Agile operating models, workflows, and delivery practices to increase productivity, improve quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce development and Scrum-related costs
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate delivery, engineering, and operational metrics, including velocity, throughput, lead time, deployment frequency, predictability, quality trends, and mean time to recovery (MTTR), and translate findings into actionable improvements
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and related Agile, DevOps, and reporting tools to support planning, execution, transparency, governance, and performance measurement
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to prepare executive-level PowerPoint presentations, dashboards, business cases, and delivery reports, and effectively influence technical and business leaders
* Working knowledge of AI-enabled technologies and their application within software engineering, Agile delivery, DevOps automation, estimation, reporting, and process improvement, including responsible use of AI, data protection requirements, validation of AI-assisted outputs, and alignment with organizational policies and governance standards

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Experience supporting Agile delivery in healthcare technology, regulated SaaS, or other compliance-oriented technology environments
* Experience improving CI/CD maturity, automated testing adoption, DevOps operating models, or release reliability
* Experience with scaled Agile, team-of-teams coordination, quarterly planning, PI planning, or multi-team dependency management
* Familiarity with cloud engineering, platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code, observability, incident response, or site reliability practices
* Experience using delivery analytics, dashboards, and executive reporting to support data-driven decisions

**Experience:**

* 5 or more years of experience leading Agile delivery, Scrum, delivery management, or technology execution within software engineering, DevOps, cloud, or SaaS environments
* 3 or more years of experience working with engineering teams using modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, release practices, automated testing, or DevOps delivery models
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing blockers, improving delivery metrics, and driving continuous improvement across one or more engineering teams
* Experience reviewing or challenging technical estimates, delivery assumptions, team capacity, or engineering execution plans
* Experience preparing leadership-facing reports, dashboards, presentations, or delivery updates

**Required Training, Certification and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Practical experience leading Agile delivery within DevOps/Cloud environments
* Expertise in Jira/Confluence

**Preferred Training, Certification and Education:**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or SAFe certification preferred
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMI-ACP, or comparable Agile certification
* Training or certification in DevOps, cloud platforms, software delivery, product delivery, or release management
* Advanced Agile, facilitation, coaching, or delivery leadership training

**Working Conditions:**

* Remote or home office environment
* Ability to sit and use workstation equipment for up to 8 hours daily
* Frequent video meetings, facilitation sessions, and cross-functional delivery discussions
* May require occasional work outside standard business hours to support release activities, delivery escalations, or incident learning
* May require occasional travel for planning sessions, team workshops, or leadership meetings

**Benefits Overview**
At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote,
**working from their home**
. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.
  
  
Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:
  
  
**Physical And Mental Health Benefits**

* Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
* Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits
* Generous PTO with buy/sell options
* 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness program - earn insurance discounts or credit towards health-related items

**Financial Health Benefits**

* 401K Plan with employer matching contributions
* Company-funded spending/reimbursement accounts to help with out-of-pocket medical expenses
* Bonus and Recognition programs
* Tuition Assistance
* Consultation with financial planner
* Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
* Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

**Other Benefits**

* E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other grounds, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability. Must have legal authority to work in the US.
  
  
**We will not accept applicants that use AI when answering the screening questions. Applicants who use AI to answer any questions or to complete their application will not be considered for employment.**

title: Group Technical Product Manager
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving.
**Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!**
As the
**Group Technical Product Manager for Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI/ML**
, you will lead a portfolio spanning
**Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI/ML**
— owning strategy and delivery across the full data value chain.
  
  
You will lead a small team of Technical Product Managers accountable for enterprise data platforms, ML models, generative AI applications, data pipelines, and business intelligence. This is a player-coach role: you will own cross-cutting technical strategy and escalation decisions, while also serving as a Technical Product Manager for one or more value streams. You’ll be responsible for staying close enough to delivery to resolve the hard calls when your team needs you.
  
  
You will sit at the intersection of product strategy, data platform leadership, and people management — partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and senior business stakeholders to ensure Hagerty's enterprise data and AI capabilities evolve faster than the market demands.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Portfolio Strategy & Vision**

* Own the strategy and roadmap across Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI/ML — enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, ML models, generative AI, and BI — ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Classify and sequence investment across feature work, adoption, platform scaling, and new-capability expansion to maximize portfolio ROI.
* Identify and prioritize cross-product dependencies, platform investment priorities, and build-vs-buy decisions across all three domains.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape long-term platform vision, balancing innovation with foundational reliability and data quality.
* Translate enterprise data strategy into actionable product priorities for your TPMs.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a small team of TPMs covering Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI/ML — fostering high performance and a strong ownership culture.
* Deliberately delegate high-visibility, high-complexity initiatives as stretch assignments; build systems, frameworks, and review cadences that enable TPMs to operate independently.
* Provide ongoing performance feedback, career development support, and clear expectations for product excellence.
* Model player-coach behavior: engaged enough in delivery to remove blockers, strategic enough to keep the team focused on what matters.
* Calibrate workload and capacity across your TPMs, ensuring each has a clear and manageable scope.

**Execution Oversight & Delivery**

* Ensure consistent, high-quality execution across enterprise data platform delivery, ML model productionization, AI feature rollout, and BI development.
* Guide teams in prioritization and tradeoff decisions across new capabilities, technical debt, scalability, and compliance obligations.
* Stay hands-on where it counts — joining critical ceremonies, unblocking decisions, and owning the hard prioritization calls that require Group-level authority.
* Hold TPM plans to Hagerty's product plan review standard: measured outcomes tied to enterprise levers, an economically prioritized flow with a named constraint, and a probabilistic delivery forecast.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Produce and maintain the portfolio-level roadmap architecture — mission, product/system, and technology layers — aggregating Enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI/ML domain roadmaps into one coherent view with figures of merit and technology-readiness levels per initiative.
* Apply evolution mapping across the enterprise data and AI stack to justify build, buy, and outsource decisions, and assign each initiative to a horizon with an explicit investment split so near-term delivery does not starve platform work.
* Stay current on AI/ML advances and the evolving regulatory landscape for AI in insurance.
* Ensure enterprise data products meet data governance, model risk management, and compliance requirements.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**About LawnStarter**
LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.
  
  
**About Product At LawnStarter**
Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service experience for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow. We've organized around those bets as swim lanes: New Customer Acquisition, Strengthen Supply, Service Experience, and AI & Operating Excellence.
  
  
**The Role**
This is the most senior individual contributor seat in Product, with no direct reports. You'll work as a peer to the leaders of Ops, Data, Design, and Engineering.
  
  
Senior Product Managers here each own a workstream inside one of four swim lanes. You drive the Service Experience product agenda end to end: everything after a customer books, for customers and Pros, and the AI increasingly behind it. Two jobs at once: a critical thought partner to leadership on how AI reshapes our service experience, and an operator who ships with peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops at a speed and quality that most would not believe. You're accountable for company-level numbers, not initiative-level ones.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Different**

* Thought partner, not order-taker. Leadership wants your view on where AI takes the service experience, and expects you to change their minds sometimes
* Speed and quality together. Small team, peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops who move fast, and few layers between your judgment and what ships
* Ultra AI-forward is the point. We want someone already operating the way most PMs will operate in five years
* Strategy and hands. You still prototype with LLMs, write eval sets, read transcripts, and re-architect live systems yourself

**Requirements**
**What You'll Own**

* The Service Experience swim lane's product strategy and roadmap: marketplace trust after booking, including setting the right expectations on both sides, steering Pros toward great work, and the increasingly AI-assisted policies that arbitrate conflicts
* AI-powered support for customers and Pros, including the eval systems that gate every change (golden datasets, automated judges, regression detection, human-review sampling)
* Two company-level numbers: Contribution LTV (profit per customer over their lifetime) and the brand-promise metrics
* The vision and proof of concept for how AI transforms the customer and Pro experience, not just support
* The bar for product: standards for shipping trustworthy AI, influencing Senior PMs by showing what great looks like, and being the person leadership calls for the hardest two-sided judgment calls

**Problems to Solve**
**Making AI support provably good, then letting it do a lot more.**
AI handles roughly a third of customer support conversations today. The goal for the next year: over half of all inquiries, customer and Pro, resolved with high satisfaction. Getting there is gated on one hard, ongoing, technical thing: proving the AI resolved a case rather than just closed it. That means defining "good" for an open-ended conversation, and catching quality drift before a customer or Pro feels it. You'll build Pro-side support on that foundation: unglamorous work that makes a slick demo safe to scale.
  
  
**Keeping the promise on both sides.**
Most service failures aren't bad work, they're mismatched expectations: the grass grew a tier past what was booked, or the customer wants a date the Pro can't commit to. Our promise is priced as quoted, done right, and keeping it means getting expectations right before the work starts and steering Pros toward great work. These aren't bad actors: both sides are right from where they sit, and the marketplace has to make a call. You'll build the policies and the increasingly AI-assisted systems that decide fairly and consistently at scale, and make the judgment call yourself when there's no clean answer.
  
  
**Making every customer more profitable.**
Trust isn't a soft metric here: customers who get what they were promised stay for years, and conflicts resolved fairly cost less to serve. You'll own Contribution LTV, targeting +10% year over year. The hard part is knowing which lever moves it (retention, cost to serve, fewer make-goods) and proving the attribution, not just asserting it.
  
  
**Deciding what AI does to the whole experience, not just support.**
AI already runs quietly in pricing, fraud detection, and routing. The next unlock is AI that customers and Pros notice. By year one, we want a working proof of concept and a leadership-endorsed vision for how AI transforms that experience. What's first? How do you know?
  
  
**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* 50%+ of support inquiries resolved by AI with high customer and Pro satisfaction, behind an eval suite blocking regressions, plus a first version of Pro-side AI support live
* Contribution LTV up 10% year over year, with attribution you can defend
* Brand-promise metric goals hit: priced as quoted, done right
* A working proof of concept and a leadership-endorsed vision for how AI transforms the customer and Pro experience
* Leadership treats you as the person who defines where the service experience goes, not just delivers it, and the team ships faster and better because you're in the room

**Who You Are**
**A track record of extraordinary outcomes.**
Not solid, exceptional: results with your fingerprints on the decision. A generically solid resume, or wins you can't explain, won't clear the bar.
  
  
**Obsessed with AI, to the point of building.**
You use AI daily, have built with LLMs, and reach for AI before asking a person when you need data or want to read code. You have real intuition for whether an AI experience is good, and a view on where it's headed. Unlikely to be a good fit if you treat LLM quality as a vibe check, or evals as engineering's problem.
  
  
**Obsessed with the customer and the Pro.**
You live in transcripts and Pro feedback to understand both sides, and hold their interests at once, with a rationale you'd defend to either, neither indecisive nor a hip-shooter. Skip this one if you think you already know what our customers and Pros need.
  
  
**Ruthlessly data-driven.**
You find root causes through data, and reach for the number before the opinion. What doesn't work: leading with your gut, or refusing to move until the data is perfect.
  
  
**Unbelievable speed, without dropping quality.**
You ship scrappy, compress timelines, and it still makes you proud. You dive into unglamorous details like labeling eval sets and rewriting policy, because that's what quality costs. This won't work if perfectionism keeps you from shipping, or your speed leaves a mess behind.
  
  
**A thought partner who multiplies the room.**
You change leadership's mind, raise the bar for PMs by doing the work, and influence peers who don't report to you. Unlikely to be a good fit if you wait for direction, or guard what you know.
  
  
**This Role Is NOT**

* A people-management role. You're an individual contributor with no direct reports. Influence comes from judgment and output, not a team you manage
* A support PM role. Support is one surface of a broader area covering trust and AI, not a ticket queue or a help center
* The internal-AI tooling role. A separate effort drives AI adoption in internal tooling. This role is about AI in the experience customers and Pros have
* A strategy-only seat. You'll write evals, read transcripts, and prototype with LLMs. If you'd rather just set direction, this will frustrate you
* A tactical delivery role. This one owns where the service experience goes, not the next feature in it. If you're strongest turning someone else's strategy into tickets, this isn't the fit

**Benefits**

* Base salary: $185,000 to $230,000
* Equity: We want our product managers to benefit from significant company growth, so equity is a meaningful part of how we structure PM compensation
* Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision
* Fully remote (US): Deep thinking time and partnership with peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops matter more than a desk
* Flexible PTO: We focus on results. Take what you need

*LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.*

title: Design Task Leader / Senior Project Manager - Desalination
description:
**Ardurra**
is looking to hire an experienced
**Design Task Leader / Senior Project Manager**
to support
**desalination projects in Texas**
! Ideally this position is based in Texas, or near one of our current office locations, but we are open to candidates based anywhere in the United States!
  
  
Ardurra is seeking a senior leader to help deliver major desalination and advanced water treatment projects, with a focus on large-scale work supporting Houston, Corpus Christi, and the broader Texas market. We have recently secured large-scale infrastructure projects, including one of the most significant water supply projects in the country.
  
  
This major seawater desalination project is a once-in-a-generation water supply program and is poised to be one of the largest desalination facilities in the United States, representing a significant advancement in Texas water infrastructure. This project will be studied, analyzed, and referenced for decades to come as an opportunity to help define how coastal cities solve water scarcity in the U.S.
  
  
This is a high-visibility leadership opportunity for a proven senior professional who can drive project execution, lead technical teams, build trusted client relationships, and help grow Ardurra’s desalination practice in Texas and nationally.
  
  
**Primary Function**
The Design Task Leader / Senior Project Manager leads the full lifecycle delivery of complex desalination and advanced treatment projects. Through design, construction, and commissioning, with full accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client outcomes.
  
  
This role requires deep experience in seawater or brackish desalination and oversight of key systems including pretreatment, reverse osmosis, post-treatment, and concentrate management, along with multidisciplinary coordination across design, permitting, and construction.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to deliver exceptional client outcomes on technically complex desalination projects while strengthening Ardurra’s technical leadership, client presence, and long-term growth in the desalination sector.
  
  
**Primary Duties**
*Project Leadership and Delivery*

* Lead planning, design, and execution of large desalination and advanced treatment projects, including seawater and brackish reverse osmosis facilities
* Direct multidisciplinary teams through all project phases, from conceptual development and basis-of-design through detailed design, procurement support, construction-phase services, startup, and commissioning
* Define project scope, work plans, staffing plans, schedules, budgets, deliverable milestones, and quality review checkpoints
* Manage project financial performance, including forecasting, change management, invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, and overall project profitability
* Apply strong project controls and risk-management practices to maintain performance against scope, schedule, and budget objectives

*Technical Leadership*

* Serve as a senior technical leader for desalination systems and advanced treatment processes, including pretreatment, membrane systems, reverse osmosis, energy recovery, chemical systems, post-treatment, and concentrate/brine management
* Oversee development and review of key technical deliverables such as basis-of-design memoranda, process flow diagrams, P&IDs, technical specifications, design criteria, equipment selection documentation, and lifecycle or alternative analyses
* Guide pilot testing, process evaluations, and technology selection efforts where required
* Ensure designs are practical, constructible, code-compliant, and aligned with client, regulatory, operational, and maintainability requirements
* Coordinate with internal and external subject matter experts across civil, mechanical, structural, electrical, instrumentation and controls, coastal/marine, geotechnical, and permitting disciplines

*Team Leadership*

* Build, lead, and mentor high-performing project teams
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and quality oversight to project managers, discipline leads, and design staff
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, quality, and client service excellence

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or related Engineering field
* 15–30+ years of experience in water infrastructure project delivery, with significant experience in desalination and/or advanced treatment
* Professional Engineer (PE) license required or ability to obtain reciprocity as needed
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multidisciplinary design projects for municipal, utility, or industrial clients
* Strong experience with one or more of the following: seawater reverse osmosis, brackish reverse osmosis, pretreatment systems, post-treatment/stabilization, concentrate/brine management, intake/outfall systems, pilot testing, and startup/commissioning
* Experience with alternative delivery, design-build, progressive design-build, or EPC-adjacent coordination is strongly preferred

**Compensation And Benefits**
The expected base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $225,000 annually. Actual pay is based on job‑related factors such as skills, experience, location, and internal equity. Additional compensation and benefits may apply.
  
  
**Why Ardurra?**
While Ardurra offers competitive compensation and rich benefits programs, it is our culture that truly sets us apart from our peers. We nurture a family-like culture, striving to create a work environment that is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding but also fun. We are acutely focused on developing our staff, whether through our internal Ardurra Academy or through our industry-leading Leadership program. We have made a deliberate and focused commitment to nurture a people-centric culture where people are: valued as individuals; supported in their professional and career development with multiple, varied career paths; provided the tools and resources to be successful, engaged, and satisfied in their work; and positive benefits, time-off programs, and flexibility to help maintain a healthy balance between work and home.
  
  
Ardurra is an Equal Opportunity/ Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.
  
  
*NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:*
Ardurra does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Agency Agreement, Ardurra will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. If a resume or candidate is submitted to any hiring manager without a previously signed agreement, Ardurra reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. These candidates will be considered property of Ardurra. We’re not currently looking to add any more agencies to our list of approved vendors, so please do not contact any of our managers or recruitment team with sales calls or details of your candidates.

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.
  
  
This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.
  
  
We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.
  
  
You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.
  
  
This is a fully remote role.
  
  
**What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like**

* Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.
* Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.
* Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.
* Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.
* Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.
* Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.
* Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.

**An Ideal Candidate Has**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.
* Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.
* AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.
* Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.
* Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.
* Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

**Bonus**

* Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.
* Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).
* Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.
* Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.

**Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us**

* Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Carrot Cash travel stipend.
* Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.
* Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
* Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
* Open communication with management and company leadership.
* Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
* 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees.
* Access to Disability & Life insurance.
* Health Reimbursement Account (HRA).
* DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan.

**More About Hopper**
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
  
  
The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
  
  
While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.
  
  
Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
  
  
**Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:**
Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  
  
Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
  
  
Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  
  
Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
  
  
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  
  
Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.
  
  
Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.
  
  
Come take off with us!

title: Product Owner (RangeOS)
description:
By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.
  
  
By Light is seeking an experienced Product Owner to lead the vision, roadmap, and execution of RangeOS—our next‑generation cyber range orchestration platform deployed across global training environments. This role operates with minimal supervision and requires close collaboration with engineering, cyber operations, program leadership, and multi‑vendor partners. The Product Owner will translate mission needs into actionable requirements, prioritize development, and ensure successful delivery of capabilities that support individual and collective cyber training.
  
  

* Define, maintain, and communicate the RangeOS product vision, roadmap, and release strategy.
* Translate operational, customer, and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable requirements and user stories.
* Prioritize the product backlog to maximize mission impact, technical feasibility, and delivery velocity.
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure alignment between requirements, design, and implementation.
* Coordinate with cyber range operators, exercise planners, and multi‑vendor partners to validate capabilities and workflows.
* Support deployment planning, release readiness, and integration across RCS, ECS, and cloud environments.
* Develop and maintain product documentation, feature briefs, and customer‑facing materials.
* Serve as the primary voice of the customer, ensuring RangeOS capabilities meet operational training objectives.

**Analysis and Design**

* Collaborate with engineering to shape solution designs that meet functional and non‑functional requirements.
* Assess technical tradeoffs, dependencies, and risks across the product lifecycle.
* Estimate effort and complexity for new features and enhancements.

**Backlog and Feature Management**

* Write clear, concise user stories with acceptance criteria.
* Groom and refine the backlog to ensure development teams have well‑defined, ready‑to‑execute work.
* Validate completed features against requirements and mission needs.
* Drive continuous improvement in product workflows, usability, and performance.

**Documentation**

* Internal Produce clear requirements, user stories, and release notes for engineering and program teams.
* Process Maintain product artifacts, roadmaps, and decision logs.
* External Develop customer‑facing guides, feature descriptions, and training materials.
* Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills across technical and non‑technical audiences.

**Testing & Validation**

* Participate in feature validation, user acceptance testing, and integrated system testing.
* Ensure delivered capabilities function as intended within cyber range environments.
* Gather feedback from operators, instructors, and stakeholders to inform future improvements.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8570 IAT Level II certification
* 5+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or technical leadership roles.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and backlog management practices.
* Experience working with full‑stack development teams and modern software architectures.
* Familiarity with cyber ranges, cyber training platforms, or simulation environments.
* Understanding of orchestrated training events, exercise lifecycle, and multi‑vendor tool integration.
* Ability to operate across complex environments involving RCS, ECS, cloud, and hybrid deployments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision‑making skills.
* Experience with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Knowledge of REST API design, authentication patterns, and distributed systems.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation (Terraform is a plus).
* Experience supporting government, DoD, or large‑scale training programs.
* DoD Top Secret security clearance
* Up to 10% travel

title: Product Manager - Payments and Financial Services
description:
**Innovate with purpose**
At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.
  
  
Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.
  
  
BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.
  
  
✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.
  
  
**Make Your Impact Within a Rapidly Growing Fintech Company**
Join BILL as a Product Manager on the Payments and Financial Services team, specifically within the FinSuite Platform. FinSuite is BILL's next-generation payments platform, responsible for the core money-movement capabilities that power how hundreds of thousands of SMBs pay vendors, manage cash flow, and automate their financial operations. The team owns Payment Engine, payments processing infrastructure (ACH, check, RPPS, wire), ledger ingestion, platform decoupling, and a growing set of AI-enabled payment experiences. This is high-stakes, high-visibility work: the FinSuite team processed over $30B across 10M+ transactions per month, with a direct line to customer trust and BILL's transactional revenue.
  
  
In this role, you'll own a clearly defined product area or workflow within the FinSuite Platform and drive it end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll write requirements, define success metrics, manage squad execution, and partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, CX, GTM, Finance, and operations to ensure every feature you ship delivers real customer and business impact. You'll also contribute to the team's AI roadmap, helping define safe self-service actions, instrument payment experiences for AI readiness, and measure outcomes for the owned area. SMBs rely on BILL every day to keep their financial operations running. Your work directly shapes that reliability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own a defined product area, feature set, or workflow within FinSuite Platform and drive it from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.
* Write product requirements, user stories, success metrics, rollout plans, and launch-readiness materials that engineering and design can execute against.
* Drive day-to-day squad execution, including sprint participation, prioritization, risk identification, and cross-team dependency management.
* Build and maintain a quarterly roadmap for the owned area, with a biannual view of priorities and sequencing, in partnership with more senior PMs.
* Define and track metrics for the owned workstream, covering adoption, reliability, operational efficiency, revenue enablement, and AI or self-service coverage where applicable.
* Contribute to AI-enabled payment experiences by clarifying workflows, defining tool and API requirements, identifying safe self-service actions, and measuring containment and customer value.
* Partner with CX, Ops, GTM, Finance, and analytics to ensure every feature works operationally and commercially, not just technically.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and dependency gaps, and escalate with options rather than just problems.

**We'd Love To Chat If You Have**

* 2+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a product-adjacent role with clear ownership of customer and business outcomes.
* Proven ability to ship software products end to end in partnership with engineering and design, including writing requirements, tracking execution, and driving launches.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to author clear requirements, decision documents, and stakeholder updates.
* Comfort using data to size opportunities, prioritize work, evaluate post-launch outcomes, and define success metrics at the feature or workflow level.
* Ability to manage ambiguity within a bounded scope, move work forward independently, and escalate with context when blockers arise.
* Strong cross-functional partnership instincts, including the ability to coordinate across engineering, design, analytics, and business stakeholders without losing momentum.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, fintech, platform products, or operations-heavy environments where reliability and accuracy are non-negotiable.
* Exposure to AI-enabled product experiences, including agent workflows, self-service tooling, or instrumentation for LLM-based products.
* Familiarity with payment rails (ACH, check, wire, card) or financial services platforms serving SMB customers.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

**What’s in it for you?**
Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn’t only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well.
  
  
Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL:
  
  

* 100% paid employee health, dental, and vision plans (choose HMO, PPO, or HDHP)
* HSA & FSA accounts
* Life Insurance, Long & Short-term disability coverage
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Don’t believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages.

We are committed to a transparent, inclusive hiring process that reflects our values. If you need accommodations at any stage, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com. To ensure a fair evaluation, our Candidate Integrity Policy prohibits the use of unapproved external assistance, including generative AI, during live interviews or assessments. title: Sr Project Manager
description:
Public Consulting Group LLC (PCG) is a leading public sector solutions implementation and operations improvement firm that partners with health, education, and human services agencies to improve lives. Founded in 1986, PCG employs approximately 2,000 professionals throughout the U.S.—all committed to delivering solutions that change lives for the better. The firm is a member of a family of companies with experience in all 50 states, and clients in three Canadian provinces and Europe. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit www.publicconsultinggroup.com.
  
  
Project management, leading complex client-facing projects, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring delivery to client expectations. This position will focus on multiple projects simultaneously, managing schedule, contract compliance, and budgets.
  
  
Projects focus on State government administered health and human service benefits, including but not limited to Medicaid and SNAP.

* Develops mechanisms for monitoring project progress and problem solving with customer representatives, developers, and clients
* Oversees and coordinates multiple projects across the team to ensure each clients’ deliverables are met in a timely manner
* Reviews status of projects and budgets, recommends and tracks pricing for modules and development, and manages schedules and prepares status reports
* Investigates and analyzes clients’ processes, recommends solutions to meet the clients’ needs, leads training for clients, manages implementation of new processes and software, and provides ongoing maintenance and support to clients
* Manages team sprint cycle priorities to optimize sprint capacity and timelines, and collaborates with development leadership to plan and execute new development
* Delegates testing requirements across team, and also contributes to testing, for new development and potential bugs in the system
* Monitors client requests and recommends solutions to increase team efficiency and rapid responses to meet client needs

* Coordinates and monitors multiple responses to current and prospective clients’ bids and requests for proposals; lead all levels of staff to inform response; and ensure on-time and complete delivery of proposals.
* Assists in demonstrations of relevant products and services to current and prospective clients, as expertise is required.
* Organizes team business development strategy sessions and works closely with team supervisor to project manage development plans, adjust strategy as needed, and track team progress
* Actively seeks understanding of other products and offerings; organizes product learning sessions to familiarize full team.
* Directly supervises a small group (1-2) of support and entry/immediate level professionals
* Effectively engages colleagues and peers in the development and execution of strategies and work plans, and effectively coaches/leads other colleagues to do the same
* Leads firm-wide initiative to develop best practices and build training modules for ASG track.
* Provides after-hours client support and travel as required.

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field; Master’s degree preferred
* 4+ years of experience managing complex, multi-year projects
* Project Management Certification (PMP)

* Schedule flexibility due to clients located across the U.S. (multiple time-zones)

title: Lead Product Owner - Data Analytics
description:

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.
  
  
As a Lead Product Owner on the Boundary Applications and Analytics team, you will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for Ferguson’s Decision Support Center space – the trusted source for accurate and interactive Enterprise and Operational reporting. This role operates at the intersection of technology and business functions, requiring close partnership with Finance to define, prioritize, and deliver solutions that supports the company’s “one source of truth” strategy. This role is focused on understanding the needs of internal business customers, deriving business value, offering thought leadership throughout the software delivery lifecycle, and leading technical teams to deliver large-scale projects with speed and quality. You will be a technology partner, relentlessly building and advocating for the customer while simultaneously listening and negotiating with business collaborators across the company. You will help craft a comprehensive backlog and design a thoughtful roadmap for execution of Ferguson’s vision, ensuring each report is precise, reliable, and timely. The ideal candidate brings experience leading Data Analytics teams in fast‑paced environments, thrives amid ambiguity, and takes direct accountability for delivering measurable business value.
