* Complete comprehensive, competitive analyses and market validation across multiple customers/products, contributing to deep stakeholder understanding of customers and markets to find adjacencies, and impactful new market opportunities.
* Manage and communicate a detailed roadmap for your product.
* Use qualitative and quantitative research to drive business value and roadmap prioritization.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve operational efficiency and enhance business impact.
* Collaborate closely with the business, Finance and Reporting teams to define, document and prioritize requirements, ensuring business needs are met and exceeded.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Strong analytical approach with focus on data accuracy, reporting, and business value.
* Proven ability to prioritize, influence, and align cross-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Experience with enterprise reporting, analytics platforms, or “single source of truth” initiatives.

**Professional Competencies:**

* Problem Solving: Identify issues quickly and drive effective solutions
* Collaboration: Build alignment and work effectively across teams
* Communication: Clearly convey ideas, updates, and tradeoffs

title: Senior Workday Engagement Manager

Read more about Alchemy’s values here: https://alchemy.us/about/.

Alchemy's Senior Engagement Manager will provide project leadership, develop enduring partnerships with customers, and ensure the successful deployment of Workday. The role will oversee and take full ownership of overall project deliverables and milestones to ensure the successful deployment of the Workday HCM, Financials, and Student product, ensuring projects are deployed on time, within budget, and according to our customers’ high-quality expectations. The Senior Engagement Manager will also be responsible for mentoring and developing less experienced engagement managers. This role requires a strong project or engagement manager with experience leading both Workday Platform and Student implementations.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Ensure Workday deployments are properly planned, staffed, and delivered successfully
* Communicate and work effectively with customer stakeholders/steering committees, customer project managers, and internal teams to ensure a positive, sustainable result
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget
* Identify the risks associated with the project and appropriately escalate project issues to customer team and internal stakeholders
* Develop risk mitigation solutions as needed with input from the internal project team and stakeholders
* Solid understanding of Workday HCM, Financials, and/or Student product suites
* Hold a Workday project management certification and be an expert in adapting the Workday implementation methodology
* Support the sales cycles by assisting with scoping, project estimation, Statement of Work review and conducting orals presentations
* Demonstrate extensive industry expertise and the ability to create tailored solutions for prospects and customers by integrating Workday with third-party systems
* Continue to enhance and expand Alchemy’s capabilities in both Higher Education and State and Local Government

**About You (Required Skills)**

* Extensive large enterprise (LE) Workday project management experience and the desire to support LE Workday Platform for Higher Education and State and Local Government engagements as Alchemy seeks to move upmarket
* Ability to grow Alchemy’s capability in the State and Local Government space
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

title: Senior Data Center Project Manager
description:
At
**ABB**
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
**This position reports to:**
Director, Data Center Services Center of Excellence
  
  
\_\_
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Project Manager**
to lead the
**start-up and commissioning of power delivery equipment**
for large-scale data centers. In this role, you will own the planning and execution of commissioning activities for
**MV/LV switchgear (AIS and GIS), busway, and related critical power systems**
, ensuring that hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers go live safely, on time, and exactly as designed.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of
**engineering, construction, and operations**
, ideal for someone who thrives in complex technical environments and enjoys being on the critical path of data center delivery.
  
  
**The work model for the role is: Remote**
This role is contributing to the
**Electrification Service Data Center Services COE**
in the United States.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
**Project Leadership & Ownership**

* Lead end-to-end start-up and commissioning projects for electrical power systems within data centers—from pre-functional checks through Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and handover.
* Develop and own the commissioning project plan, including scope, schedule, budget, risk register, and resource plan.
* Serve as the single point of contact for all commissioning-related activities with internal teams, customers, and contractors.

**Technical & Commissioning Execution**

* Coordinate and oversee commissioning activities for:
* Medium and low voltage switchgear / switchboards
* Transformers, Busway / bus duct and protection relays and metering
* Ensure commissioning is executed in accordance with owner’s project requirements, design basis, specifications, and industry standards (e.g., NFPA, IEEE, IEC, ASHRAE, Uptime).
* Review and approve commissioning scripts, test procedures, and method statements, and ensure that deficiencies are documented, tracked, and closed out.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for issues uncovered during L2-L4 commissioning and IST.

**Stakeholder & Customer Management**

* Act as the key liaison between clients (including hyperscale cloud, enterprise, and colo customers), EPCs, OEMs, Cx agents, and internal engineering/service teams.
* Run regular progress meetings and technical reviews, clearly communicating status, risks, and recovery plans.
* Build strong working relationships on-site and represent the company with professionalism and confidence.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Champion a “zero harm” safety culture on all commissioning sites, ensuring compliance with company and customer safety policies and procedures.
* Enforce quality standards and ensure all work is executed to the highest levels of craftsmanship and reliability.
* Ensure all required documentation, test reports, as-builts, redlines, and turnover packages are complete, accurate, and delivered on time.

**Planning, Controls & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain detailed commissioning schedules aligned with construction milestones and data center go-live dates.
* Track costs, change orders, and earned value for commissioning scope; proactively manage variances and opportunities.
* Provide regular project reporting to leadership and customers, including KPIs, risk/issue logs, punch lists, and lessons learned.

**Team Collaboration & Leadership**

* Coordinate and direct multidisciplinary site teams (field engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third-party Cx agents).
* Mentor less-experienced engineers and support staff on commissioning best practices, documentation, and customer communication.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of standard commissioning procedures, templates, and tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 7+ years managing complex technical projects, with at least 3+ years focused on start-up and commissioning of power or MEP systems.
* Direct experience in data centers, critical facilities, or heavy industrial power distribution environments.
* Strong understanding of electrical power systems (MV/LV), short circuit/coordination concepts, protective relays, and critical power architecture (N, N+1, 2N).
* Demonstrated experience with commissioning processes (levels 1–5), electrical acceptance testing, and integrated systems testing.
* Familiarity with EPMS/BMS, SCADA, and controls integration is a plus.:
* Proven track record managing scope, schedule, cost, risk, and stakeholders on multi-million-dollar projects.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and the MS Office suite.
* Willingness and ability to travel to project sites (10-20% travel).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences.
* Authorized to work in the United States

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading commissioning for hyperscale or large colocation data centers.
* Hands-on background as an electrical field engineer, commissioning engineer, or Cx agent before moving into project management.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, CxA, CPQ, or equivalent.
* Experience with major OEM low and medium voltage equipment and protective relay platforms.
* Familiarity with NFPA 70/70E, IEEE, IEC, and data center-specific standards/owner specifications.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling processes for repeatable commissioning across multiple sites or regions.

**What's In It For You**
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

title: Product Manager - AI SOC Platform — MDR/MXDR, Network & Cloud Security (MSSP)
description:
LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst-recognized and largest pure-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of the AI SOC platform that powers our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR), managed network security, and managed cloud security services. This role is about scale: building AI- and automation-first detection, triage, and response capabilities that absorb growing alert and workload volumes without linear analyst headcount, and making the platform extensible — so new distribution channel partners, MSSPs, and MSPs can onboard quickly and consume our detections, cases, and response actions through well-documented APIs. Scope spans endpoint, network, and cloud — firewall and NDR-driven network defense and cloud posture, workload, and identity security — packaged so MSSPs can operate them multi-tenant, at estate scale, under their own brand. You'll be equally comfortable in the architecture review and in front of a customer or partner executive, presenting the strategy, roadmap, and business case.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and evangelize the roadmap for the AI SOC platform underpinning MDR/MXDR — AI-assisted triage, alert correlation and deduplication, automated investigation, and orchestrated response
* Target workload volume as the primary product outcome: drive down analyst touches per alert, false-positive rates, and manual investigation steps through automation and agentic workflows
* Define the platform's extensibility model — multi-tenancy, tenant hierarchy, role-based access, white-labeling, and partner-facing configuration — so new distribution channel partners can be onboarded repeatably
* Own the partner and customer API surface (detections, cases, telemetry ingestion, response actions, reporting/billing), including versioning, rate limits, documentation, and developer experience
* Build the integration and data-source roadmap across EDR, identity, cloud, email, and network telemetry, prioritizing coverage that partners and customers ask for most
* Own the managed network security roadmap — firewall and IPS policy management, NDR, secure service edge/SASE, and network telemetry-driven detections delivered at MSSP scale
* Own the managed cloud security roadmap — CSPM/CNAPP posture management, cloud workload and container protection, cloud identity and entitlement monitoring, and multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) detection coverage
* Package network and cloud security for MSSP delivery — multi-tenant policy management, bulk device and account onboarding, co-managed and partner-operated models, and estate-wide change/compliance reporting
* Present the strategy, roadmap, and benefits to sales teams, customers, and external partners — QBRs, advisory boards, partner enablement sessions, analyst briefings, and deal-critical escalations
* Maintain a deep view of the MSS/MDR/MXDR competitive landscape (MSSPs, EDR-led MDR, SIEM and hyperscaler SOC platforms, emerging AI SOC entrants) and sharpen our differentiators in positioning and pricing
* Own AI governance and trust requirements for the platform — model transparency, analyst-in-the-loop controls, auditability, and data residency/handling commitments
* Own commercial success metrics — automation rate, cost-to-serve per tenant, partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, adoption, and retention — and build the business case for new capabilities

**What You'll Deliver**

* AI SOC platform roadmap with quarterly updates, including automation and workload-reduction targets
* Partner onboarding and channel enablement kit — reference architecture, API documentation, sandbox access, and integration certification criteria
* Public and partner API specifications, versioning policy, and developer documentation
* Customer- and partner-ready strategy and roadmap narratives, demos, and benefit/ROI models
* Competitive battlecards and differentiation positioning for the MSS/MDR/MXDR market
* Business cases, service packaging, and pricing/cost models for platform and channel offerings
* Managed network and cloud security service definitions, MSSP-ready packaging, and supported-technology matrix
* Product requirement and service description documents
* Measurable progress against automation rate, cost-to-serve, MTTD/MTTR, adoption, retention, and partner revenue KPIs

**What We're Looking For**

* 3-5+ years of product management experience in MSS/MSSP, MDR/MXDR, EDR, SIEM, or SOC automation (SOAR / AI SOC) products
* Demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML- or automation-driven capabilities and measuring their impact on analyst workload and cost-to-serve

**Education**

* A high school diploma or equivalent is required; a college or university degree is a plus.

**Why Join LevelBlue?**
At LevelBlue, you’re not just an employee—you’re part of a team making a real difference in the world of cybersecurity. We foster a culture of innovation and creativity where your contributions are valued, and you’ll have the support and resources to grow and thrive.
  
  
**Benefits And Perks**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with employer matching.
* Generous paid time off and holidays.
* Flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts.
* Employee assistance programs.
* Training and development opportunities.
* Adoption assistance program.

This role is open to candidates legally authorized to work in the United States. At LevelBlue, we support flexible work and bring people together in person for key moments based on role, team, and business needs.
  
  
LevelBlue is committed to a culture of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other status protected under applicable law.
  
  
To all agencies: Please do not contact LevelBlue employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. LevelBlue’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies through its approved agency process and with a valid agreement in place. Any resume submitted outside this process will be considered the property of LevelBlue, and no fee will be paid if a candidate is hired from such a submission.

title: Senior Product Manager, Market Intelligence
description:
**About Chartis**
The challenges facing US healthcare are longstanding and all too familiar. We are Chartis, and we believe in better. We work with more than 1,900 organizations annually to develop and activate transformative strategies, operating models, and organizational enterprises that make US healthcare more affordable, accessible, safe, and human. With more than 1,450 professionals, we help providers, payers, technology innovators, retail companies, and investors create and embrace solutions that tangibly and materially reshape healthcare for the better. Our family of brands—Chartis, Jarrard, Greeley, and HealthScape Advisors—is 100% focused on healthcare and each has a longstanding commitment to helping transform healthcare in big and small ways. Believe in better.
  
  
Chartis has offices in Boston, Chicago, New York, Washington D.C., and Nashville.
  
  
Remote work is allowed.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
This is an opportunity to join a product development organization building next-generation AI-enabled health technology products. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager (IC) with deep analytics expertise and a healthcare background to own the roadmap and development of our structured market analytics products—automated, agent driven analyses of commonly used healthcare datasets that power our client-facing Market Intelligence platform.
  
  
You will own these products end to end: identifying the market questions our users need answered, defining the data models and metrics that answer them, and partnering with engineering and analytics teams to build, validate, and ship them. You will set the quality bar—establishing accuracy benchmarks and testing frameworks—so every market intelligence product we release earns the trust of the consultants and clients who depend on it.
  
  
This role reports to the Principal Product Manager, Market Intelligence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
*Product Strategy & Vision*

* Own and drive the roadmap for new structured market analytics products, prioritizing investments based on user needs, market opportunity, and fit with the broader platform.
* Develop a deep understanding of healthcare markets and the data that describes them—including claims, provider, utilization, and market share data—and how consultants and clients use analytics to answer market questions.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined product requirements with clear metric definitions, data specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Define and track success metrics for each product, including accuracy, adoption, and usage.

*Agentic Analytics Product Development*

* Lead end-to-end development of new standardized market analytics products: data source evaluation, data model and metric design, validation, and release.
* Partner with data engineers and analysts on schema design, transformation logic, and data quality assurance.
* Build and own accuracy benchmarks and testing frameworks, including gold-standard test sets that gate each release.
* Ensure products are designed for consumption by AI agents and downstream applications, not just human analysts.

*Execution & Leadership*

* Drive product execution from requirements through delivery, including documentation, backlog management, and release communication.
* Communicate options and trade-offs to senior leaders to enable fast, well-informed decisions.
* Gather structured feedback from consultants and clients, and iterate on products based on real-world usage.
* Serve as the connective tissue across product, data, and consulting teams to ensure analytics products evolve in ways that serve the full portfolio.

**Qualifications And Desired Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in product management, analytics, or data product roles, with demonstrated success delivering data-intensive products
* Deep analytics expertise, including SQL, data modeling, metric definition, and hands-on work with large datasets
* Healthcare background, with working knowledge of healthcare data (such as claims, provider, and market data) and industry dynamics across providers and payers
* Experience building and managing data products on cloud data platforms required, with Snowflake strongly preferred
* Consulting experience preferred, with an understanding of how advisory teams use data and analytics in client work
* Proven ability to define the right metrics, use data to drive decisions, and deliver measurable outcomes
* Demonstrated success taking products from concept to pilot to scale in ambiguous, early-stage environments
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and business stakeholders
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or quantitative field a plus

Salary range: $135,000- $201,000 plus may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The salary range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills, experience, training, licensure and certifications, practice area, and other business and organizational needs. In addition, Chartis offers several benefits including medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, disability insurance, life insurance, 401(k) match, paid time off, wellness stipend, and additional voluntary benefits.
  
  
At Chartis, we pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of individuals and the different perspectives they provide. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

**Position Summary:**
The Associate Director, Customer Engagement Platforms & Data is the hands-on BTS product and platform leader responsible for translating approved Commercial and Global Medical Affairs customer engagement, omnichannel, and data priorities into secure, scalable, and compliant capabilities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise Technology & Solutions - Commercial and Global Medical Affairs, the role provides product management, solution architecture, integration, delivery, and lifecycle leadership through a shared operating model with Commercial Systems & Analytics within Commercial Insights & Operations.
  
  
Commercial Systems & Analytics owns, manages, and operates commercial and sales operations technology, including CRM, data, reporting, and analytics. The Associate Director partners closely with that team to align roadmaps, decision rights, delivery, and operating practices while providing BTS leadership for enterprise architecture, integration, security, scalability, vendor management, and lifecycle planning. Align business ownership of commercial and sales operations technology, data, reporting, and analytics with BTS accountabilities for architecture, integration, security, scalability, vendor management, and lifecycle planning; establish clear roles, decision rights, handoffs, and roadmaps.

title: Water & Wastewater Engineering Project Manager
description:
What Your Day Will Look Like:
  
  
As a Project Manager, you'll lead the planning, design, and delivery of critical water and wastewater infrastructure projects that support communities throughout California. Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and stakeholders, you'll oversee projects from initial planning through design and construction while driving technical excellence, client satisfaction, and financial performance.
  
  
In this role, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to clients, building and strengthening long-term relationships while helping guide infrastructure investments and project priorities. You'll balance project execution, team leadership, business development, and operational performance to successfully deliver projects on schedule and within budget.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a motivated leader to combine engineering expertise, project management, and client-facing responsibilities while helping grow Consor's water and wastewater practice throughout California.
  
  
**Projected Compensation:**
$160,000 - $180,000+ DOE
  
  
Compensation for candidates with significant experience beyond the minimum requirements may be considered above this range.
  
  
**Location:**
Candidates must reside in California and hold an active California PE license. Consor offers flexible work arrangements, including remote, hybrid, and in-office options from our California locations in Rancho Cordova, Walnut Creek, Oakland, Santa Clara, Los Angeles, and San Diego.
  
  
What You'll Do:
  
  

* Drive project execution strategies, proactively identifying risks, resolving challenges, and implementing solutions to keep projects on track and within scope.
* Develop and monitor detailed project work plans, budgets, and resource allocations to ensure efficient use of time and financial performance.
* Lead client presentations, workshops, and stakeholder meetings, translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, permitting requirements, and industry standards throughout all project phases.
* Oversee contract management activities, including scope development, negotiations, change orders, and documentation.
* Champion continuous improvement by implementing best practices, innovative technologies, and process enhancements across projects.
* Partner with business development teams to identify new opportunities, contribute to proposals, and support project pursuits and interviews.
* Monitor project financials, including forecasting, invoicing, and profitability analysis, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between engineering, environmental, planning, and construction teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Act as a strategic advisor to clients, providing guidance on long-term infrastructure planning, capital improvement programs, and system optimization.

What You'll Need:
  
  

* Experience managing the planning, design, and delivery of water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
* Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience building and maintaining client relationships and supporting business development efforts.
* Bachelor of Science in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, or a related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years of water and wastewater engineering experience.
* Active California Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD and Civil 3D is preferred but not required.

This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, and bodies of water, depending on project requirements.
  
  
While performing the duties of this job, physical demands of the employee include frequent sitting, moving, standing, talking, hearing, and occasional balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, handling, grasping, and feeling. This job may occasionally require operating a company vehicle, and lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 35 lbs.
  
  
**What Benefits You’ll Enjoy:**
**We invest in us. Because our team members go above, below, and beyond the surface to care for our communities (inside and out), we do our best to take care of you by providing a comprehensive benefits package !**
Eligibility for some of the benefits outlined below is based on full-time work status; part-time and contingent positions are only eligible based on hours worked. If you have questions, contact careers@consoreng.com .
  
  

* Career Growth & Development – Tuition reimbursement program, paid professional training, major license achievement bonus, extensive on-demand learning center, and paid professional memberships.
* Work-Life Alignment – Industry-competitive PTO, seven paid holidays and two floating holidays, flexible work schedules, paid parental leave, and eligibility for hybrid and remote work options for some employees based on role responsibilities.
* Wellness – Medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, fitness and wellness reimbursement, and HSA and FSA options.
* Life – Employer-paid STD and LTD, employer-paid term life insurance, and retirement 401(k) with company match.
* Community – Quarterly social events, paid group volunteering events, and employee networks and groups .

**How Your Career Will Grow:**
We know career growth is not always linear or streamlined—it’s often dynamic. You may want to explore a management track, try a new technical track, or move laterally to reposition your skills and talents. No matter what level you join us at or how you want to shape your career, we want Consor to be a place where you can learn and grow.
  
  
**Why You’ll Love Consor:**
You’ll experience a culture where we share in our successes and support one another through challenges. Here, there are countless opportunities to explore your career path by working on projects that help you expand your potential and take your career to new heights! Join our diverse team of experts who live and work alongside client partners, providing thoughtful solutions to create inspiring communities together. Click here to learn more about Consor.
  
  
**Consor’s Commitment to Equal Opportunity in the Workplace**
Consor welcomes and celebrates equality and diversity in the workplace. We are committed to fostering an environment in which employees and prospective employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where the uniqueness, perspectives, and experiences of individuals are valued. Consor is an equal opportunity employer and maintains employment practices designed to provide equal employment and development opportunities for all employees and applicants, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Consor also maintains an affirmative action program across its offices and worksites.
  
  
If you need more information or special assistance for persons with disabilities or limited English proficiency, contact Human Resources at (786) 275-7370. Persons with hearing and speech impairments can contact Consor by using the Virginia Relay Service, a toll-free telecommunication device for the deaf (TDD). Call 711 for TTY/TDD.
  
  
If any applicant believes they have been discriminated against or desires further information or assistance, contact us at (786) 275-7370.

title: Sr Product Owner - Enterprise Data
description:
The Sr Product Owner works on a cross functional team to create meaningful and simple experiences for their product’s customers. They own the direction-setting, discovery, and prioritization of customer wants and needs. A Sr Product Owner typically has more experience in the role of Product Owner, and as such likely manages complex products with greater scope and impact.
  
  
The Sr. Product Owner role is highly collaborative working closely with several key partners. The Sr Product Owner articulates, translates, and executes the Product Manager’s long-term strategy and vision of the product through tactical strategies and solutions to drive necessary business outcomes. This requires the right alignment and regular, transparent communication to ensure both roles deliver on their goals.
  
  
Additionally, the Sr. Product Owner works closely with stakeholders, end users, and functional and technical team members to rapidly deliver quality solutions to customers.
  
  
This role is part of Thrivent's Enterprise Data Products organization and supports data products aligned to Product & Services and Life, Health & Annuities (LHA). This data product enables product performance insights, buiness decision-making, analytics, and AI-enabled business capabilities. The Sr Product Owner partners closely with business leaders, analysts, architects, and engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver data products that drive measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Enterprise Data Products at Thrivent are focused on creating trusted, reusable, and measurable data products that enable analytics, operational decision-making, governance, and AI-powered experiences across the enterprise.
  
  
**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Works as a key team member on a cross functional team, responsible for continuous delivery of value to the customer through compelling and empowering customer experiences
* Collaborate with Product Manager and stakeholders to ensure work prioritization is aligned with Thrivent’s priorities and overall product roadmap as well as to provide product development feedback and direction.
* Leans into the work of developing and socializing the product strategy with senior leaders across the company
* Continuously innovates and evolves the product in alignment with strategic priorities. Is responsible for creating, maintaining, and evolving the product roadmap
* Maintain and refine product backlog: Create user stories and acceptance criteria and prioritize all stories to ensure work focuses on those with maximum business value that align with product strategy
* Ensure stories clearly communicate the customer and stakeholder needs to meet key business objectives and strategies for the product. Is available for consultation during agile team planning and grooming sessions as needed.
* Coaches team members on effective product management and agile techniques to help mature the abilities of the entire team
* Facilitates efforts across other product teams to align product roadmaps and sprint plans, in an effort to focus on delivering the maximum business value to the organization
* As a functional leader of an agile team, ensures the team is aligned around similar goals and objectives and attending all team meetings
* Engages with customers and users on a regular basis to uncover implicit and explicit needs
* Develop and track key value drivers that measure effectiveness of product discovery and overall product performance, and communicate these to stakeholders and business leaders on a regular basis
* Foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.
* Inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization’s direction (Product/Agile/DevOps)
* Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – courage, collaboration, and commitment by demonstrating resiliency, working together to make the best decisions, and holding yourself and others accountable
* Supports and/or develops an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients.
* Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients

No direct personnel supervisory responsibility, however, supervises large complex product teams with cross-functional team members.
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:**
***Required:***

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* 5-7 years relevant business experience
* Experience working with enterprise data products, analytics, reporting, governance, or data platform initiatives within financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Demonstrated ability to define and measure product value through business outcomes, adoption, quality, operational efficiency, or customer impact.
* Experience partnering with business leaders, data engineers, architects, analysts, and technical delivery teams.
* Understand fundamentals of iterative development, software development process and procedures
* Expertise in the principles of Agile Product Management, stakeholder management, market and user research, technology management, and process design
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and influence skills among all organizational levels; strong facilitation and executive communications skills
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, translate business problems into actionable product priorities, and facilitate alignment across multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong prioritization and tradeoff-management skills across competing stakeholder needs.
* Ability to influence without direct authority across business and technology teams.

***Preferred:***

* Certified Product Owner or similar certification
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Power BI, or similar technologies
* Experience with data governance, metadata management, data quality, lineage, or master data management.
* Experience developing and managing enterprise data products that support analytics, customer insights, operational reporting, decision support, or AI-enabled capabilities.
* Financial services experience, preferably supporting life insurance, health insurance, annuities, product management, distribution, or advisor capabilities.
* Expert in defining high-quality business requirements and proficient in Agile story writing
* Expertise with foundational product management tools, techniques and principles across discovery, design, build, release, and measure cycle
* Strong leadership skills to coordinate and motivate product teams, even outside direct reporting relationships
* Experience working in large, complex organizational initiatives

Pay Transparency
  
  
Thrivent’s long-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full-time role is $132,814.00 - $179,690.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important.
  
  
Thrivent is unique in our commitment to helping people to be wise with money and live balanced and generous lives. That extends to our benefits.
  
  
The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well-being benefits, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for receipt of these benefits is subject to the applicable plan/policy documents. Thrivent’s plans/policies are subject to change at any time at Thrivent’s discretion.

*sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable local, state, or federal law. This policy applies to all employees and job applicants.*

**About Lyra Health**
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lyra is transforming mental health care through technology with a human touch to help people feel emotionally healthy at work and at home. We work with industry leaders, such as Morgan Stanley, Uber, Amgen, and other Fortune 500 companies, to improve access to effective, high-quality mental health care for their employees and their families. With our innovative digital care platform and global provider network, 10 million people can receive the best care and feel better, faster. Founded by David Ebersman, former CFO of Facebook and Genentech, Lyra has raised more than $900 million.
  
  
A Product Manager will play a critical role in owning product planning and launches, partnering closely with Product (PM, Design), Engineering, Go-to-Market (GTM), Customer Success (CS), Operations, and the leadership team to execute our product strategy and achieve our business goals. This role is highly visible across the organization and is crucial to ensure that we execute at a high level across every facet of product management, development, and operations.
  
  
Lyra is looking for an experienced Product Manager to help drive initiatives to support our customers and end users. The ideal candidate is a strategic problem solver that is highly collaborative, synthesizing input from many different cross-functional teams, articulating a plan, and executing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to identify high-impact opportunities and define strategies to drive platform scalability
* Set the strategic product vision and drive delivery against the roadmap, ruthlessly prioritizing efforts to achieve core business objectives
* Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle by establishing operational rhythms that maintain team velocity, ensure high-quality shipping at scale, and optimize the cross-functional build process
* Track overall program metrics and effectively report out on program health to executive audiences
* Partner closely with channel partners to identify new opportunities
* Collaborate with Go to Market and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless transition from product development to product launch and customer onboarding, and receiving feedback to further drive the product roadmap
* Demonstrate deep operational accountability by proactively identifying and mitigating risks that impact the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by regularly reviewing and optimizing processes and methodologies

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in product management with a proven track record of strategic execution and shipping products at scale in a software development environment
* Highly organized self-starter; able to multitask and apply structure to ambiguous situations
* Strong quantitative analytical skills and ability to think strategically and tactically to solve problems and drive results while operating in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies
* Curiosity and passion to learn more about your users, our market, our product, the competitive landscape, and much more
* Demonstrated leadership and proactive ownership over strategic decision-making; possesses an execution-oriented mindset with an innate sense of operational

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with platform product teams, scaling solutions across the business and other product teams
* Experience defining and shipping 0-1 features
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field

* Develops and maintains governance frameworks to ensure consistent, compliant, and effective program management practices.

title: Product Manager, Detection Pipeline
description:
You live at the intersection of security and product management, and there's no place you'd rather be. You understand that the detection pipeline isn't just plumbing. It's the connective tissue that turns raw security data into signal, and if ingestion, normalization, or correlation break down, everything downstream suffers. You're not intimidated by the scale and complexity of data flowing through a modern security platform. Quite the opposite: you pride yourself on knowing how data moves from source to detection, where the pipeline breaks, and what it takes to make it fast, reliable, and cost effective.
  
  
You’ve got an informed opinion about what an MDR should detect, an opinion that comes from customer empathy, hands-on industry knowledge, and a set of experiences that didn’t always go as planned. You can hold a technical conversation with a SOC analyst and turn around and explain the same thing to a Sales team in plain English. You've been waiting for a role where that combination of skills actually matters.
  
  
Still reading? Great. This role isn't for all PMs. Yes, all the standard PM things apply: plan, prioritize, communicate, and own a roadmap, build relationships, and become the authority on how internal teams and customers use your platform. But in this role, you'll bring your security experience to bear on one of the most foundational parts of Expel's platform. If you get your energy from untangling how security data flows through a platform at scale and turning that into a roadmap that makes customers safer, you'll thrive here.
  
  
**What Expel Can Do For You**

* Give you clear ownership of a product area with measurable impact on customer value and business outcomes.
* Surround you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and operators who are genuinely invested in building something great.
* Offer a foundation to build on: the detection pipeline is critical to Expel's platform, and there's meaningful work ahead.

**What You Can Do For Expel**

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Expel's detection pipeline (normalization, correlation, and automated detections and suppressions), from defining the six month vision to driving execution with Engineering and UX.
* Establish relationships with internal teams (SOC, Detection Engineering, Engineering) and customers, and use their input, alongside market and competitive signals, to build and prioritize a roadmap that maximizes impact.
* Be the voice of your roadmap: clearly articulating value to Detection Engineering, SOC, Sales, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Product Marketing to effectively communicate the value of the detection pipeline internally and externally.

**What You Should Bring With You**

* A curious, customer-obsessed mindset — you're comfortable asking "why" until you get to the real problem.
* 2–4 years of experience in product management or a directly relevant role, with experience in the security industry strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with product management and software engineering processes, from requirements definition through to launch.
* Familiarity with security tools — EDR, SIEM, and firewall products — and how they fit into a customer's security stack.
* Broad knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and where security risks emerge in those environments.
* Experience with SIEM technologies is highly desired — bonus points if you've navigated integration or data pipeline challenges firsthand.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write a crisp user story and present to a customer in the same afternoon.
* The ability to build trust across Engineering, Security Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and UX.

This role is remote within the United States.

Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colourful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

to join us at our facility in
**PA-Glen Mills (US-PA-Remote).**
The Project Manager – New Product Commercialization & Growth will lead the end-to-end launch, expansion, and commercialization of our product lines. This role serves as the cross-functional leader responsible for transforming growth initiatives into profitable market outcomes.
  
  
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Executive Leadership, the individual will drive new product introduction (NPI), accelerate market adoption, optimize portfolio expansion, and deliver top-line revenue growth.
  
  
A highly strategic, commercially minded leader who can bridge strategy and execution, this individual excels at driving cross-functional alignment, managing complex growth initiatives, and delivering measurable business outcomes. They are energized by building new businesses, launching innovative products, and creating sustainable top-line growth while maintaining accountability for financial performance. The successful candidate combines strong project management discipline with commercial acumen, enabling the organization to bring innovative products to market faster, scale adoption, and achieve aggressive revenue and profitability targets.

**Product Launch Leadership**

* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure readiness across manufacturing, supply chain, sales, marketing, and customer support.

**Commercialization & Revenue Growth**

**Qualifications**

title: Staff Product Manager (vMetal)
description:
As a
**Staff Product Manage**
r for vMetal at vCluster Labs, you'll help own the systems that discover, provision, configure, and manage physical hardware, turning racks of bare metal into a programmable platform for AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers to build tenant clusters on top of. You'll work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership on the tradeoffs that shape where vMetal goes next.
  
  
**As a Staff Product Manager, Your Role Will Include**

* Infrastructure Direction: Align on business priorities and technical direction for vMetal, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against. You'll take this on from beta and early releases forward, shaping the direction of the product.
* Product Leadership Partnership: Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership to shape the direction of vMetal.
* Hands-on Validation: Run alpha and beta builds yourself, including against real bare metal hardware where possible. Catch integration issues before customers do.
* Customer Intelligence: Engage directly with platform engineers at AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers running bare metal at scale.
* Market Positioning: Track the bare metal and GPU infrastructure ecosystem. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and partner with GTM on messaging that lands.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.

**This role could be a fit for you if you bring:**

* Experience: 5+ years experience in cloud infrastructure, bare metal, or GPU/HPC platforms. We're open to a range of backgrounds for this role, not just traditional product management.
* Infrastructure Fluency: You understand bare metal provisioning, out-of-band server management (Redfish, IPMI), and PXE boot well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.
* Kubernetes Familiarity: You're comfortable with Kubernetes fundamentals, pods, controllers, CRDs, and the operator pattern, and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers.
* Customer-Facing Infra Experience: You've sat across from platform engineers and architects, and you're comfortable in that conversation.

**Bonus Points For**

* Kubernetes-as-a-Service: Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.
* Internal Developer Platforms: Platform PM experience building IDPs that abstract infrastructure complexity for developer teams.
* Startup Growth: Adaptable to startup pace and change.

**About VCluster Labs**
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.
  
  
We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.
  
  
We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.
  
  
**Benefits**
We offer the following benefits:
  
  

* Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
* Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
* Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
* Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

**Culture & Values**
**At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For**

* Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
* Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
* Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
* Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
* Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $170K - $210K

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager**

**$160,000–$200,000**

**Remote - based in US**

We're partnering with a fast-growing, AI-driven company building real-time ad infrastructure and personalized commerce platforms. This isn't a website - it's core systems powering automated, high-performance advertising for major brands and retailers.

As the business continues to grow, they're looking to hire an experienced Product Manager to take ownership of a core area of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role, working alongside Engineering, Data and Design teams to shape products that solve complex technical challenges for enterprise customers.

**The Role**

You'll own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for a key product area, working across the full product lifecycle from discovery through to launch. You'll partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements and deliver solutions that create measurable business value.

This role would suit Product Managers who enjoy working on highly technical platforms, collaborating closely with engineering teams and solving complex problems involving workflows, platform capabilities, data and user experience.

The business is lean and fast-moving, so you'll need to be comfortable wearing multiple hats, creating structure where it doesn't already exist and adapting as priorities change.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for a key product area.
* Define product strategy and prioritise features based on customer needs and business objectives.
* Write detailed product requirements and work closely with Engineering throughout delivery.
* Collaborate with customers to understand workflows, pain points and opportunities for improvement.
* Work alongside technical teams to deliver scalable, high-quality platform enhancements.
* Balance customer feedback, technical investment and long-term product strategy.
* Use SQL to pull, analyse and investigate your own data to understand product performance, customer behaviour and potential issues.
* Use data and customer insights to support product decisions and validate assumptions.
* Partner with Engineering and Data to investigate technical problems and understand technical trade-offs.
* Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to extend your ability to investigate problems, understand a codebase, explore technical approaches or build quick prototypes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional user experience.
* Operate comfortably in a lean environment, taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined product remit when required.

**About You**

* 4+ years' Product Management experience within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience working on complex, technical software products.
* Strong SQL skills and confidence pulling and analysing your own data.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience writing detailed product requirements and managing competing priorities.
* A collaborative approach and confidence working closely with engineering teams.
* Experience with data-driven decision making and technical products.
* Experience working in a start-up or high-growth environment, ideally where you've had to work autonomously, wear multiple hats and create structure in an evolving organisation.
* Comfortable investigating technical problems yourself and getting into the detail before bringing Engineering in where needed.
* Strong AI fluency and an understanding of how tools such as Claude or ChatGPT can be used beyond writing and editing - for example, investigating a codebase, exploring an issue, building a prototype or working through technical trade-offs.
* Naturally curious and hands-on, with strong product judgement. You use AI to extend what you can do, rather than relying on it to make decisions for you.
* Adtech experience remains important for this role, with experience across digital advertising, ad serving, campaign management, programmatic or related products particularly relevant.

**Nice to Have**

* Digital Advertising / AdTech
* Marketing Technology
* Data & Analytics
* Enterprise SaaS
* Customer Data Platforms
* Retail Technology
* Workflow or Platform Products
* Experience with real-time bidding, DSPs, SSPs or advertising infrastructure
* Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems or large-scale data environments
* Background in engineering, data analysis or another technical discipline

**What's on Offer**

* $160,000–$200,000 Base Salary
* Significant ownership and autonomy.
* Opportunity to influence the direction of a rapidly evolving platform.
* Collaborative, engineering-led product culture.
* Work on complex technical products solving real-world business challenges.
* The opportunity to work in a lean, fast-moving environment where you can have a direct impact on the product and wider business.

description:
**The Opportunity**
We seek a forward-thinking, innovative
**Product Manager**
to drive a strategic initiative focused on automating Power substation design work. This position offers an exciting opportunity to define and implement innovative and agile automation solutions that will drive our company’s efficiency and productivity for years to come.
  
  
This position works closely with internal experts, outside consultants, operations, and technology partners to develop a roadmap, create, and execute the strategic initiative for modular automation projects for power substations that utilize design authoring software and supporting software tools. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, initiative, innovation, and strategic thinking to ensure the successful implementation of automation initiatives and translate business needs and customer insight into clear product requirements.
  
  
The Product Manager owns the product lifecycle by defining the strategic “why” and “what” in the roadmap and partnering with delivery teams to translate priorities into successful outcomes. By collaborating across functions, they drive impactful solutions that advance Ulteig’s digital transformation objectives, ensuring measurable outcomes through data-driven decision-making and agile practices. Success in this role is measured by product adoption, business impact, and effective stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Product Execution & Delivery**

* Identify and Frame Problems: Proactively engage with stakeholders and internal users to uncover, define, and articulate the most pressing technical challenges and opportunities. Ensure that product efforts are anchored in a deep understanding of the underlying problems, not just proposed solutions. Use research, data analysis, and direct feedback to validate problem statements before moving to solution design.
* Define Product Vision & Roadmap: Own the 6 to 12-month product roadmap, ensuring alignment with Ulteig’s strategic objectives and customer needs.
* Translate Vision into Action: Convert product strategy into clear requirements and actionable plans for design automation solution products.
* Build the Business Case: Justify new features and initiatives by linking them to measurable business goals (e.g., “reduce manual data entry by 10 hours/week”).
* Validate MVPs and Early Concepts: Define requirements for minimum viable products, prototypes, and pilot solutions, and use stakeholder and user feedback to test concepts before broader investment or rollout.
* Own the Product Backlog: Create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog, including writing clear features, requirements and defining acceptance criteria.
* Support Daily Execution: Serve as the dedicated “go-to” person for the delivery team, answering questions, clarifying requirements, and making rapid prioritization calls.
* Accept Completed Work: Review and accept completed user stories, ensuring they meet acceptance criteria and deliver intended value.
* Manage Releases: Coordinate with the team and stakeholders to plan and communicate product releases.
* Develop and Maintain Key Artifacts: Maintain product requirement documents, customer journey maps, voice of the customer analysis, product analytics, and business impact dashboards.

**Leadership & Development**

* Storytelling: Crafting compelling narratives that align diverse teams (business services, engineering, sales, and design) behind a single product vision.
* Relationship Management: Navigate diverse team dynamics to build trust and drive alignment across competing interests.
* Leading Through Ambiguity: Support product team morale and focus when strategies change rapidly due to new information or business priorities.
* High emotional intelligence:

**Operational Excellence**

* Support Continuous Improvement: Champion technology adoption and process improvements within assigned product areas.
* Drive Product Adoption: Partner with stakeholders to support adoption of new products, processes, and ways of working through change planning, communication, and adoption activities.
* Monitor Product Performance: Use dashboards to track ROI, adoption, and business impact.
* Define & Track Success: Establish and monitor KPIs and metrics that define success for your product.
* Incorporate Market and Competitive Insights: Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and market signals to inform product strategy, prioritization, and decision-making.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Manage Stakeholder Expectations: Act as the primary point of contact for your product, managing stakeholder expectations and communicating product vision and roadmap to business stakeholders.
* Support Progress Communications: Partner with the delivery lead to support communication of delivery progress, key updates, and outcomes to stakeholders.
* Conduct ‘Customer’ Research: Regularly meet with users and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and needs.
* Engage Cross-Functional Partners: Collaborate with business services teams and other partners to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive alignment.
* Drive Enablement and Client Engagement: Partner with stakeholders to develop product messaging and support demos and presentations.
* Represent Product Value Clearly: Communicate product value propositions clearly and professionally to all stakeholders to reinforce benefits and support product adoption.

**Team Contribution & Growth**

* Contribute to Team Culture: Foster innovation, collaboration, and accountability within the product team.
* Continuous Learning: Actively seek and act on feedback, participate in ongoing learning, and work toward shared team goals.

*Disclaimer: The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required of this position.*
**What We Expect From You**

* Degree in Engineering, Design, Business Management, or other related field; consideration will be given to relevant experience.
* Requires 8+ years of experience in design-related fields; hands-on automation, digital design, or BIM experience preferred.
* Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple, concurrent projects and workstreams while meeting aggressive deadlines in a fast-paced environment, with extensive project planning and execution skills.
* Excellent problem-solving and relationship-building skills.
* Strong communication skills, written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* Knowledge and proficiency in the primary design authoring and supporting software platforms that will be utilized for these applications.
* Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement.
* Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S

**Competency Profile:**

* Client Success: Develops cross-functional shared goals and demonstrates accountability for achieving them. Ensures (external and internal) client needs are met through planning, utilization of metrics, communication, and personal accountability.
* Integrity: Takes ownership to manage and deliver work; holds self accountable. Listens with empathy and responds to others' ideas, perspectives, and concerns. Makes financially responsible decisions to maximize resources and budgets that optimize Ulteig's success.
* Enthusiasm: Energizes people and models optimism in the face of disruption. Builds alignment between organizational and personal purpose. Invests time to understand others' motivations and perspectives to build strong working relationships. Delivers timely and impactful communications that create alignment and consistency across the organization.
* Inclusion: Combines and amplifies different strengths, capabilities, and perspectives across the groups they work with. Fosters a sense of belonging and encourages others to bring their full selves to work. Builds trust with colleagues by engaging with transparency, empathy, and authenticity. Advocates for equitable opportunities across the teams and partners they collaborate with.
* Agility: Celebrates and recognizes contributions, learning, and growth, even through failed ideas. Thinks beyond current work (futuristically) and encourages others to do the same. Takes ownership for change management; understands and clearly communicates the "why", gains buy-in, and manages resistance through change. Navigates ambiguity, assesses situations, and makes informed decisions.
* Innovation: Operates with autonomy and flexibility to innovate and acts rapidly. Champions and models continuous new technology and skills development, and drives adoption across the organization.

*As you consider applying for a position at Ulteig, we encourage you to think outside the box – because we do! You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team members, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. And, yes, relevant military experience is absolutely considered for transitioning service members.*
**What You Can Expect From Ulteig**
Ulteig is a purpose-driven organization that has built a culture focused on people, both our clients and our employees, for over 80 years. Working at Ulteig is more than a job, opening opportunities to make an impact by creating and solving for a sustainable future. Our vision is to be the most trusted partners transforming our world’s critical infrastructure. Regardless of where you work, you are empowered to build a workday that best suits your strengths. We strive to ensure a balance and separation between home and work life.
