title: Technical Program Manager 6 - Infrastructure, AI
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
  
  
**The Team**
The Infrastructure and GenAI Technical Program Management organization sits within Engineering Operations (Eng Ops), which helps Netflix's engineering teams move faster and more reliably at scale. Eng Ops serves as the strategic and operational arm of the broader Infrastructure and Security organization, spanning functional disciplines including Platform Modernization, Developer Education, Support, SRE, and Technical Program Management.
  
  
Infrastructure and GenAI TPM serves as the connective tissue across engineering, turning broad, complex technical portfolios into coherent, well-governed programs. TPMs act as strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management, driving these technical programs and influencing leaders across the organization. Often the first dedicated team members in this capacity, they establish the operating rhythms that keep execution on track, manage cross-team dependencies and partnerships, surface risks before they become a fire drill, and translate strategy into plans that teams can actually execute against.
  
  
A top priority for the org is GenAI, enabling the broader organization to build GenAI platforms and driving the shift to becoming GenAI-native.
  
  
**Role**
We are hiring 3 distinct L6 Technical Program Managers to lead critical initiatives within Netflix’s Infrastructure and Security Organization. Each role will drive high-impact, cross-functional programs supporting the different areas below:
  
  
**AI Platform**
This TPM will serve as connective tissue across Netflix's AI Platform, its customers, and the infrastructure teams it relies on. You will partner with AI/ML research and engineering teams, infrastructure engineers, PMs, leaders, and fellow TPMs to transform a broad, complex technical portfolio into a coherent, opinionated AI infrastructure platform. You will drive adoption, scalability, and modernization across data and model infrastructure, training and offline AI infrastructure, and inference at scale, including model serving, routing, and experimentation. As a strategic partner embedded early in a growing engineering organization, you will shape platform direction and operating rhythms, establish paved paths, improve lifecycle visibility, and build the reliability, security, and efficiency required to deploy and operate AI safely and effectively at Netflix's scale.
  
  
**Developer Platform - GenAI**
This TPM will focus on translating the Workforce AI Program’s strategy into measurable gains in capacity, delivery speed, quality, and cost efficiency by driving its highest-priority initiatives. You will act as connective tissue across technical and enterprise teams, leaders, and fellow TPMs. This role will align stakeholders, sequence work, manage complex dependencies and risks, and coordinate delivery across AI experiences, platforms, infrastructure, third-party products, and adoption programs. Success requires navigating evolving technologies, ambiguity, and distributed ownership while ensuring AI solutions scale responsibly, securely, and cost-effectively, earn user trust, and consistently connect technical investments to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Data Platform**
This TPM will partner with the Data Platform and Online Data Stores & Movement Platform (ODSMP) engineering team - one of the most foundational and business-critical teams at Netflix. As Netflix builds toward an agentic infrastructure powered by GenAI, demand for real-time, low-latency data patterns - including feature stores, RAG pipelines, and AI-facing retrieval is accelerating, and ODSMP sits at the center of enabling the infrastructure that AI-native products and systems depend on. The TPM in this role will be a strategic partner to the engineering team and will act as the first team member as they navigate that growth, turning a broad, complex technical portfolio into a coherent, managed agentic platform with opinionated paved paths, while strengthening reliability, security, and cost governance at scale. The TPM will lead the team's core operating rhythms, manage the health of our partnerships, and drive technical cross-team programs that move the platform forward.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
A successful candidate will have experience driving large-scale technical programs across infrastructure and will be energized by the opportunity to help shape how AI and agentic systems are built and operated at scale. They will be comfortable operating in technical ambiguity, applying systems thinking to complex technical environments, influencing technical and strategic direction and translating emerging AI platform needs into executable programs that meaningfully impact thousands of engineers across Netflix.
  
  

* Partner closely with leaders, engineers, PMs, and practitioners to identify, influence and frame net-new problem spaces before they are formally defined, then structure them into technical execution plans with well-defined milestones, ownership, and success criteria.
* Personally drive execution rigor across complex, multi-team programs, tracking progress, managing dependencies, unblocking issues, and owning delivery outcomes end to end while implementing minimal process.
* Influence org-level investment decisions, resource planning, and technical roadmaps in partnership with engineering and product leaders.
* Communicate clearly and consistently with technical leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions.
* Use insights from program execution to influence platform evolution, architectural direction, and operational practices over time.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience leading large-scale technical programs in infrastructure, internal platforms, or distributed systems, including significant time leading programs with org-level scope and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated understanding of the GenAI tech stack, along with experience driving complex GenAI programs across the org.
* Proven experience creating partnerships with cross-functional teams, driving large-scale technical strategies, debating technical approaches, and building long-term scalable solutions with engineers.
* Proven ability to structure ambiguous, undefined technical problem spaces into executable programs, not just manage against a roadmap someone else defined.
* Proven ability to identify gaps in solutions and weigh in on product vs. technology trade-offs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical constraints, trade-offs, and business impact to diverse audiences.
* Understanding of challenges in high-scale distributed systems, architectures, and data layers.

**What sets you apart?**

* You have operated in 0→1 and evolving problem spaces, quickly bringing order and execution discipline.
* You're equally comfortable setting the strategic direction and doing the hands-on work to move it forward, e.g. building the program plan, writing the technical alignment doc, pulling the data, and rallying and running the working group.
* You operate as a strategic thought partner to VPs and Directors, not just a program tracker.
* You enjoy orchestrating programs with many moving parts - people, needs, and technologies.
* You have a deep understanding and point of view within your technical domain(s).
* You have a healthy blend of technical knowledge with a customer-focused mindset and empathy.
* You are a strong systems thinker with the ability to connect infrastructure capabilities to business outcomes.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $420,000.00 - $630,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.
  
  
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.
  
  
Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.
  
  
We're seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) who combines strong technical depth with exceptional organizational and communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and drives execution through ambiguity with confidence and clarity.
  
  
As a TPM at RunPod, you'll play a central role in leading complex, cross-functional programs across product and platform teams. This role sits inside our Supply organization — you'll be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, Data Center Management, and our host partner teams, working to make sure GPU capacity keeps pace with demand. Through strong communication, alignment, and proactive risk management, you'll drive the successful delivery of high-impact programs that keep supply, cost, and reliability in balance for our customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in AI/ML developer platforms, GPU/cloud infrastructure, or other hardware-capacity-constrained environments.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
* Technical degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**What You’ll Receive**

title: Program Manager (VA)
description:
Job Type
  
  
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**Job Summary**
IronArch is seeking an experienced delivery leader to support the Veteran Transition Experience (VTE) program at the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) while providing leadership across an assigned portfolio of IronArch programs.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who is strongest where strategy meets execution. Within VTE, you will operate as a Delivery Lead and Scrum Master, creating the structure, visibility, and delivery discipline that allow cross-functional product teams to do their best work. You will facilitate Agile delivery, surface and resolve blockers, manage risks and dependencies, monitor program health, and ensure contractual reporting and delivery obligations remain on track.
  
  
You will work in a shared ownership model with program and product leadership rather than operating as a traditional, top-down Program Manager. Success requires being close enough to the work to understand what is slowing teams down, while maintaining the broader perspective needed to anticipate risks, connect dependencies, and improve how the program operates.
  
  
Beyond VTE, you will also provide leadership across an assigned portfolio of IronArch programs. This includes maintaining visibility into delivery performance, staffing and risk; supporting customer relationships and escalations; managing and developing delivery personnel; and helping IronArch identify opportunities to strengthen existing programs and grow strategic customer relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*VTE Delivery & Scrum Leadership*

* Own day-to-day delivery for VTE, ensuring teams have the structure, information, and support needed to meet program and contractual objectives.
* Serve as Scrum Master, facilitating sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and other team ceremonies.
* Partner with Product Managers to align team execution with product goals, priorities, and release plans.
* Monitor scope, schedule, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, milestones, and delivery commitments, resolving or escalating issues as needed.
* Coordinate work and dependencies across product, engineering, design, research, analytics, and other functions.
* Track sprint velocity and other delivery measures to understand team capacity, improve predictability, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Lead recurring contractual reporting, including the Monthly COR report, and maintain clear visibility into overall program health.
* Build trusted relationships with VA stakeholders and communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans clearly.
* Support project invoice workflows and coordinate with internal operations and finance partners as needed.
* Establish practical Agile, documentation, and knowledge-management practices that help teams work effectively and maintain continuity.
* Support onboarding and help new team members quickly understand team practices, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.

*Data-Informed Delivery & Reporting*

* Develop clear reporting that gives IronArch and VA stakeholders meaningful visibility into delivery progress, risks, trends, and outcomes.
* Use delivery metrics such as velocity, schedule performance, risks, operational measures, and available product data to identify trends and support decision-making.
* Help evolve reporting beyond activity tracking toward measures that demonstrate delivery performance and product outcomes.

*Portfolio Leadership*
In addition to VTE delivery responsibilities, this role will provide leadership across an assigned IronArch portfolio.
  
  

* Maintain a synthesized view of delivery performance, staffing, and risk across assigned contracts.
* Serve as an escalation point for client and contract delivery issues and help stabilize programs when additional leadership support is needed.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers across the assigned portfolio.
* Review Program Manager forecasts and monitor portfolio-level staffing, delivery, and financial health in partnership with Finance and IronArch leadership.
* Participate in IronArch's Delivery Operations cadence and contribute portfolio updates to Business Health Reviews and Monthly Business Reviews.
* Manage assigned Program Managers, Associate Program Managers, or other delivery personnel, including coaching, performance feedback, reviews, and development planning.
* Mentor delivery leaders and help strengthen delivery practices across programs.
* Support strategic account planning and identify potential growth opportunities within existing customer relationships.
* Partner with IronArch leadership and other capability leaders when programs require additional technical, operational, or delivery support.

**Requirements**
Must Have
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Significant experience leading delivery for complex digital product or technology programs.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master, Delivery Lead, Agile Delivery Manager, or in a comparable hands-on delivery role.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, release planning, velocity, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams that may include product management, engineering, design, research, analytics, and operations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and manage delivery risks, blockers, dependencies, schedules, and competing priorities.
* Experience developing program or contract reporting for customers and organizational leadership.
* Experience working directly with government or enterprise customers and communicating effectively with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
* Experience managing and developing employees, including coaching and performance feedback.
* Ability to move comfortably between hands-on team delivery and broader program or portfolio-level concerns.
* Strong facilitation, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to create structure and clarity in complex or ambiguous delivery environments.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Current authorization/onboarding to work with the Department of Veterans Affairs.
* Previous experience supporting VA, VHA, or other federal civilian technology programs.
* Experience supporting Veteran-facing digital products or digital health services.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) or similar analytics platforms, including using product data to develop meaningful reporting and connect delivery decisions to measurable product outcomes.
* Experience turning product analytics and delivery data into dashboards, reports, or actionable recommendations.
* Experience with GitHub, Mural, Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration and delivery-management tools.
* Experience with government contract reporting, invoice workflows, staffing forecasts, and contract performance monitoring.
* Experience managing delivery across multiple contracts or programs.
* Experience supporting account growth, capture, proposals, or other business development activities.

**Impact & Success:**
Success in this role means VTE can focus on delivering valuable outcomes because delivery is organized, risks and dependencies are visible, blockers are addressed quickly, and stakeholders have a clear picture of program health. Across your broader portfolio, success means IronArch leadership has an accurate view of program health, delivery leaders receive the coaching and support they need, customer concerns are addressed early, and programs are positioned for sustainable delivery and growth.
  
  
Salary Description
  
  
$130,000 - $140,000

title: Senior Product Manager, Field Systems (Salesforce)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
Smartsheet is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Field Systems team, the group responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling the commercial go-to market tools including CRM, e-signature, opportunity management, sales engagement, marketing automation, and forecasting platforms. You will own the product roadmap and serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and an agile delivery team to ensure the right work gets prioritized, scoped, and shipped at the right time.
  
  
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise systems, business strategy, and Scaled agile execution. You'll thrive here if you love translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, leveraging modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, and partnering closely with sales, marketing, finance, and customer success to drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
You will report to our Director, Field Systems. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.
  
  
**You Will**

* Partner with the Director of Field Systems to define, maintain, and communicate a prioritized product roadmap aligned to company go-to-market objectives
* Continuously assess the value, urgency, and feasibility of roadmap initiatives to ensure the team is always working on the highest-impact problems
* Translate strategic priorities into quarterly PI (Program Increment) objectives within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
* Engage directly with internal stakeholders including Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Technical Support to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and business goals
* Define clear epics, features, and user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria.
* Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to inform solution design
* Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to accelerate requirements documentation, synthesize stakeholder feedback, draft communications, and surface insights from data bringing a modern, AI-augmented approach to everyday PM work
* Serve as the Product Owner for the agile team, owning and grooming the team backlog to ensure a healthy queue of well-refined work
* Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and System Demos
* Make real-time prioritization and trade-off decisions to keep the team moving and unblocked
* Maintain transparent, proactive communication with stakeholders on roadmap status, delivery timelines, and change impacts
* Build trust with business partners by consistently delivering on commitments and surfacing risks early
* Collaborate with change management and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities
* Define success metrics for features and initiatives; track outcomes post-deployment and use data to inform future prioritization
* Drive retrospective insights from delivery into roadmap refinement and team process improvements

**You Have**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on go-to market tools and platform products in an enterprise environment
* Demonstrated experience working within SAFe or agile framework, including PI Planning and cross-team coordination
* Strong product sense with experience balancing user needs, business value, and technical feasibility
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present confidently to senior leaders and technical teams alike
* Experience writing detailed epics and features, lean business cases, and user stories with strong assumptions and acceptance criteria
* Comfort with data including the ability to query data, interpret metrics, and build business cases
* Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification
* Experience supporting sales operations, revenue operations, or marketing operations functions
* Familiarity with CPQ, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud implementations
* Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) applied to PM workflows such as documentation, research, or analysis.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification
* Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

**Current US Perks & Benefits**

* Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
* 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
* Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
* Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
* US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
* US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
* Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
* Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
* Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
* Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
* Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

*Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.*
US Base Salary Pay Range
  
  
$135,000 - $176,250 USD
  
  
**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

title: CMC Project Manager/Senior CMC Project Manager, Research & Development
description:
Job Type
  
  
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
Reports to: Director, Technical Project Management, Research & Development (R&D)
  
  
Location: Remote Work (US Only)
  
  
**Why Sabin**
Our mission is to make vaccines more accessible, enable innovation and expand immunization across the globe. We seek a future free from vaccine-preventable diseases. We are an innovative, collaborative, and engaged team that values accountability, teamwork, partnership and driving impact. We are vaccine champions improving lives through immunization. Sabin staff, management and the Board of Trustees are committed to ensuring that fairness, integrity, and opportunity remain at the core of how we operate.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The CMC Project Manager/Senior Project Manager leads cross-functionally to ensure planning and delivery of Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls activities across the vaccine development lifecycle. In partnership with CMC and Program leadership, this role translates strategy into integrated plans and ensures execution remains aligned with program objectives, contractual commitments, budgets, and milestones.
  
  
The CMC Project Manager coordinates internally as well as externally with service providers (e.g., Contract Manufacturers and Laboratories) and other partners. The role establishes clear deliverables, owners, dependencies, and decision points; monitors performance against plans; and holds teams and service providers accountable for timely execution, decision-making, transparent information sharing, and risk management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Project Management
  
  

* Develop and improve project management tools and practices that strengthen planning, transparency, communication, and execution.
* Lead the day-to-day planning and management of drug product process development service providers and corresponding activities, coordinating deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and cross-functional inputs to maintain alignment with CMC strategy and program milestones.
* Provide clear updates to Program leadership, governance bodies, funders, and other stakeholders.
* Contribute to the continued development of R&D project management standards and capabilities.

Strategy and Integrated Planning
  
  

* Partner with Program and CMC leadership to translate development strategy into integrated CMC plans, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, and deliverables.
* Develop and manage integrated and logic-linked schedules that enable identification of critical path, decision points, assumptions, and schedule risks.
* Critically evaluate plans, dependencies, and assumptions to ensure resulting schedules are realistic and aligned with program priorities and commitments.
* Assess changes in scope, strategy, or assumptions and communicate the impact on schedules, cost, resources, risk, and downstream activities.

Execution and Accountability
  
  

* Plan and execute meetings that promote alignment, resolve conflicts, accelerate decisions, and maintain progress against the plan.
* Hold internal teams and service providers accountable for accurate status reporting, timely escalation, schedule integration, and delivery of work to schedule and budget.
* Maintain effective project controls, including alignment driving agendas and meeting minutes, schedules, action and decision logs, risk registers, and milestone reporting.
* Monitor and control progress against plans, identify variances, and partner with accountable leads to implement corrective or recovery actions.
* Coordinate activities across sub team and working groups, contract manufacturers, testing laboratories, consultants, and other partners.
* Ensure decisions, risks, changes, and dependencies are communicated to affected stakeholders.
* Model and reinforce program governance, decision-making, and escalation processes.

Financial, Contractual, and Resource Management
  
  

* Partner with Finance, functional leaders, and Earned Value Management personnel to manage budgets, forecasts, actuals, and variance analysis.
* Identify financial, resource, or capacity constraints and work with accountable leads to develop corrective actions.
* Partner with technical staff and Grants & Contracts to support prime contract and subcontractor planning and execution.
* Facilitate the development of statements of work, requests for proposals, proposal evaluations, service providers’ plans, basis of estimate, and contract modifications.
* Manage service providers, ensuring delivery of contractual milestones, deliverables, and to budgets expectations.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in scientific, engineering, pharmaceutical, or related discipline; advanced degree and/or PMP certification preferred
* 7+ years of relevant experience in Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 vaccine/biologic project management; demonstrated skills and experience in planning and leading complex, multi-year, integrated product development programs with multiple funding partners and service providers
* Working knowledge of the CMC lifecycle from early development through validation, regulatory submission, and commercialization
* Experience supporting U.S. Government or other funding partners contractually rigorous planning, forecasting, and reporting expectations is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and managing integrated schedules, critical paths, dependencies, and recovery plans
* Experience managing service providers, including CDMOs, CROs, and testing laboratories
* Advanced experience using MS Project and Smartsheet
* Experience using Microsoft 365 applications, including MS Teams and SharePoint
* Experience with Pharma industry governance practices
* Experience with Earned Value Management and project controls
* Demonstrated ability to hold teams and service providers accountable in a matrixed environment
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to be flexible and optimistic
* Strong attention to detail, ability to manage complex tasks, highly organized, dependable and able to prioritize competing demands to meet deadlines
* Ability to process information quickly and listen carefully to feedback and comments from staff and adapt plans/actions accordingly
* Ability to travel approximately 10-20% domestically and internationally with notice

**Other**

* Subject to a criminal background investigation
* Request for three professional references
* Verification of education/degrees
* Commitment to furthering Sabin’s mission

Sabin’s philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased, equitable, competitive compensation, and benefits. Using benchmarking and salary survey data, the annual salary for this position ranges from $108,000 - $164,000. The exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, training, and certifications/degree. As a grant-funded organization, Sabin actively seeks funding for existing and new programs.
  
  
Sabin provides a comprehensive benefits package for eligible, featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as flexible spending accounts. Eligible employees enjoy flexible vacation leave, sick leave, and both short-term and long-term disability options. The organization observes 10 federal holidays plus an end of the year winter break. Additionally, Sabin offers an employer matching 401(k) plan.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
  
  
**Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies**
Recruitment vendors may not contact Sabin hiring managers, executives, or employees and must have an executed agreement on file. Unsolicited resumes do not create an agreement, and Sabin is not responsible for related fees.
  
  
Sabin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability or genetic information, sex (including gender identity, pregnancy or sexual orientation), marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

title: Technical Program Manager - System Integration
description:

We are looking for a TPM/System Integration Test Lead to join our team at a top consumer electronics company in Cupertino, CA! This is your chance to work with industry leaders, drive innovation, and play a crucial role in the manufacturing test readiness of world-class products.

As the lead, you will work alongside a team of highly skilled Technical Program Managers, ensuring seamless execution of system-level testing for next-generation consumer technology. If you're passionate about problem-solving, thrive under pressure, and enjoy working with cross-functional teams to bring products to life, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee preparation and execution of test readiness activities, including managing the transition from Surface-Mount Technology (SMT) to final assembly across all phases of product New Product Introduction (NPI) development
* Plan, execute and complete build dry runs to ensure manufacturing test readiness for NPI builds, identifying potential issues before full production and generating daily build reports in clear, regular updates to engineers
* Quickly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve any test-related issues that arise during the build process, ensuring minimal disruption and maintaining timelines
* Create and implement strategic plans for addressing problems, ensuring timely and effective solutions
* Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless communication and alignment on project goals and deliverables
* Regularly track and report on the status of test progress, readiness, and outcomes, ensuring transparency and accountability throughout the project lifecycle
* Continuously refine and improve test processes and methodologies to enhance quality, efficiency, and product maturity, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices
* Ensure product test quality standard and manufacturing criteria are met

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* BS or MS System/EE/SW Degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience on product engineering testing, development
* Deep understanding of system and hardware fundamentals and a background in the design of complex systems
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead & thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Understands and deals well with rapid New Product Development cycles; remains flexible when faced with uncertainty and changes in direction
* Experience with failure analysis and troubleshooting
* Excellent communication, organizational, presentation and leadership skills with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly
* Self motivated and proactive with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities
* Proficient in MacOS, iOS

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in managing cross-functional teams and collaborating with international Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) partners to facilitate the mass production of consumer electronics products
* Manufacturing testing methodologies (HW & SW test validation)
* Experience with program management is a plus
* Prior experience with one or more of the following technologies: Acoustics, Display, Touch, Imaging Sensors, Motion Sensors, PCBA, Power or Battery

**Type:**
12+months, multi-year engagement

**Location:**
Cupertino, CA (Hybrid, Tuesdays - Thursdays Onsite)

$80/hr - $105/hr (DOE)

* 3-5 years of customer-facing work experience in healthcare implementation
  
* Track record of applying strong quantitative and analytical skills in prior roles
  
* A maniacal obsession with customer happiness, success, and retention. You’re the type of person who will move mountains to solve problems and make people successful

* Foundational knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and/or CSS
  
* Understanding of healthcare IT systems and data
  
* Experience with project management and facilitating change management

* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to overcoming challenges
  
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 35-50% nationwide
  
  

**BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE**

  
* Master's degree in business or healthcare field
  
* Background in perioperative services, including knowledge of surgical workflows
  
* Experience and passion for process improvement (Lean or Six Sigma training a strong plus)
  
* Intermediate JavaScript skills
  
* EMR integration experience (e.g. HL7, FHIR, Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth)
  
* Healthcare software customization experience
  
* Experience with Pendo Guide, ZenDesk
  
* Project management certification
  
* Healthcare IT implementation experience
  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL GET**

* Competitive compensation package that includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options
  
* 401(k) Match

title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
description:
**Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a
**Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero**
to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

**What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

**Who are we looking for?**

**Skills & Abilities**

* You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
* You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.
* You treat the program's problems as your own. You move on things before being asked, you measure yourself by outcomes rather than activity, and you find the faster path and take it.
* You drive results through influence, not authority. You create alignment with engineering teams, Sales, and the CPO's org by understanding what each team needs and making it easy for them to say yes.
* You're comfortable applying AI to your own work: drafting, research, analysis, and wherever else it frees you for the judgment calls that matter. Genuine curiosity about what AI can and cannot do is part of what makes someone thrive here, especially in a role that's also responsible for making AI credible to customers.
* You translate clearly between business stakeholders (GTM, CX, G&A) and technical teams. You know enough about the systems to design processes, not just manage a backlog.
* You're credible on stage and in a boardroom. Executive presence is real for this role: you will represent Celigo externally and need customers and prospects to trust what you say.
* You use data (adoption, usage, outcomes) to prioritize, to influence colleagues and executives, and to know early when something isn't working.

**Education & Experience**

* 8+ years in product management, comfortable operating hands-on as a Principal individual contributor while owning a program end-to-end.
* Deep functional experience in GTM and/or CX operations and the systems that run them (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar), sufficient to design the processes, not just manage the backlog.
* Track record of running an internal-as-first-customer, dogfooding, or Customer Zero program, or standing up a Product function where one didn't exist.
* Experience building and packaging reference stories or proof points that Sales and Marketing can use externally.
* Preferred: background with SaaS, iPaaS, integration, or automation platforms, and comfort with AI-first or agentic products.
* Preferred: hands-on experience using the product you support internally.
* Preferred: close partnership with a CPO or Product org to influence a public roadmap.

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a
**base**
salary between $175,000 and $200,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

**Celigo is proud to be**

* A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award.
* Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
* Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.
* Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

**Here you'll experience**

* Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency
* A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented
* Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field
* Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

+ Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)
+ Wellness days and holidays to recharge
+ Parental leave and a generous benefits package
+ Monthly tech stipend
+ Recognition and career development opportunities

**Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility**

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about

Taking a Stand

.

Celigo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Project Manager - Marine Structures
description:
**Overview**
**Join us as we Rise to the Challenge**
At KCI, we’re building an enduring community that provides unparalleled value to our employee-owners. We make our mark designing and delivering our world-class solutions, so we invest deeply in supporting and developing our team. We reward integrity and commitment, and when we do well, you do well. Our employee’s have the freedom to innovate, unlimited growth, a voice that matters, a lifestyle that works, and skin in the game. Achievements are shared and celebrated. As a team, we are motivated to better ourselves, each other, and the world around us.
  
  
**The Company**
KCI Technologies, Inc. is a 100% employee-owned engineering, consulting and construction firm serving clients throughout the United States. KCI is recognized as an industry leader, employing cutting-edge technologies, management practices and strategic growth initiatives. Employee ownership fosters an entrepreneurial spirit, encourages technical expertise, and shapes strategic planning.
  
  
KCI is currently ranked #53 on Engineering News-Record’s list of the Top 500 design firms in the nation.
  
  
**Kci Benefits Information**
We offer a competitive compensation package, family friendly benefits, a collaborative working environment, and the training, mentoring and resources you need to advance in your career.
  
  
We understand that you have choices, and we know that together we will make a great team!
  
  
**KCI is committed to building a diverse and inclusive staff, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply.**
KCI Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.
  
  
**Duties, Responsibilities & Other**
The Senior Project Manager represents the highest level in KCI's Project Management career path. This role provides strategic leadership and technical oversight for complex condition assessment, failure investigation, and rehabilitation programs across piers, wharves, bulkheads, seawalls, breakwaters, dolphins, mooring systems, and other coastal and waterfront structures.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in expanding KCI's marine inspection practice, strengthening client relationships across public and private maritime markets, and guiding teams to deliver defensible, technically rigorous assessments that owners can act on. The Senior Project Manager ensures seamless coordination among inspection teams, dive crews, engineers, laboratories, contractors, and stakeholders while managing the safety and logistical demands of overwater and underwater work.
  
  
**Project Management Leadership and Execution**

* Lead and manage marine inspection and forensic engineering projects, including above-water and underwater condition assessments, routine and special inspections, damage investigations, load ratings, and remaining service life evaluations.
* Direct multidisciplinary teams consisting of engineer-divers, marine structural engineers, geotechnical and coastal engineers, NDT technicians, surveyors, and materials specialists.
* Develop and communicate comprehensive inspection work plans, defining scope, level of effort, access methods, documentation standards, dive safety requirements, and reporting deliverables.
* Manage project scope and change control, particularly when field findings expand the investigation beyond the original scope.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, proactively identifying risks related to tides, currents, water clarity, weather windows, vessel traffic, and facility operations.
* Oversee project budgets and cash flow, with attention to inspection-specific cost drivers such as dive spreads, vessel and barge support, specialty testing, and laboratory work.
* Serve as the primary client liaison for port authorities, municipalities, state DOTs, USACE, NAVFAC, USCG, private terminal operators, and facility owners.
* Apply deep knowledge of marine deterioration mechanisms — corrosion and section loss, marine borer attack, timber decay, concrete spalling and delamination, chloride intrusion, fatigue, scour and undermining, vessel impact, and overload — to interpret findings and advise clients.

**Forensic Investigation and Failure Analysis**

* Lead forensic investigations of marine structural failures, distress, and damage events, including vessel allisions, storm and surge damage, collapse, and progressive deterioration.
* Establish root cause through field observation, materials testing, structural analysis, review of design and construction records, and reconstruction of loading conditions.
* Prepare clear, defensible forensic reports suitable for owners, insurers, and legal proceedings.
* Provide expert witness and litigation support, including depositions, testimony, and technical rebuttal, as needed.
* Advise clients on emergency response, interim stabilization, and load restrictions following damage events.

**Training, Development, and Compliance**

* Mentor and develop Project Managers, engineers, and engineer-divers within the Marine group, strengthening KCI's internal inspection and forensic expertise.
* Ensure compliance with KCI policies, the Quality Management System (QMS), and marine inspection best practices.
* Lead development and implementation of dive and overwater safety plans, including compliance with ADCI Consensus Standards, OSHA commercial diving regulations (29 CFR 1910 Subpart T), and USCG requirements.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Federal, state, and local regulations and inspection protocols, including USACE, NAVFAC UFC waterfront inspection criteria, NBIS requirements for underwater bridge inspection, and state and port authority standards.

**Financial Management and Reporting**

* Negotiate contracts, scopes, and fees with clients, subconsultants, dive contractors, and testing laboratories.
* Prepare and manage client and subconsultant contracts.
* Achieve or exceed utilization targets (typically 70–80%) while supporting practice growth.
* Track and report project performance metrics, budgets, WIP, AR, and cash flow monthly.
* Prepare monthly project progress and completion reports and present results at Project Review Meetings.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through improved inspection technology, data collection methods, and reporting workflows.

**Business Development and Market Growth**

* Serve as a key leader in growing KCI's marine inspection and forensic practice, identifying opportunities in asset management programs, multi-year inspection contracts, resiliency assessments, and post-event response work.
* Participate in go/no-go decisions, teaming strategies, and preparation of inspection-focused proposals and SOQs.
* Lead and support client presentations, pursuit strategies, and interviews.
* Strengthen relationships with port authorities, coastal municipalities, maritime agencies, insurers, and facility owners.
* Support marketing efforts through project write-ups, photography, technical thought leadership, and conference participation.
* Actively participate in at least one marine, maritime, coastal, or industry organization (e.g., PIANC, ASCE Coasts, Oceans, Ports & Rivers Institute, AMPP, ADCI, CMAA).

**Technical Oversight and Field Execution**

* Provide full oversight of inspection, assessment, and forensic deliverables required by contract.
* Conduct and oversee site visits, underwater and above-water inspections, and field assessments in active waterfront and marine environments.
* Oversee application of inspection and testing methods, including Level I/II/III underwater inspection, ultrasonic thickness testing, half-cell potential and corrosion surveys, concrete coring and chloride sampling, timber probing and boring, GPR, sonar and hydrographic survey, and photogrammetry or LiDAR documentation.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, specifications, geotechnical reports, hydrographic surveys, and historical inspection records to establish baseline conditions.
* Compare field conditions and inspection data to original design assumptions and identify deviations, deficiencies, and rates of deterioration.
* Lead or oversee preparation of condition assessment reports, structural evaluations, load ratings, repair and rehabilitation plans, and prioritized capital planning recommendations.
* Maintain current knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including ASCE Waterfront Facilities Inspection and Assessment, AASHTO, ACI, AISC, USACE Engineer Manuals, UFC criteria, PIANC guidance, and ASTM testing standards.

**Qualifications**
**Education and/or Skills Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in related field (AEC Industry) and minimum of 6 years of related professional experience, or 10 years of equivalent

professional experience.
  
  

* Experience should include a track record of expanding project management duties.
* Proven experience in project management roles, with a focus on managing larger-scale projects or programs.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Proficiency in project management software and tools, with the ability to develop and maintain comprehensive project plans and

documentation.
  
  

* Knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to project management, quality assurance, and safety protocols.
* Effective problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and implement solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong negotiation skills to manage contracts, scope changes, and stakeholder agreements effectively.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles to effectively manage project budgets, financial reporting, and resource allocation.

**Education And/or Work Experience Preferred**

* Master’s Degree in related field (AEC Industry)

**Certificates, Licenses, And/or Registrations Required**

* Ability to complete the KCI PM Training and Contract Risk Training along with passing the PM Board within 6 months of start date.

Pre-employment drug screening and background check are conditions of employment. Motor vehicle checks may be required based upon position.

****Role Overview****
The MMM Product Specialist is a critical bridge role responsible for the successful implementation of Tinuiti's Bliss Point Data Scientific MMM Products. This role engages pre-SOW signing and stays closely involved through data onboarding and the client's first model readout — ensuring every engagement is technically sound, strategically set up, and delivered on time.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a strong technical background, the ability to interpret complex model outputs and translate them into actionable insights, and the communication skills to coach and enable client-facing teams. Strong technical project management — coordinating stakeholders and holding teams to milestones — is essential, as is a comfort with process engineering and automation to make deployments more scalable over time.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Product Scoping: Partner with Sales pre-SOW to assess product-client fit, define the right model scope (e.g., DTC vs. DTC and Commerce), and provide input on SOW language to ensure commitments are accurate and achievable.
* Technical Onboarding: Support end-to-end data onboarding for all MMM engagements, serving as the primary technical resource for client data questions while partnering with Client Reporting, Client Delivery, and Econometrics.
* Pre-Readout Enablement: Partner with Client Delivery to prepare for the first model readout — helping the team understand model outputs and coaching them on how to use our toolkit to frame budget recommendations and strategic decisions for the client.
* Client Data Science Engagement: Lead methodology walkthroughs for client data science teams, fielding technical questions about model construction, assumptions, and outputs.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the central point of contact across Client Reporting, Econometrics, Sales, and Client Delivery — ensuring continuity, preventing over-promising, and holding stakeholders accountable to timelines.
* AI-Powered Efficiency & Process Optimization: Identify and implement opportunities to use AI tools, agents, and automation to make workflows faster and more scalable. Standardize implementation processes into practical, repeatable products.
* Product Feedback: Synthesize engagement patterns and client feedback to inform feature development and improve the overall offering.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Mathematical Proficiency: Strong background in data analysis, statistics, or a related technical field — able to understand model methodologies and explain outputs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements — building timelines, sequencing dependencies, and holding cross-functional partners accountable without direct authority.
* Data Literacy: Comfort in the "messy middle" of data and user needs, with an ability to simplify complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
* Strategic Communication: Able to translate the "why" behind the "what" for internal stakeholders and external clients, including C-suite executives and client data science teams.
* Proactive Ownership: A "Maker's Mindset" — proposes solutions and drives projects forward with minimal hand-holding.
* Collaboration & Engineering Empathy: Experience partnering with model builders on technical hand-offs and QA.
* Client-Facing Experience: Comfortable with C-level executives and technical decision-makers; experience in a customer-facing or new-business-oriented role is a plus.
* Automation & AI Fluency: Demonstrated comfort using AI tools and automation to improve process efficiency, with a curiosity to keep pushing that capability forward.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, and alignment with market data. Portfolio Delivery & Execution

* Lead IMS coordination and develop schedule recovery strategies to maintain critical project and portfolio milestones.
* Reinforce safety ownership throughout the projects in strict adherence to company safety policies.

Client and Cross Functional Relationships
  
  

* Serve as the lead point of contact for assigned portfolio building trust through consistent performance and transparency.
* Coordinate across disciplines to ensure seamless project integration and handoff to operations.
* Drive alignment across internal and external leadership teams.
* Lead executive level reporting and presentations for assigned portfolio.

Financial Management
  
  

* Responsible for overall budget management and cost control for assigned portfolio.
* Accountable for reviewing and approving vendor invoices as necessary.
* Review and approve client invoices via Procore.
* Review change orders with stakeholders and resolutions to prevent delays and mitigate financial risk.
* In partnership with Project Controls, review cost forecasting aligned with schedule and procurement strategy.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Contribute to initiatives that improve construction processes, safety practices, and overall efficiency across T5 Data Centers’ growing portfolio.
* Incorporate lessons learned to drive continuous improvement and delivery excellence.
* Coach and mentor direct report(s).

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent data center experience, required
* 4+ years Project Management experience, required
* Data center development and/or data center construction experience, required
* Substation design experience, preferred

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Senior Implementation Consultant in Avalara's Professional Services organization, you will serve as a subject matter expert leading the delivery of large, complex, and high-visibility enterprise implementations for Avalara’s Excise platforms (AvaTax for Energy, Returns for Energy, AvaTax for Tobacco and Returns for Tobacco).
  
  
You will own the technical architecture and tax determination strategy for multi-jurisdiction, high-volume energy distributors, suppliers, and terminal operators. In addition to customer delivery, you will serve as a technical escalation lead, drive practice-wide standards, collaborate with external implementation partners, and mentor consultants across the team.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
Enterprise Solution Architecture & Delivery
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of complex, multi-tiered enterprise implementations involving multi-entity structures, complex supply chains, cross-border movements (US/Canada), and custom ERP/connector integrations.
* Architect custom calculation logic, and complex schedule/return mappings across high-volume transaction datasets.
* Facilitate advanced architectural and functional design workshops with enterprise tax directors, IT leadership, and systems integrators.
* Lead system integration testing (SIT) and UAT strategy, troubleshooting complex race conditions, caching behaviors, and data schema discrepancies.
* Manage project technical risk, proactively mitigating scope drift and identifying architectural constraints early.

Practice Leadership & Escalation Management
  
  

* Act as a senior escalation point for critical customer issues, complex data anomalies, and unresolved tax determination and compliance challenges.
* Partner with Product Management, Core Engineering, and Support to diagnose root causes (e.g., platform performance, caching, connector bugs) and advocate for platform enhancements.
* Collaborate with and provide technical governance for third-party implementation partners
* Participate in pre-sales discovery, scoping calls, and Level-of-Effort (LOE) estimations for complex or custom enterprise opportunities.

Mentorship & Practice Excellence
  
  

* Eligible to serve as Team Lead, providing technical coaching, peer review, and quality assurance for consultants.
* Lead the creation of standardized implementation templates, automated validation scripts, and training curricula.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise software implementation, tax technology consulting, systems integration, or technical solution delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* In-depth subject matter expertise in excise/fuel and taxation, oil & gas supply chains, terminal operations, or indirect tax systems.
* Advanced technical troubleshooting skills (APIs, SQL/database queries, data transformation pipelines, ERP data structures).
* Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders (C-level, Tax Directors, Enterprise Architects) and lead cross-functional technical teams without direct authority.

**Preferred**

* Prior hands-on experience configuring Avalara Excise platforms (ATE, ARE,) or similar tax engines
* Deep knowledge of ERP ecosystems (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP Cloud, PDI Enterprise, JD Edwards).

**Pay Range Details**
The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may different in other locations.
  
  
Colorado $88,000-$140,800 [annually]
  
  
Washington $88,000-$155,700 [annually]
  
  
California $88,000-$170,300 [annually]
  
  
NYC $97,100-$170,300 [annually]
  
  
The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business consideration
  
  
This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
