title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager-Service Intelligence
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

#### Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace. As **Senior Staff Technical Product Manager** **– Service Intelligence** for a confidential digital initiative, you will lead the strategy and execution of a foundational backend intelligence platform that powers critical decision‑making across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail and service ecosystem. 

This role focuses on designing a backend‑driven decisioning and orchestration system that evaluates complex, interdependent operational inputs to produce reliable, scalable outcomes in real time. The platform is being built ahead of Start of Operations and will play a central role in how Scout coordinates resources, responds to events, and enables consistent execution across locations. This role operates at a cross-domain level, shaping how multiple systems, products, and operational workflows interact through centralized decision intelligence.  

Initially, there is no end‑user interface or traditional UX design responsibility associated with this position; success is defined by system behavior, decision quality, and operational outcomes. 

This is a deeply technical, AI‑driven and analytical role requiring strong systems thinking and comfort operating in a highly ambiguous, 0‑to‑1 environment. The successful candidate will help shape core capabilities from the ground up, owning both initial delivery and long‑term evolution of a mission‑critical intelligence platform while maintaining strict discretion around sensitive product details. 

#### What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Define and Lead Strategy 

- Define, evolve, and drive the product and ecosystem strategy for a confidential, intelligence‑driven core platform supporting Scout’s operations and service experience.
- Define how complex operational signals, constraints, and policies are modeled into automated decision logic.
- Lead early-stage platform definition ahead of Start of Operations, building foundational capabilities with no existing baseline.
- Accountable for system performance across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail network, ensuring decisions are reliable, explainable, and scalable.
- Influence senior leadership and align platform strategy with long-term company objectives while protecting sensitive capabilities.
- Identify new problem spaces and expansion opportunities for decision intelligence across additional domains and systems.

Complex Decisioning & Problem Solving 

- Frame and solve highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems through intelligent system design and decision frameworks.
- Model operational constraints, dependencies, and priorities as structured logic, rules, or machine‑assisted decision frameworks.
- Drive solutions where “missing inputs” require downstream actions to resolve constraints rather than blocking outcomes.
- Navigate ambiguity inherent to 0‑to‑1 product development, making informed tradeoffs as requirements and dependencies evolve.
- Evaluate tradeoffs involving accuracy, speed, scalability, and explainability, including intangible system behaviors.
- Ensure system behavior is consistent, explainable, auditable, and adaptable as business rules change.

Lead Product Development 

- Guide product development across multiple related initiatives, teams, and domains to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
- Lead end‑to‑end product development for a highly complex, logic‑heavy platform from concept through scale.
- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Analytics, AI/ML teams, IT, and Operations to:
- Translate operational needs into system logic and technical requirements.
- Define data models, decision flows, signal ingestion, and output generation.
- Balance deterministic rules with AI‑assisted approaches where appropriate.
- Ensure platform extensibility as new use cases and domains are added over time.
- Establish best practices and frameworks for decisioning platforms adopted across related systems and teams.

AI & Intelligence Enablement 

- Champion the use of AI, machine reasoning, and advanced analytics to enable scalable decision‑making.
- Define where AI augments human decision processes versus fully automated execution.
- Ensure models and logic are transparent, testable, and continuously improvable.
- Collaborate with data partners to ensure high‑quality inputs, feedback loops, and monitoring.

Stakeholder Leadership 

- Influence and align senior leadership, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders on strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs.
- Serve as a trusted partner to Business, Software Engineering, fellow Digital Product Customer Experience team, and Leadership teams.
- Translate complex, cross‑functional needs into a shared technical and product vision without exposing sensitive strategy externally.
- Lead alignment across teams with differing priorities, timelines, and constraints.
- Build long‑term trust in the platform through transparency, reliability, and outcomes.

Operationalize a Pre‑Launch Platform 

- Build readiness for a mission‑critical platform before Start of Operations.
- Define rollout strategies, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and manual override paths.
- Ensure the platform supports consistent execution independent of location or context.
- Define scalable operating models for how decision intelligence is embedded across systems and workflows.

Drive Technical Excellence 

- Drive architectural decisions across systems, data flows, and integrations, balancing long-term scalability with short-term delivery needs.

- Partner with Scrum and platform teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure architectures.

- Define best practices for real‑time decisioning systems, data latency, reliability, and observability.

- Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in logic complexity, system dependencies, and edge cases.

- Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, privacy, and compliance standards.
- Treat the platform as a living system, ensuring post-launch stability and continuous evolution.

Own Live Decision Intelligence 

- Own system behavior and decision quality once the platform is live, ensuring outcomes are accurate, explainable, and aligned with operational intent.
- Monitor real-world system decisions to identify gaps, edge cases, and unintended outcomes.
- Lead continuous tuning of logic, rules, thresholds, and AI-driven decision frameworks based on live data.
- Define criteria for acceptable system behavior, including fallback paths, overrides, and escalation mechanisms.
- Use system insights to influence product strategy and operational decision-making at a broader organizational level

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

- The role will be based out of a Scout Motors location in **Fremont, California.**
- This role requires 1-3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.
- Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

#### What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

- 12+ years of product management experience with deep focus on technical platforms, complex systems, or decisioning engines.
- Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product, engineering, or business context
- Proven experience leading 0‑to‑1 products in pre‑launch, startup, or transformation environments.
- Track record of building logic‑heavy or intelligence‑driven systems that coordinate multiple inputs and constraints.

Technical Expertise 

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data architectures, and real‑time processing.
- Hands‑on experience working with AI/ML systems, rules engines, optimization problems, or decision frameworks.
- Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, explainability, and scalability.
- Comfort working closely with engineers and data scientists on system design.
- Experience owning backend or platform products where value is delivered through system behavior and decision quality rather than user interfaces.

Skills 

- Demonstrated ability to define strategy in highly ambiguous environments.
- Strong ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholders.
- Exceptional analytical and structured problem‑solving capabilities.
- Ability to define complex logic and decision flows with precision.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complexity without oversharing sensitive information.
- Data‑driven mindset; comfortable working with metrics, experimentation, and system telemetry.
- High tolerance for ambiguity; energized by building something new where the path is not fully defined.

Education 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
- Advanced technical degree or MBA preferred.
- AI-related certification required.

#### What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

- Competitive insurance including:
  - Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
- 401(k) program with:
  - An employer match and immediate vesting
- Generous Paid Time Off including:
  - 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
  - 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
  - Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
  - Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

#### Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $160,000.00 - $192,500.00

Initial California, Washington and New York base salary range = $176,000 - $211,750

Internal leveling code: IC7

**Notice to applicants:**

- To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
- Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*
- Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.*
- Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.*

**Equal Opportunity**

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

description:

Co-founded in 2023 by [Joe Laws](https://www.redcellpartners.com/member/joe-laws/) and [Grant Verstandig](https://www.redcellpartners.com/member/grant-verstandig/), Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. ### About the Role

We are hiring a Staff Technical Program Manager (L6) to lead the delivery of complex AI-enabled products and customer programs across our healthcare portfolio.

As a Staff TPM, you will independently own end-to-end delivery of multi-team, multi-stakeholder healthcare AI programs with significant customer and regulatory complexity. This is a senior individual-contributor role expected to set program standards, coach other program managers, and influence portfolio-level sequencing.

You will sit at the intersection of healthcare operations, product development, engineering, customer delivery, and governance. You will work directly with health systems and healthcare partners to understand their workflows, establish executable delivery plans, and guide programs from discovery and validation through production launch and expansion.

You will create a structure where requirements are incomplete, surface risks before they become blockers, drive decisions across multiple teams, and maintain a clear source of truth for scope, ownership, dependencies, milestones, and readiness. You will also turn lessons from the programs you lead into reusable practices that make subsequent healthcare implementations faster and more predictable.

### What You’ll Do

- Independently lead complex healthcare programs from customer discovery and use-case definition through technical implementation, validation, production launch, and operational transition.
- Partner directly with clinical, operational, IT, security, and executive stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, data environments, integration constraints, and success measures.
- Translate ambiguous customer needs into clear program scope, requirements, milestones, ownership, dependencies, decision points, and measurable exit criteria.
- Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, AI/ML, platform, infrastructure, security, legal, compliance, and customer teams.
- Establish and maintain an authoritative source of truth for plans, risks, decisions, dependencies, validation status, launch readiness, and customer commitments.
- Manage complex dependencies involving EHR systems, customer APIs, identity and access management, clinical protocols, data access, cloud/on-premises infrastructure, and third-party systems.
- Drive healthcare AI-governance readiness, including use-case registration, risk classification, validation planning, audit evidence, customer reviews, approval gates, and production sign-off.
- Define and execute phased validation approaches (de-identified testing, sandbox, shadow mode, controlled rollout, and formal production acceptance) with explicit quality, safety, reliability, privacy, observability, and rollback criteria.
- Prepare and lead customer program reviews, executive readouts, technical working sessions, governance reviews, and go-live readiness assessments.
- Convert deployment lessons into reusable playbooks, onboarding checklists, validation standards, templates, and program-management mechanisms for the healthcare portfolio.
- Surface cross-program conflicts, capacity constraints, and sequencing decisions, and drive the appropriate leaders to resolution.

### Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in technical program management, product delivery, engineering program management, healthcare implementation, or a related role.
- Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional software or platform programs from ambiguous discovery through production adoption.
- Experience delivering technology in healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated environment involving sensitive data and formal approval processes.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and communicating effectively with engineers, product leaders, executives, operational teams, and domain experts.
- Strong technical fluency across software architecture, APIs, integrations, data flows, cloud infrastructure, identity, security, testing, deployment, and production operations.
- Ability to engage deeply with engineering teams, understand technical constraints, challenge assumptions, and translate engineering decisions into program and customer impact.
- Experience managing programs with external dependencies, long lead-time approvals, customer-controlled systems, and competing organizational priorities.
- Strong judgment in balancing delivery speed, customer value, technical quality, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term product maintainability.
- Proven ability to influence decisions and drive accountability across multiple teams without relying on direct authority.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive reporting, decision documentation, risk framing, and customer-facing facilitation.
- Willingness to travel periodically to customer locations for discovery, validation, governance reviews, and production launches.

### Preferred

- Experience delivering software or AI capabilities within health systems, academic medical centers, clinical research organizations, healthcare technology companies, or provider operations.
- Experience with EHR implementations or integrations (e.g., Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner).
- Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and patterns such as FHIR, SMART on FHIR, HL7 v2, CDS Hooks, interface engines, and healthcare APIs.
- Experience managing healthcare privacy, security, and contracting dependencies (PHI, HIPAA, BAAs, audit logging, customer-managed environments).
- Experience with clinical or operational AI-governance processes, model validation, human-in-the-loop workflows, shadow-mode testing, and controlled production rollout.
- Familiarity with AI agents, LLM applications, RAG, guardrails, evaluations, workflow orchestration, and model observability.
- Experience with Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), customer-managed deployments, and secure enterprise software delivery.
- Experience managing programs involving clinical-administrative workflows such as document routing, scheduling, prescription renewal, prior authorization, in-basket management, discharge planning, or clinical research operations.
- Experience building scalable delivery processes that reduce implementation time and customer-specific engineering work across multiple deployments.
- Prior experience in a startup, forward-deployed engineering organization, professional-services environment, or other high-ownership, rapid-execution setting.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

title: Localization Technical Program Manager
description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

SUMMARY

Avetta is seeking a highly skilled **Localization Technical Program Manager** to set technical direction and serve as an embedded partner across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Localization, and Localization Testing. You will make Avetta’s products globally ready by connecting product engineering, localization technology, and release delivery. This hands-on leadership role combines internationalization (i18n) engineering, localization-systems ownership, and technical program leadership to ensure Avetta’s products are designed for global markets and its localization workflows are reliable, scalable, and integrated throughout the product development lifecycle.

You will lead technical delivery across product i18n and the localization technology ecosystem, from early design through release. This includes ownership of Phrase/TMS configuration, APIs and integrations, Avetta’s central platform for AI-enabled translation, workflow automation, release readiness, and technical enablement for the localization team. You will establish standards, guide implementation, and help resolve complex technical and process issues. The role requires a highly specialized combination of deep i18n knowledge and hands-on localization systems expertise. Targeted i18n and localization quality metrics may be used to identify issues and guide improvements, but analytics and reporting are not the primary focus of the role.

**If residing within commutable distance to one of our offices, a hybrid schedule would be required (3 days in office, 2 days work from home).  Candidates within commutable distance are preferred, but those outside of an office area may be considered on a remote basis.**

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design and implement i18n solutions within the software development lifecycle, including string externalization, resource-file architecture, Unicode and encoding support, and scalable patterns for locale-aware product behavior.
- Define and review locale behavior across products, including pluralization, grammatical variants, date, time, number, and currency formats, time zones, sorting, and other regional conventions.
- Ensure product readiness for right-to-left (RTL) languages and protect variables, placeholders, markups, and other non-translatable elements throughout content and translation workflows.
- Partner with Localization Testing to support pseudo-localization, functional validation, defect triage, and release readiness.
- Own and administer Phrase or a comparable Translation Management System (TMS), including project and workflow configuration, translation memories, termbases, quality settings, permissions, automation, and lifecycle governance.

IDEAL EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience building or supporting localization APIs and integrations; familiarity with formats and technologies such as JSON, XML, XLIFF, ICU MessageFormat, REST APIs, webhooks, source control, and CI/CD is strongly preferred.
- Experience designing AI-enabled products and workflows, including LLM and Machine Translation integrations, prompt design, API-based orchestration, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop quality controls.
- Strong technical program management, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience working in Agile software development and release environments across Product, Engineering, UX/UI, and testing teams.
- Ability to provide timely support during releases and maintain substantial working hours overlap with Avetta's core Product and Engineering teams. Experience using i18n or localization quality metrics is helpful; dashboarding or data-visualization expertise is not required.
- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to prototype solutions, develop workflow automations, document technical designs, or accelerate implementation is strongly preferred. Ability to contribute through APIs or scripting is beneficial; production software development is not required.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

## **The Team**

Upstart’s Auto Retail team is bringing Upstart’s AI-powered underwriting combined with best-in-class software to help all Americans get better access, lower rates and a better process when purchasing a vehicle. Auto lending represents over $600B in annual volume across over 70K dealerships and is used by almost every household in the country yet has record low process satisfaction, transparency, and credit access. We aim to change that. The team partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, Servicing, Fraud, dealer-facing functions and more to improve the experience for lenders, dealers, and consumers.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own program planning, execution and outcomes for complex, high-impact Auto Retail initiatives. You will turn ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work into clear plans, drive decisions, manage dependencies and risks, and help teams deliver reliably and with quality. You will partner with Product Managers, who own product strategy and priorities, and Engineering Managers and engineers, who own technical design and implementation. Your leverage will come from technical judgment, cross-functional leadership, bringing clarity from ambiguity, and the practical execution systems you build.

You’ll help accelerate the quality, speed, and adoption of the software and features we build by:

- Surfacing operational signals and customer pain points
- Analyzing problems and opportunities and developing clear, stack-ranked recommendations
- Driving PM-prioritized initiatives from technical planning through launch and rollout
- Establishing continuous feedback loops by monitoring post-launch results and identifying opportunities for iteration and improvement

## **How you’ll make an impact**

- Lead complex, cross-functional software initiatives from alignment through delivery, coordinating across Product, Engineering, Servicing, Analytics, Machine Learning, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and dealer-facing partners.
- Translate ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problem spaces into actionable plans with clear milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, and owners.
- Partner with Product Managers on business strategy and prioritization, and with Engineering Managers and engineering teams on technical approaches and execution plans.
- Engage meaningfully in technical discussions by evaluating software architecture, data models, data movement, data pipelines, and trade-offs among potential approaches.
- Identify blockers, clarify ambiguous ownership, surface downstream impacts early, and help teams resolve issues before they create delivery risk.
- Establish practical, lightweight ways of working that improve coordination and visibility across teams without creating unnecessary reporting or process overhead.

## **Minimum Qualifications**

- Professional experience in a Technical Program Management role, including ownership of complex, cross-functional software initiatives.
- Experience translating ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems into executable plans with milestones, dependencies, risks, and clear ownership.
- Experience working in a TPM or similar role directly with product managers and engineering managers and their teams with a clear understanding of ownership, roles, and responsibilities.
- Technical fluency in software architecture, data models, third party vendor integrations, and data pipelines, with the ability to evaluate trade-offs among technical approaches.
- Experience delivering initiatives across Product and Engineering while connecting program execution to measurable business or customer outcomes.

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience working in a complex industry, a multi-sided marketplace, or B2B2C environment with competing stakeholders and priorities such as speed, quality, reliability, and scale.
- Experience partnering with teams in financial services, auto retail, servicing, fraud, analytics, Machine Learning, or other operationally complex domains.
- Experience establishing and scaling practical program-management processes in an environment where ownership and ways of working are still evolving.
- Experience in a growth-stage technology company or other environment where teams must move quickly while managing execution risk.

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

$162,100—$224,500 USD

**What you'll love**

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

- Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
- Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
- Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
- Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
- Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
- Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
- Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
- Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
- Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
- Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
- Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
- Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
- Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

*If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email <candidate_accommodations@upstart.com>*
